一款**文化遗产资产管理**应用是文化遗产资产的官方记录软件：包括历史建筑、纪念碑、考古遗址、公园和花园、战场、文化景观、历史街区，以及类似的基于地点的遗产资源。它将每个资产作为独立识别、永久记录的条目进行管理，这些条目以遗产术语进行描述——它是什么、属于哪个时期、已知哪些信息、具有何种保护状态——并锚定在地理空间中的一个位置上。围绕这个登记册，系统记录了遗产机构用于理解、保护和管理这些资产的各种活动：实地调查与勘察、指定与名录收录决定、规划咨询、状况监测，以及向专业人士和公众发布清单。

其定义性核心故意保持精简：一份由遗产资产记录组成的常设清单、遗产领域的特征描述，以及位置锚定。其他一切——交互式地图、公共网络门户、咨询案例处理、社区提名、状况监测——在成熟产品中普遍存在，但它们是对登记册的扩展，并非使该登记册成为此**类型**应用的关键。

边界与定义同样重要：此**类型**并**不**保管实物。它没有入藏记录、没有存储位置、没有借出。一旦系统需要回答“这件物品存放在哪个架子上以及谁可以借阅它”，它就变成了馆藏管理系统。文化遗产资产管理回答的是另一个问题：“这个地方是什么，它在哪里，我们对它了解多少，以及它的状态如何？”
leaves.dc: The world of the application is organized around one central object and a documentation layer gathered around it.
leaves.dc_zh: 应用世界围绕一个中心对象及其周围的文档层来组织。
leaves.rules:
- **The record is of record.** Asset records persist and accumulate; changes are logged in audit trails, and prior states remain retrievable. Removing an asset from an official list is recorded as a decision, not an erasure.
- **Vocabulary is governed.** Characterization fields are populated from controlled terminologies so that decades of entries by different hands stay consistent and searchable. Terminology management is an administrative first-class activity, not an afterthought.
- **Spatial selection is a first-class operation.** "Everything within this area" is a core query of the Type, used constantly in casework and publishing; the map is both a working tool and an access route to records.
- **Access is tiered.** Internal, registered, and public views of the inventory differ; some recorded data is withheld from publication entirely, and unpublished or provisional entries are held for review before adoption.
- **Viewing is not consulting.** In planning-linked systems, using or reading the inventory explicitly does not substitute for the statutory consultation process; the system records casework, the legal process happens outside it.
- **Custody is absent by design.** Objects and finds appear as documentation of assets, not as accessioned holdings; the system does not model storage locations, ownership chains, or loans. This is the structural line between this Type and collection management.
- **Legacy data is a permanent concern.** Because these registries often descend from decades of paper records, bulk import, digitization, and reconciliation are standing features rather than one-time projects.
leaves.rules_zh:
- **记录即权威。**资产记录持续存在并不断累积；变更记录在审计跟踪中，先前状态仍可检索。将资产从官方名录中移除被记录为一项决定，而非擦除。
- **术语受管控。**特征描述字段使用受控术语进行填充，以确保数十年间不同人员输入的内容保持一致和可检索。术语管理是一项行政上的首要活动，而非事后补充。
- **空间选择是一等操作。**“此区域内的一切”是该**类型**的核心查询，频繁用于案例处理和发布；地图既是工作工具，也是访问记录的途径。
- **访问分级。**清单的内部视图、注册用户视图和公共视图有所不同；某些记录的数据完全不对外发布，未发布或临时性条目在被采纳前会保留以供审核。
- **查看不等于咨询。**在与规划相关的系统中，使用或阅读清单并不明确替代法定咨询程序；系统记录案例，法律程序发生在其外部。
- **设计上无保管功能。**物品和出土物作为资产的文献记录出现，而非作为入藏的馆藏；系统不建模存储位置、所有权链或借出。这是区分此**类型**与馆藏管理的结构性界限。
- **历史数据是永久性问题。**由于这些登记册通常源自数十年的纸质记录，批量导入、数字化和协调对账是持续存在的功能特点，而非一次性项目。

leaves.name: Curriculum Management
leaves.overview:
A **Curriculum Management** application is the institution-side system that governs what an educational institution teaches. It maintains the institution's curriculum — its programs and courses (in higher education) or its units and lessons mapped to standards (in schools) — as structured records, routes every change to those records through an institutional review-and-approval process, and publishes or synchronizes the approved result as the authoritative version of the curriculum that the rest of the institution relies on.

The defining core is small:

```text
Curriculum records
└── Governed change (proposal → review → approval, tracked)
    └── Curriculum of record, published / synchronized outward
```

Everything else commonly associated with these products — dynamic proposal forms, SIS synchronization, impact analysis, learning-outcome mapping, catalog sites, marketing coordination, study planners — is standard capability that mature products add to make the loop workable at institutional scale. It is not what makes the software a curriculum management application.

When the software starts managing enrolled students, delivering live courses to learners, or placing activities in rooms and time slots, it has crossed into a different Application Type (Student Information System, Learning Management System, Academic Timetabling).
leaves.overview_zh:
一个**课程管理**应用程序是机构侧的系统，用于管理教育机构的教学内容。它以结构化记录的形式维护机构的课程——包括高等教育中的专业与课程，或学校中映射到标准的教学单元与课程——并通过机构审查与批准流程路由对这些记录的所有更改，然后发布或同步批准的结果，作为该机构其余部分所依赖的权威课程版本。

其定义的核心是简洁的：

```text
课程记录
└── 受控的更改（提案 → 审查 → 批准，全程跟踪）
    └── 发布/同步到外部的权威课程记录
```

通常与此类软件相关的所有其他功能——动态提案表单、SIS 同步、影响分析、学习成果映射、目录网站、市场协调、学习计划器——都是成熟产品为使该循环在机构规模上可行而添加的标准能力。它们并非构成课程管理应用程序的本质。

当该软件开始管理注册学生、向学习者交付实时课程或将活动安排到教室和时间段时，它就跨越到了不同的应用类型（学生信息系统、学习管理系统、课程表编排系统）。
leaves.dc: The system's center is the curriculum itself, held as structured, governed records rather than as free documents:
leaves.dc_zh: 系统的中心是课程本身，以结构化的、受管理的记录形式存在，而不是自由文档：
leaves.rules:
- **Approval is the only path to change.** The live curriculum of record changes only when a proposal completes its review process; direct edits to published curriculum are not the model.
- **Effective-dating governs activation.** Approved changes apply to a designated term or catalog year; current students remain under the requirements of their entry version. Prior versions persist and remain consultable.
- **The record has history.** Proposals, edits, comments, and approvals are retained as an auditable trail; institutions must be able to show what the curriculum was, when, and who approved it.
- **Roles gate actions.** Who may propose, review, approve, configure, and publish is institution-defined and enforced; the same change may require different bodies depending on its type or scope.
- **The student system is a neighbor, not the same system.** Curriculum approvals typically synchronize with the student information system rather than replacing it; keeping the two aligned is one of the product's central jobs and a common source of operational risk when it fails.
- **Publication is downstream of governance.** What students and families see is generated from approved records; stale or divergent catalogs are precisely the failure mode these products exist to prevent.
leaves.rules_zh:
- **批准是更改的唯一途径。** 在线课程记录仅在提案完成其审查流程后才更改；直接编辑已发布的课程不是该模式。
- **生效日期管理激活。** 批准的更改适用于指定的学期或目录年份；现有学生仍按其入学版本的要求学习。先前版本持续存在并可供查询。
- **记录具有历史。** 提案、编辑、评论和批准都作为可审计的轨迹保留；机构必须能够展示课程在何时是什么样子，以及由谁批准。
- **角色控制操作。** 谁可以提案、审查、批准、配置和发布由机构定义并强制执行；根据更改的类型或范围，同一次更改可能需要不同的主体。
- **学生系统是邻居，而非同一系统。** 课程批准通常同步到学生信息系统，而非替代它；保持两者对齐是产品的核心任务之一，当同步失败时，这常成为运营风险的常见来源。
- **发布是治理的下游。** 学生和家长看到的内容是由批准的记录生成的；过时或有分歧的目录正是此类软件旨在防止的故障模式。

leaves.name: Customer Advocacy Platform
leaves.overview:
A **Customer Advocacy Platform** is a brand-side system of record for operating a customer advocacy program: it maintains a managed population of customer advocates, defines specific advocacy actions the brand wants from them, and runs each ask through a managed loop — targeting, participation, review, and recording — so the resulting advocacy (reference calls, reviews, testimonials, case studies, referrals, speaking, community contributions) can be delivered to the sales, marketing, and customer teams that need it, and measured against business outcomes.

The defining core is small:

```text
Advocate population of record
└── Advocacy ask (a specific requested action)
    └── Managed ask → participation loop
        (target → participate with proof → review/approve → record)
```

Everything else the market associates with the category — points, badges, leaderboards, reward catalogs, reference-request routing, advocate hubs, communities, revenue-influence dashboards, AI advocate sourcing — is widespread in current products but is not what makes the product an advocacy platform. A rewards-less reference program run from a spreadsheet satisfies the same core; the platform replaces the spreadsheet, not the program.

When the only ask is "refer someone" and the machinery centers on offer design, conversion attribution, and reward fulfillment, the product is a Referral Marketing Platform. When the reward attaches to the customer's own repeat purchases, it is Loyalty Program Management. When the participants are employees, external creators, or policy targets, it is a different Application Type entirely.
leaves.overview_zh:
一个**客户倡导平台**是品牌方用于运营客户倡导计划的系统记录：它维护一个受管理的客户倡导者群体，定义品牌希望他们执行的具体倡导行动，并将每个请求通过一个受管理的循环——目标定位、参与、审核和记录——进行处理，从而使产生的倡导活动（如参考电话、评论、证言、案例研究、推荐、演讲、社区贡献）能够交付给需要它的销售、市场和客户团队，并根据业务成果进行衡量。

其定义性的核心很小：

```text
倡导者群体记录
└── 倡导请求（一个具体的请求行动）
     └── 受管理的请求 → 参与循环
         (目标定位 → 带证明参与 → 审核/批准 → 记录)
```

市场与该类别关联的其他所有内容——积分、徽章、排行榜、奖励目录、参考请求路由、倡导者中心、社区、收入影响仪表盘、AI倡导者来源——在当前产品中很普遍，但这并不是使产品成为倡导平台的原因。一个没有奖励的、从电子表格运行的参考计划满足相同的核心；平台取代的是电子表格，而不是计划本身。

当唯一的请求是“推荐某人”，且机制集中在优惠设计、转化归因和奖励履行时，该产品是推荐营销平台。当奖励附着于客户自身的重复购买时，它是忠诚度计划管理。当参与者是员工、外部创作者或政策目标时，它完全是另一种应用类型。
leaves.dc:
**Advocate population of record.** The platform's foundation is a set of identified customers held as managed program members. Each advocate record carries who the person is (tied to their account/company), what they can credibly speak to (products used, industry, use cases, expertise), their program standing (active or inactive), their preferences (which activity types and topics they opt into, through which channels), any use limits, and their participation history. Advocates are recruited deliberately — nominated by internal users, identified from recently won deals, or enrolled through onboarding — because not every customer is suited or willing.

**Advocacy ask.** The unit of work is a brand-defined request for a specific advocacy action. Asks take many forms: take a reference call with a prospect, write a review on a third-party site, provide a testimonial or quote, participate in a case study or customer story, refer a peer, speak at an event or webinar, share brand content socially, answer questions in the community, join a customer advisory board, test a beta, or give product feedback. An ask specifies what to do, how to submit proof of completion, and (commonly) what recognition it carries.

**Managed ask → participation loop.** Asks do not float freely; they are targeted to suitable advocates based on segment, preferences, and fit, then offered through the advocate's preferred channel. The advocate responds — accepts, completes the action, and submits proof (a link to the review or post, a file, a confirmation). Completions pass a review or approval gate before being credited. Every participation is recorded against the advocate and the program, which is what makes overuse protection, recognition, and measurement possible.

If any of the three is removed, the product stops being an advocacy platform: without advocate records it is an anonymous campaign tool; without asks it is a contact database; without the managed loop it is one-off outreach with no program memory.
leaves.dc_zh:
倡导者记录库。平台的基础是一组被识别出的客户，作为管理计划成员。每个倡导者记录包含：人物身份（与账户/公司关联），他们可信地谈论的内容（使用的产品、行业、用例、专业知识），他们的计划状态（活跃或非活跃），他们的偏好（他们选择参与的活动类型和主题，通过哪些渠道），任何使用限制，以及他们的参与历史。倡导者是精心招募的——由内部用户提名，从最近赢得的交易中识别，或通过入职流程注册——因为不是每个客户都适合或愿意。

倡导请求。工作单元是品牌定义的特定倡导行动请求。请求采取多种形式：与潜在客户进行参考电话，在第三方网站上写评论，提供推荐或引言，参与案例研究或客户故事，推荐同行，在活动或网络研讨会上演讲，在社交媒体上分享品牌内容，在社区中回答问题，加入客户顾问委员会，测试测试版，或提供产品反馈。请求指定要做什么，如何提交完成证明，以及（通常）携带什么认可。

管理请求 → 参与循环。请求不是随意漂浮的；它们基于细分、偏好和适合度针对合适的倡导者，然后通过倡导者的...
leaves.rules:
### Advocate consent and preferences govern targeting

Advocates opt into activity types and topics and choose channels. Asks are offered "on their terms" — a customer who has not opted into public reviews should not receive review asks. Preferences are a structural control, not a courtesy.

### Use limits and overuse protection

Advocate goodwill is a finite resource. Products track each advocate's past and pending participations, support per-advocate use limits and per-activity completion caps, and surface overuse before another ask is made. Reference requests additionally require the customer's account team to approve use before the customer is approached.

### Completion passes a review gate

Proof of completion is reviewed before credit: approve, or reject with a reason and allow resubmission. For reference activity, the loop closes with outcome feedback (did the call happen, how did it go), because an unfulfilled or failed request is a program signal, not just a missing record.

### Advocate data has a shelf life

Profiles decay — people change roles, products, and willingness. Mature products automate profile refresh; some also track advocates' job changes, because reference search is only as good as the data behind it.

### Rewards are gated by approval

Recognition is credited after the review gate, not at submission. Points accumulate to a balance redeemable from a catalog; some programs also reward internal users for program work (nominating, arranging, updating profiles) to sustain adoption on the operator side.

### The program serves commercial outcomes

Advocacy activity is recorded in a form that can be tied to business results — the opportunity a reference supported, the deal influenced by a customer story, the referral that became a lead. Program reporting speaks the language of pipeline and revenue, not just participation counts.
leaves.rules_zh:
### 倡导者同意和偏好主导目标定位

倡导者选择参与的活动类型和主题，并选择渠道。请求是“按他们的条件”提供的——一个未选择公开评论的客户不应收到评论请求。偏好是结构性控制，而非礼貌。

### 使用限制和过度使用保护

倡导者的善意是有限的资源。产品跟踪每个倡导者的过去和待处理参与，支持每倡导者使用限制和每活动完成上限，并在进行另一个请求前显示过度使用。参考请求还要求客户的客户团队在接触客户前批准使用。

### 完成通过审核关卡

完成证明在授予认可前进行审核：批准，或拒绝并提供原因并允许重新提交。对于参考活动，循环以结果反馈结束（通话是否发生，进行得如何），因为未履行或失败的请求是计划信号，而不仅仅是缺失的记录。

### 倡导者数据有保质期

档案会衰减——人们改变角色、产品和意愿。成熟的产品自动化档案刷新；一些还跟踪倡导者的工作变动，因为参考搜索仅取决于其背后的数据质量。

### 奖励由批准门控

认可在审核关卡后授予，而非在提交时。积分累积为可从目录兑换的余额；一些计划还奖励内部用户进行计划工作（提名、安排、更新档案）以维持运营方的采用。

### 计划服务于商业成果

倡导活动以可关联到业务结果的形式记录——参考支持的机会，客户故事影响的交易，成为线索的推荐。计划报告

leaves.name: Customer Communication Management / CCM
leaves.overview:
A **Customer Communication Management (CCM)** application is an organization-side system for designing, producing, delivering, and governing its recurring outbound customer communications — bills, statements, insurance policies, notices, disclosures, and correspondence — by combining governed templates and approved content with customer data, and delivering the individualized results across the organization's delivery channels (from print to digital in today's products) as a managed production operation that keeps a record of what was sent.

The problems it solves are specific: organizations in regulated, high-volume industries send large volumes of standardized communications that must each be personally accurate, legally compliant, on-brand, and reproducible after the fact — and they must maintain that output across decades of changing regulations, brands, and channels. CCM turns this from scattered per-document work into one governed portfolio: communication designs held in one place, assembled from data, produced across channels, and traceable.

The boundary is equally specific. CCM is about **transactional and service correspondence arising from the customer relationship** — the statement a bank owes a customer, the policy documents an insurer must issue, the notice a utility must send. It is not promotional campaign sending (marketing platforms), not one-off collaborative documents (document generation), not the computation of the charges themselves (billing), and not two-way customer conversation (customer service).
leaves.overview_zh:
一款**客户沟通管理（CCM）**应用是组织侧的系统，用于设计、生产、交付并治理其重复性的外发客户沟通内容——包括账单、对账单、保险单、通知、披露文件及信函——通过将受治理的模板和经批准的内容与客户数据相结合，并将个性化结果通过组织的交付渠道（在当今产品中涵盖从印刷到数字化的形式）作为受管的生产操作进行交付，同时保留已发送内容的记录。

它所解决的问题是具体的：处于受监管、高业务量行业中的组织需要发送大量标准化的沟通内容，这些内容必须对每位客户都保持个人准确性、法律合规性、符合品牌规范，且事后可复现——并且它们必须在数十年间不断变化的法规、品牌和渠道中维持这种输出。CCM 将这种分散的单文档工作转变为一个受治理的组合：沟通设计集中存放于一处，由数据组装，跨渠道生产，且可追溯。

其边界同样具体。CCM 关注的是**源于客户关系的交易性和服务性信函**——银行欠客户的对账单、保险公司必须签发的保单文件、公用事业公司必须发送的通知。它不是促销活动的发送（营销平台），不是一次性的协作文档（文档生成），不是费用本身的计算（计费），也不是双向的客户对话（客户服务）。
leaves.dc:
- **Archive and retrieval** — produced communications stored as searchable, audit-ready records, retrievable for regulatory reviews, data-protection requests, and service follow-ups. Nearly universal, but packaged differently: a native module at some products, a separate suite product at others, an integration with archive providers at others.
- **Interactive, on-demand generation** — communications produced during live customer interactions, with data pre-filled from the CRM or core system, guided selections, controlled editing with real-time proofing, and optional approvals before sending.
- **Delivery orchestration** — respecting customer channel preferences (including opt-in/opt-out), keeping channels in sync, capturing engagement (opens, links, delivery confirmation), and triggering follow-up communications.
- **Production monitoring** — real-time visibility into jobs and runs, exception handling, batch- and individual-level tracking, and job consolidation across output sources.
- **Post-composition handling** — packaging already-composed output for delivery, converting print files into digital formats, and moving work between print facilities and service providers without touching upstream systems.
- **Integration surface** — APIs and connectors to CRM, ERP, billing, policy, and claims systems that feed data in and embed generation where staff work.
- **Content quality automation** — increasingly common AI assistance: readability, tone, and brand checks during authoring; automated QA of complex communications; translation.

Optional, segment-dependent structures include guided forms and interviews that capture data feeding communications, journey mapping as a planning layer, accessibility tooling for standards-compliant output, migration and rationalization tooling for legacy communication estates, and vertical packaging for specific regulated programs.
leaves.dc_zh:
档案和检索：产生的通信存储为可搜索、可审计的记录，可检索用于监管审查、数据保护请求和服务跟进。几乎是通用的，但包装方式不同：在一些产品中是原生模块，在其他产品中是单独的套件产品，或者与其他归档提供商集成。
交互式、按需生成：在实时客户交互中产生的通信，数据从CRM或核心系统预填充，指导选择，控制编辑并实时校对，可选在发送前审批。
交付编排：尊重客户渠道偏好（包括选择加入/退出），保持渠道同步，捕获参与度（打开、链接、交付确认），并触发后续通信。
生产监控：实时查看作业和运行，异常处理，批量和单个级别跟踪，以及跨输出源的作业合并。
后处理：将已组合的输出打包用于交付，将打印文件转换为数字格式，并在打印设施和服务提供商之间移动工作而不触及上游系统。
集成界面：API和连接器连接到CRM、ERP、计费、政策和索赔系统，输入数据并嵌入生成在工作人员工作的地方。
内容质量保证：确保内容准确、合规和品牌一致性的过程。
leaves.rules:
- **Content changes are governed events.** Approval workflows and version control gate what enters the live portfolio; regulatory content is commonly locked so it cannot be edited ad hoc inside a communication. The system is designed so that a produced communication can always be tied to an approved version.
- **The record is structural.** Mature products commonly keep, per communication, who sent what, when, to whom, and in what version — from content creation through delivery to archive. As-delivered versions are commonly stored precisely because regulators and customers may ask for them years later.
- **Batch and on-demand coexist under one portfolio.** The same approved design can be produced in a scheduled high-volume run or triggered for one customer; both produce the same governed artifact.
- **Assembly is rule-driven, not just field-filling.** Conditional content — disclosures selected by region or product, offers by eligibility, required notices by situation — is a standard assembly behavior, and the rules themselves are part of the governed design.
- **Channel preferences are respected.** Delivery orchestration commonly honors opt-in/opt-out state and channel preference, and captures engagement (delivery, opens, links) that can trigger follow-up.
- **Production is monitored as an operation.** Runs have exceptions — missing data, failed output, delivery failures — and mature products surface them for intervention before they breach service commitments or compliance obligations.
- **Print remains a first-class channel.** Even cloud-native products treat print output (files and streams for production facilities) as a primary channel alongside digital ones — a heritage of the category that has not been engineered away.
leaves.rules_zh:
- **内容变更是受治理的事件。** 批准工作流和版本控制决定什么进入实时组合；监管内容通常被锁定，以便不能在沟通中随意编辑。系统设计确保已生产的沟通内容始终可以关联到经批准的版本。
- **记录是结构化的。** 成熟产品通常按每个沟通内容保留，谁在何时向谁发送了什么以及哪个版本——从内容创建到交付再到归档。已交付版本通常被精确存储，因为监管机构和客户可能在多年后要求提供这些版本。
- **批量和按需在一个组合下共存。** 同一个经批准的设计可以在计划的高产量运行中生产，也可以为单个客户触发；两者都产生相同的受治理产物。
- **组装是规则驱动的，而不仅仅是字段填充。** 条件内容——按地区或产品选择的披露、按资格提供的优惠、按情况要求的通知——是标准的组装行为，且规则本身也是受治理设计的一部分。
- **尊重渠道偏好。** 交付编排通常尊重选择加入/退出状态和渠道偏好，并捕获参与度（交付、打开、链接点击），这些可以触发后续跟进。
- **生产作为操作进行监控。** 运行会有异常——数据缺失、输出失败、交付失败——成熟产品会在它们违反服务承诺或合规义务之前将其呈现出来以供干预。
- **印刷仍是一级渠道。** 即使是云原生产品也将印刷输出（用于生产设施的文件和流）视为与数字渠道并列的主要渠道——这是该类别的传统，并未被工程化消除。

leaves.name: Customer Data Platform / CDP
leaves.overview:
A **Customer Data Platform (CDP)** is customer data infrastructure whose central object is the **persistent, individual customer profile**: it continuously consolidates customer data from multiple source systems into one durable record per person, links records and events that belong to the same individual (identity resolution), derives attributes and audiences from those profiles, and makes the profiles and audiences available to other systems — ad platforms, messaging tools, personalization surfaces, analytics, and warehouses.

The defining core is small:

```text
Customer data from many source systems
  → consolidated into persistent individual profiles
  → linked to the right person via identity resolution
  → enriched and grouped into audiences
  → delivered outward to systems that act on them
```

Three properties hold the type together. Remove the persistent individual profile and the product becomes an event pipeline or analytics tool. Remove multi-source consolidation with identity linkage and it becomes a single-source contact database. Remove outbound delivery and it becomes a customer analytics database with nothing activated.

Everything else commonly associated with CDPs — identity graphs, streaming ingestion, destination catalogs, consent dashboards, AI-predicted attributes, warehouse interop — is widespread in current products but is not what makes the product a CDP. A pre-cloud marketing database that assembled unified customer records from several systems and exported lists to a mail house satisfies the same core without any of the modern machinery.
leaves.overview_zh:
一个**客户数据平台（CDP）**是一种客户数据基础设施，其核心对象是**持久化的个体客户档案**：它持续地将来自多个源系统的客户数据整合为每个人的一条持久记录，将通过身份解析关联到同一人的记录与事件，从这些档案中推导属性和受众群体，并将这些档案和受众群体提供给其他系统——广告平台、消息工具、个性化界面、分析工具和仓库。

其定义性的核心很小：

```text
来自多个源系统的客户数据
   → 整合为持久化的个体档案
   → 通过身份解析关联到正确的人
   → 丰富并分组为受众群体
   → 向外交付给对其采取行动的系统
```

三个特性维系着这一类型。移除持久化的个体档案，产品就变成了事件管道或分析工具。移除带有身份关联的多源整合，它就变成了单源联系人数据库。移除向外交付，它就变成了一个没有任何激活功能的客户分析数据库。

通常与CDP相关联的其他所有内容——身份图谱、流式摄取、目标目录、同意管理仪表板、AI预测属性、仓库互操作——在当前产品中很普遍，但这并不是使产品成为CDP的原因。一个前云时代的营销数据库，如果从几个系统中组装统一的客户记录并将列表导出给邮件服务商，就能满足同样的核心，而不需要任何现代机制。
leaves.dc: The center of the system is the **customer profile** — a persistent, individually addressable record for one person. Every profile carries:
leaves.dc_zh: 系统的核心是客户档案——一个持久、可单独寻址的个人记录。每个档案包含：
leaves.rules:
- **The profile persists and accumulates.** Profiles survive sessions, channel switches, and long gaps in activity. Accumulation over time is the point: computed attributes and predictions depend on history.
- **Anonymous and known coexist, and identification is a merge.** Work done anonymously is not discarded when the person is later identified; it is attached to the known profile. The reverse — un-merging — is generally not a designed operation; in the products researched, identity merges are treated as permanent, which is why merge rules are configured carefully.
- **Conflicting data is resolved by rules, not silence.** When two sources disagree about an attribute value, a merge policy (recency, source priority, or explicit rules) decides which value the profile carries.
- **Audience membership is dynamic.** A profile's membership changes as its data changes; audiences are living definitions, not exported snapshots — although snapshot exports to destinations are also a normal delivery mode.
- **Consent gates the loop.** Consent state on the profile determines whether data may be processed and whether the profile may be delivered to particular destination types; opt-outs and deletion requests must propagate to downstream systems that already received the data.
- **The CDP consolidates; it does not originate.** The platform does not create customer data; it reflects what sources send. Data quality problems upstream become profile problems downstream, which is why validation and monitoring surfaces are standard.
- **Activation is delivery, not execution.** The CDP hands profiles and audiences to other systems that act on them. (One market variant — marketer-operated CDPs with built-in on-site interaction and journey execution — crosses this line deliberately; see Variants.)
leaves.rules_zh:
- **档案持久化并积累。** 档案在会话、渠道切换和长期活动间隔中存活。随时间的积累是关键：计算属性和预测依赖于历史。
- **匿名与已知共存，且识别是合并。** 匿名完成的工作在人员后来被识别时不会被丢弃；它会被附加到已知档案上。相反——取消合并——通常不是设计操作；在研究的产品中，身份合并被视为永久性的，这就是为什么合并规则被仔细配置。
- **冲突数据通过规则而非沉默解决。** 当两个源对属性值不一致时，合并策略（最近性、源优先级或显式规则）决定档案携带哪个值。
- **受众成员资格是动态的。** 随着数据变化，档案的成员资格发生变化；受众是活的定义，而非导出的快照——尽管向目标导出快照也是正常的交付模式。
- **同意控制循环。** 档案上的同意状态决定数据是否可被处理以及档案是否可交付给特定类型的目标；退出和删除请求必须传播到已接收数据的下游系统。
- **CDP整合；它不产生。** 平台不创建客户数据；它反映源发送的内容。上游的数据质量问题成为下游的档案问题，这就是为什么验证和监控界面是标准的。
- **激活是交付，而非执行。** CDP将档案和受众群体交给对其采取行动的其他系统。（一种市场变体——由营销人员操作的CDP，具有内置的站内交互和旅程执行——故意跨越了这条线；见Variants）

leaves.name: Customer Energy Management
leaves.overview:
A **Customer Energy Management** application is the software through which the user of energy — a household or a business customer — observes, understands, and acts on **their own premises' energy usage and cost**. It collects or receives the customer's energy data (meter readings, in-home monitoring, connected devices), turns it into cost and usage insight, and drives action: changing behavior, automating or controlling devices, choosing rate plans, and participating in utility programs.

Two realization poles share the same structure:

- **utility-provided customer tools** — energy insights and self-service experiences that an energy utility offers to its customers under the utility's brand, usually embedded in or connected to the utility's website and account;
- **customer-owned energy products** — applications that come with home energy monitors, connected plugs, solar/battery systems, or EV chargers, operated by the customer directly.

The defining core is deliberately smaller than the modern feature set. Real-time data, smart-meter feeds, device control, solar and battery integration, neighbor comparison, AI assistants, and bill payment are all widespread but none of them is what makes the software customer energy management. A utility portal showing monthly usage from monthly meter reads — and even the older tradition of mailed home energy reports comparing a household to its neighbors — sits on the same defining loop.
leaves.overview_zh:
一个**客户能源管理**应用程序是能源使用者——家庭或商业客户——观察、理解并针对**其自身场所的能源使用与成本**采取行动的软件。它收集或接收客户的能源数据（抄表读数、家庭内部监控、联网设备），将其转化为成本和使用洞察，并驱动行动：改变行为、自动化或控制设备、选择费率方案，以及参与公用事业计划。

两种实现极点共享相同的结构：

- **公用事业提供的客户工具** — 能源洞察和自助服务体验，由能源公用事业公司在其品牌下提供给其客户，通常嵌入或连接到公用事业的网站和账户；
- **客户自有的能源产品** — 随家庭能源监控器、智能插座、太阳能/电池系统或电动汽车充电桩附带的应用程序，由客户直接操作。

定义的核心有意识地比现代功能集要小。实时数据、智能电表数据馈送、设备控制、太阳能与电池集成、邻居比较、AI助手和账单支付都很普遍，但其中没有一项构成该软件为客户能源管理的本质。一个显示每月抄表读数月度用量的公用事业门户网站——甚至更早的传统，即邮寄的、将家庭与其邻居进行比较的家庭能源报告——都位于相同的定义循环中。
leaves.dc:
```text
The Customer's Premise  (the energy user's own site — home or business location,
                         bound to a utility account or to the customer's devices)
└── Energy flows made visible to the customer
    │   consumption recorded over time (meter / monitor / plug data)
    │   + production, storage, grid exchange where present
    └── Rates and tariffs applied → cost and savings
    └── Insight machinery (comparisons, forecasts, alerts, tips, goals,
        device-level detail) whose purpose is customer action
        └── Action: behavior change · device control & automation ·
            rate/plan choice · program participation
```

Three properties. If any one is removed, the product is no longer recognizable as this Type:

- **Customer-side operation on one's own energy.** The operator is the energy customer acting on their own premises — not an organization managing a portfolio of buildings, not a utility managing the grid, not a program managing events. The data, the decisions, and the benefits all belong to the customer.
- **The premise's usage made visible to the customer as data over time.** The customer's consumption exists in the application as recorded, browsable history attached to their site. Without this, the product is a marketing page or a device remote control, not energy management.
- **The insight → action loop.** The application exists to turn usage into findings — cost, comparisons, forecasts, anomalies, advice, goals — and those findings into customer action. An application that only displays raw data (a passive data feed) or only switches devices (a controller without usage visibility) falls out of the Type.
leaves.dc_zh:
客户的场所（能源用户自己的场所——家庭或商业地点，绑定到公用事业账户或客户设备）
└── 能源流对客户可见
    │   随时间记录的消耗（仪表/监控/插座数据）
    │   + 在存在的情况下，生产、储存、电网交换
    └── 应用费率和资费 → 成本和节省
    └── 洞察机制（比较、预测、警报、提示、目标、设备级细节），其目的是客户行动
        └── 行动：行为改变·设备控制与自动化·费率/计划选择·计划参与
leaves.rules:
### The customer sees their own energy only

Everything in the application is scoped to the customer's own premise: data arrives by way of the customer's utility account authorization or the customer's own devices, and sharing is explicit (household members, invited guests, business colleagues). There is no browsing of other people's energy.

### The application complements the bill; it is not the bill

In-app cost figures are computed from metered or monitored data and configured rates — useful estimates, not billing documents. Products say this in various ways: insights arrive "in addition to receiving a bill", exports are "aligned with utility billing cycles", bill figures are "forecasts". Where accuracy matters (reconciliation, expense claims), the customer falls back to the utility bill and exports the underlying data.

### Fair comparison needs context

Comparisons are only meaningful with normalization: neighbor comparisons are made against *similar* homes; time-of-use tracking requires the rate periods to be configured; period-over-period comparisons are shaped by weather and occupancy in more mature products. An application that compares without context misleads — products therefore invest as much in the comparison setup as in the comparison itself.

### Proactive delivery is structural, not cosmetic

The customer is passive most of the time. Alerts (high-bill risk, anomalies), scheduled summaries, and program offers are how the loop actually reaches the customer; an insight that nobody sees changes nothing. Notification configuration is correspondingly a first-class surface.

### The action leg is bounded by the energy seller's world

In utility-provided tools, what the customer can act on (plans, programs, rebates) is whatever the utility offers; rate education and program enrollment follow the utility's catalog. In customer-owned products, automation operates within physical and safety limits (panel capacity, device constraints) and configuration changes typically require explicit user confirmation. The application does not silently rewrite the customer's energy contracts or override safety limits.

### Cadence follows the data path, and the data path does not change the Type

Real-time is a property of the data source (monitor, smart-meter feed), not of the Type. Monthly-read portals serve the same defining loop at monthly cadence.
leaves.rules_zh:
### 客户仅看到自己的能源

应用程序中的所有内容都限定在客户自己的场所范围：数据通过客户的公用事业账户授权或客户自己的设备到达，分享是显式的（家庭成员、受邀访客、商业同事）。没有浏览他人能源信息的功能。

### 应用程序是账单的补充；而非账单本身

应用内的成本数字是根据计量或监控数据以及配置的费率计算得出的——是有用的估算值，而非计费文件。产品以不同方式说明这一点：洞察是“在收到账单之外”提供的，导出数据“与公用事业计费周期对齐”，账单数字是“预测”。在需要准确性的地方（对账、费用报销），客户会求助于公用事业账单并导出基础数据。

### 公平比较需要上下文

只有进行标准化处理，比较才有意义：邻居比较是针对*相似*家庭的；分时用量跟踪需要配置费率时段；在更成熟的产品中，期间比较会考虑天气和占用情况的影响。缺乏上下文的比较会产生误导——因此，产品在比较设置和比较功能本身上投入同样多的精力。

### 主动推送是结构性的，而非表面装饰

客户在大多数时候是被动的。警报（高账单风险、异常情况）、定时摘要和计划推广是循环实际触达客户的方式；无人看到的洞察不会带来任何改变。因此，通知配置相应地成为一个首要关注的界面。

### 行动部分受限于能源销售方的范围

在公用事业提供的工具中，客户可以采取的行动（计划、计划、返利）仅限于公用事业公司提供的内容；费率教育

leaves.name: Customer Experience Management Platform
leaves.overview:
A **Customer Experience Management Platform** is the market's umbrella name for the enterprise product class that operates a standing program of measuring and improving the experiences an organization's own customers have with it — asking customers structured questions about their experience, measuring the answers into tracked experience metrics, and acting on what customers say, down to following up with the individual customer who reported a problem.

The defining structure is the one this product class actually realizes:

```text
Experience program of record
└── Instruments fielded to the organization's own customers
    (recurring relationship cadence + event-triggered transaction moments)
    └── Attributed response record
        (each response bound to a customer and to the rated interaction)
        └── Experience measurement
            (scores tracked over time; open text turned into themes)
            └── Follow-up routing loop
                (adverse responses routed to accountable owners; close the loop)
```

On current evidence, this phrase and "Voice of Customer Platform" name the **same product class**. The flagship products marketed as customer-experience or experience-management platforms are the same products the analyst market classifies and evaluates as voice-of-the-customer platforms; no independent product category with a distinct structure under the CEM name was found in the market and analyst surfaces examined. This document covers the class from the customer-experience-management lens; the alias relationship is recorded for taxonomy review.

Two things this phrase is often taken to mean, but is not, on the evidence:

- **A journey-orchestration-centered Type.** Customer journey analytics and orchestration appear across the class as a capability layer over the same collect → measure → act loop, not as a separate structure that defines a different Type.
- **A multi-audience "experience management" Type.** The broadest vendor framing spans customer, employee, product, and brand experiences on one platform. The customer slice of that umbrella is this product class; the employee, product, and brand slices are sibling solution areas on shared machinery — a packaging posture, not a new customer-facing structure.
leaves.overview_zh:
一个**客户体验管理平台**是该市场中用于指代一类企业产品的统称，这类产品运行着一项持续性的计划，旨在衡量并改善组织自身客户与其交互的体验——向客户提出关于其体验的结构化问题，将回答转化为可追踪的体验指标，并对客户反馈采取行动，直至跟进报告问题的具体客户。

其定义性结构是该类产品实际实现的结构：

```text
体验计划记录
└── 向组织自身客户投放的问卷
     (周期性关系节奏 + 事件触发的交易时刻)
     └── 归属响应记录
         (每个响应绑定到特定客户及被评定的交互)
         └── 体验测量
             (随时间追踪的分数；开放文本转化为主题)
             └── 跟进路由循环
                 (负面响应路由至责任人；闭环管理)
```

根据现有证据，该术语与“客户之声平台”指代的是**同一类产品**。作为客户体验或体验管理平台营销的旗舰产品，与分析师市场分类和评估为客户之声平台的产品是相同的；在考察的市场和分析师领域中，未发现以CEM名称命名的具有独特结构的独立产品类别。本文档从客户体验管理的视角涵盖此类产品；别名关系已记录以供分类审查。

根据证据，该术语常被误解为以下两种含义，但实际上并非如此：

- **以旅程编排为中心的Type。** 客户旅程分析和编排作为能力层出现在该类产品的收集→测量→行动循环之上，而非作为定义不同Type的独立结构。
- **多受众“体验管理”Type。** 最广泛的供应商框架涵盖单一平台上的客户、员工、产品和品牌体验。该伞形概念中的客户部分属于此类产品；员工、产品和品牌部分则是共享机制上的同级解决方案领域——这是一种包装姿态，而非新的面向客户的结构。
leaves.dc:
Four jointly-held structures:

**1. The experience program of record.** The organization configures standing question instruments — built around experience-metric questions (the recommendation / satisfaction / effort family of scores) plus open text — and fields them to its own customer base across defined touchpoints. Programs run in two canonical postures:

- **Relationship programs** — recurring or scheduled sends to the customer base or segments, measuring the overall relationship.
- **Transactional programs** — sends triggered by a business event at an interaction endpoint: an order delivered, a support ticket closed, a stay completed, a payment processed. The trigger typically arrives from an integrated system through a native integration, webhook, or API.

Mature products carry both postures; together they turn isolated surveys into a continuous measurement program covering the customer journey.

**2. The attributed response record.** Every response is held as an identified record bound to the customer — a contact record, and in business-to-business configurations a company/account above the contact — and to the context of the rated interaction (the triggering event, channel, touchpoint, location). Responses accumulate into per-customer history and program-level history. Identified attribution is the norm; anonymous collection exists as a variant that weakens exactly this structure.

**3. The experience measurement layer.** Responses are continuously computed into experience metrics — scores tracked as trends over time, broken out by touchpoint, segment, location, or cohort — and open-text answers are classified into themes and sentiment. The metrics are the "voice" made comparable; the themes are the reasons behind it.

**4. The follow-up routing loop.** Individual responses — adverse ones above all — are routed outward to accountable people: alerts, automated replies to the customer, tickets or cases created in the platform or in connected service systems, and frontline follow-up queues. Alongside the individual loop runs the systemic one: reports and dashboards that put recurring issues in front of the people who own the process. "Close the loop" is the program's own vocabulary for both.
leaves.dc_zh:
四个共同持有的结构：

**1. 体验计划记录。** 组织配置标准问题工具——围绕体验指标问题（推荐度/满意度/努力度系列得分）加上开放文本构建——并在定义的接触点向其自身客户群投放这些问题。计划以两种典型姿态运行：

- **关系计划** — 定期或按计划向客户群或细分市场发送，衡量整体关系。
- **交易计划** — 由交互端点的业务事件触发发送：订单交付、支持票证关闭、入住完成、支付处理。触发器通常通过原生集成、webhook或API从集成系统到达。

成熟产品兼具两种姿态；它们共同将孤立的调查转变为覆盖客户旅程的连续测量计划。

**2. 归因响应记录。** 每个响应作为与客户绑定的已识别记录持有——一个联系记录，在企业对企业配置中是一个位于联系之上的公司/账户——以及评级交互的上下文（触发事件、渠道、接触点、位置）。响应累积成每个客户的历史和计划级别的历史。已识别归因是常态；匿名收集作为一种变体存在，它恰好削弱了这一点
leaves.rules:
- **Solicited, not scraped.** The program asks; the platform's data is consented responses from the organization's own customers, not harvested public speech. This rule is the structural seam from social listening.
- **Attribution is the point — with a deliberate exception.** Identified responses power per-customer history and follow-up; anonymous collection exists (public link pages) but at the cost of exactly the structures that make the program actionable.
- **Over-surveying is managed.** Frequency caps, throttling, last-asked tracking, and reminders exist because response quality degrades when the same customers are asked too often.
- **Opt-out is honored.** Customers who decline further surveys are suppressed from future sends.
- **Triggers reflect source-system truth.** Transactional sends fire from real business events; the fidelity of "which event, which customer, which context" depends on the integration.
- **Metric definitions are program assets.** What counts as a promoter, a satisfied response, or a theme is configured and versioned by the organization, not fixed universally by the product.
- **Follow-up has owners.** Alerts and tickets name an accountable person; the loop is closed when the response has been acted on and, in mature programs, the customer told.
- **Visibility is role-scoped.** Executives, managers, and frontline staff see different slices of the same program; frontline scores are often confined to the respondent's own location or team.
leaves.rules_zh:
- **主动询问，而非抓取。** 计划进行询问；平台的数据来自组织自身客户的同意响应，而非采集的公开言论。这条规则是与社交聆听之间的结构分界线。
- **归属是关键——但有刻意例外。** 已识别的响应支持每客户历史和跟进；匿名收集存在 (公共链接页面)，但代价是失去了使计划可操作的确切结构。
- **管理过度调查。** 频率上限、节流、上次询问追踪和提醒的存在，是因为当同一客户被询问过于频繁时，响应质量会下降。
- **尊重退出选择。** 拒绝进一步调查的客户将从未来发送中抑制。
- **触发器反映源系统真相。** 事务性发送由真实业务事件触发；“哪个事件，哪个客户，哪个上下文”的保真度取决于集成。
- **指标定义是计划资产。** 什么算作推荐者、满意响应或主题，由组织配置和版本控制，而非由产品普遍固定。
- **跟进有责任人。** 警报和工单指定一名责任人；当响应已被采取行动，且在成熟计划中已告知客户时，循环才闭合。
- **可见性按角色限定。** 高管、经理和一线员工看到同一计划的不同切片；一线分数通常仅限于受访者自己的地点或团队。

leaves.name: Customer Feedback Management
leaves.overview:
A **Customer Feedback Management** application is the vendor-side system of record for customer feedback about a product. It captures individual pieces of feedback — requests, ideas, problems, suggestions — as persistent records attributed to the customers who gave them, consolidates related feedback from many customers into one managed item, and organizes those items so the product organization can triage, prioritize, and act on them over time.

The defining core is small:

```text
Customer feedback item of record
└── attributed to the customers who gave it (person + their company/account)
    └── related feedback consolidated across customers (one demand signal, many contributors)
        └── managed pipeline: organized → triaged → tracked through statuses toward product decisions
```

Everything else commonly associated with the category — public voting portals, changelogs, revenue-based prioritization, AI capture from support conversations — is widespread in current products but not part of what makes the application this Type. A team running a shared spreadsheet of feature requests, with a column for the requesting account, a running count of who asked, and a status column, is practicing the same discipline; these applications give that discipline structure, memory, and reach.
leaves.overview_zh:
一款**客户反馈管理**应用是厂商侧关于产品客户反馈的系统记录。它将单条反馈——请求、想法、问题、建议——作为归属于提供反馈的客户的持久化记录进行捕获，将来自众多客户的相关反馈整合为一个受管理的条目，并组织这些条目，以便产品组织能够随时间推移对其进行分类、确定优先级并采取行动。

其定义性的核心很小：

```text
客户反馈记录条目
└── 归属于提供反馈的客户（个人 + 其公司/账户）
     └── 跨客户整合的相关反馈（一个需求信号，众多贡献者）
         └── 受管理的流水线：组织 → 分类 → 通过状态跟踪直至产品决策
```

通常与该类别相关联的其他一切——公开投票门户、更新日志、基于收入的优先级排序、从支持对话中通过 AI 捕获——在当前产品中很普遍，但并非构成该应用此类型的关键部分。一个团队使用共享电子表格管理功能请求，其中包含请求账户列、询问人数计数列和状态列，这正是在实践同样的纪律；这些应用为这种纪律提供了结构、记忆和覆盖范围。
leaves.dc_zh:
- 一个**面向客户的反馈门户**——一个品牌化的界面（公开或仅限客户访问），客户可在其中提交、浏览、投票和评论；
- **重复项抑制**——在提交时提示相似的现有条目，并自动或由版主合并近似重复项；
- **闭环沟通**——客户可见的状态更新，当一个条目有进展或发布时，自动通知投票者和贡献者，并发布宣布已发布内容的**变更日志**；
- **多渠道收集**——集成从支持工单、聊天工具、CRM记录、邮件转发地址、浏览器扩展、应用商店评论以及CSV导入中提取反馈；
- **优先级排序机制**——评分和公式、影响评估，以及在B2B场景下，按客户收入加权；
- **贡献者赋能**——轻量级角色，使客户面向团队的员工能够提交和跟踪反馈，而无需成为产品团队用户。
leaves.rules:
- **Attribution is structural.** Every item and every contribution is tied to an identified customer. The contributor's own identity is recorded separately — the rule is to attribute the feedback to its originator, not to the employee who relayed it. Aggregation without attribution degrades the system into an anonymous suggestion box.
- **Merging is usually one-way.** Consolidating items combines their histories and contributor bases; products commonly do not offer an un-merge. Moderators are expected to merge deliberately.
- **Internal workflow and external communication are separable.** What the team sees and what customers see are distinct surfaces; a product typically controls them independently (separate status values, separate visibility, optional sync between internal and external states).
- **Feedback is not planned work.** The feedback item accumulates evidence; the feature or roadmap entry carries the delivery lifecycle. Confusing the two loses either the demand record or the plan's integrity — products document this boundary explicitly.
- **Processing is a real state, not a ritual.** Raw feedback typically sits in an unprocessed state until an owner has mined and filed its demand; archived items usually remain countable evidence even though they leave the working views. Deletion is treated as exceptional because it destroys attribution history.
- **The loop is customer-visible by design.** Statuses, notifications, and changelogs make progress observable to the customers who asked. A status change on an item is typically an event that can reach the very customers whose demand it carries.
leaves.rules_zh:
- **归属是结构性的。** 每个条目和每次贡献都绑定到已识别的客户。贡献者自身的身份单独记录——规则是将反馈归属于其发起者，而非转达它的员工。无归属的聚合会将系统退化为匿名建议箱。
- **合并通常是一次的。** 整合条目会合并其历史和贡献者基础；产品通常不提供取消合并。审核者被期望有意地合并。
- **内部工作流和外部通信是可分离的。** 团队看到的内容和客户看到的内容是独立的界面；产品通常独立控制它们（独立的状态值、独立的可见性、内部和外部状态之间的可选同步）。
- **反馈不是计划工作。** 反馈条目积累证据；功能或路线图条目承载交付生命周期。混淆两者会丢失需求记录或计划的完整性——产品明确记录此边界。
- **处理是真实状态，而非仪式。** 原始反馈通常处于未处理状态，直到所有者挖掘并归档其需求；归档条目通常仍作为可计数的证据存在，尽管它们离开工作视图。删除被视为例外，因为它破坏归属历史。
- **循环按设计对客户可见。** 状态、通知和更新日志使进度对提出要求的客户可观察。条目上的状态变更通常是能够到达其承载需求的那些客户的事件。

leaves.name: Customer Health Monitoring
leaves.overview:
A **Customer Health Monitoring** application is a vendor-side system that maintains a standing, account-level measure of how each of the vendor's own customers is doing — a **health score or rating** — by aggregating multiple customer signals (product usage, support activity, satisfaction, engagement, commercial standing) through a customer-defined health definition, recomputing it on an ongoing cadence, and watching it against thresholds so that deteriorating accounts are classified and surfaced for attention.

The defining core is small:

```text
Monitored customer accounts (the vendor's own customers)
└── Health measure per account
    ├── produced by a customer-defined health definition
    │   └── aggregating multiple customer signals
    ├── recomputed on an ongoing cadence, retained as history
└── Monitoring loop
    └── thresholds/bands classify health and surface accounts needing attention
```

Everything else commonly associated with the category — weighted scoring machinery, segment-scoped health profiles, trend charts, portfolio consoles, automated alerts, CRM write-back — is standard capability that makes health monitoring practical, not what makes it health monitoring. A spreadsheet of accounts with usage, ticket, and survey columns, an agreed formula producing a red/yellow/green status per account, and a weekly review that flags the reds satisfies the same core; the definition does not depend on any modern platform packaging.

The Type is realized predominantly **inside customer success platforms**, where the health measure is the signal core of the wider customer-success workflow. What distinguishes it from its neighbors: a product usage platform *produces* the usage signal at event and user granularity; renewal management *consumes* health for the renewal decision; the customer success platform *operates the relationship workflow* around the customer. Health monitoring's own center is the health measure and its monitoring loop.
leaves.overview_zh:
一个**客户健康度监控**应用是一个供应商侧系统，它通过客户自定义的健康度定义，聚合多种客户信号（产品使用、支持活动、满意度、参与度、商业地位），持续重新计算并对照阈值进行监控，从而为供应商的每个客户维护一个持续的、账户级别的**健康度评分或评级**，以便将状况恶化的账户分类并呈现出来以供关注。

其定义性核心很小：

```text
被监控的客户账户（供应商自己的客户）
└── 每个账户的健康度度量
     ├── 由客户自定义的健康度定义生成
     │    └── 聚合多种客户信号
     ├── 按持续节奏重新计算，并保留为历史数据
└── 监控循环
     └── 阈值/区间对健康度进行分类，并呈现需要关注的账户
```

通常与该类别相关联的其他所有内容——加权评分机制、按细分范围划分的健康度配置文件、趋势图表、组合控制台、自动警报、CRM 回写——都是使健康度监控具有实用性的标准能力，而非使其成为健康度监控的本质。一份包含使用量、工单和调查列的账户电子表格，一个为每个账户生成红/黄/绿状态的商定公式，以及一个标记红色账户的每周审查，同样满足这一核心；该定义不依赖于任何现代平台包装。

该类型主要在**客户成功平台**内部实现，其中健康度度量是更广泛的客户成功工作流的信号核心。它与其相邻类型的区别在于：产品使用平台在事件和用户粒度上*产生*使用信号；续约管理*消费*健康度以进行续约决策；客户成功平台围绕客户*运营关系工作流*。健康度监控自身的中心是健康度度量及其监控循环。
leaves.dc:
**1. The monitored customer account population.** The system watches a standing population of identified customer accounts — the vendor's own customers, held as records (companies, or company relationships in products that manage partner/reseller structures). Every health value in the system is attributed to one account. Without the population there is nothing to monitor; the system collapses into generic analytics.

**2. The account-level health measure.** Each account carries a persistent health state — commonly a numeric score on a defined scale and/or a banded rating (a small set of classes such as good / average / poor, or healthy / at risk / neutral). Three properties make it a health measure rather than a metric:

- **It is defined, not measured.** An administrator configures a *health definition* — which signals feed it, how each signal is judged (criteria, ranges, weights), and how signals combine into the account-level result. The definition is a managed, inspectable artifact of the business, not a fixed formula.
- **It aggregates multiple signals.** The recurring signal families are product usage (logins, license utilization, usage depth), support (open tickets, resolution times, ticket age), satisfaction and sentiment (survey scores, CSM-assessed sentiment and, in some products, AI-derived conversation sentiment), engagement (recency of contact, stakeholder involvement), and commercial standing (billing status, contract value, product footprint). The mix is customer-defined; a definition built on a single signal is a degenerate case, not the norm.
- **It is alive.** Health is recomputed on an ongoing cadence as signals change, and past values are retained — current state plus history, so trend is a first-class question ("is this account getting better or worse?"), not an afterthought.

**3. The monitoring loop.** The health measure is continuously evaluated against configured thresholds or bands. The evaluation classifies each account (e.g., into good / average / poor) and makes adverse health *surface*: accounts in poor bands appear in at-risk views and segments, raise alerts, trigger tasks or playbook actions, and are diagnosed down to the signals that pulled the score down. The loop is what turns scoring into monitoring — without it, the system is a batch report generator.
leaves.dc_zh:
**1. 被监控的客户账户群体。** 系统监视一个固定的、已识别的客户账户群体——供应商自己的客户，作为记录保存（公司，或在管理合作伙伴/经销商结构的产品中的公司关系）。系统中的每个健康值都归属于一个账户。没有这个群体，就没有什么可监控的；系统会退化成通用分析。

**2. 账户级别的健康度量。** 每个账户都携带一个持久的健康状态——通常是一个定义好的刻度上的数值分数和/或一个分级评级（一小集合类别，如好/一般/差，或健康/风险/中性）。三个属性使其成为健康度量而不是指标：

- **它是定义的，而不是测量的**：管理员配置一个*健康定义*——哪些信号输入，每个信号如何被判断（标准、范围、权重），以及信号如何组合成账户级别的结果。定义是业务的管理可检视的工件，而不是固定公式。

- **它聚合多个信号**：常见的信号家族包括产品使用（登录、许可利用率、使用深度）、支持（未解决工单、解决时间、工单年龄）、满意度和情绪（调查分数、CSM评估的情绪，在某些产品中，AI推导的对话情绪）、参与度（最近联系、利益相关者参与度...）
leaves.rules:
- **Health is a managed definition, not a raw fact.** Two vendors — or two segments of the same vendor — can legitimately compute different health for the same observable behavior, because the definition encodes the business's judgment of what "doing well" means. The definition, not the number, is the artifact of record.
- **Bands carry an action convention.** The poor/at-risk band is not just a label: across the sampled products it is explicitly the "requires action" state. The monitoring loop is built around making that state impossible to miss.
- **Unclassified accounts exist.** An account that matches no health definition — or that has been cancelled — can sit in an explicit "unknown"/unclassified state. Mature configurations ensure a default definition catches everything else, and treat unknown health as a configuration problem to fix.
- **Manual inputs need protocol.** Subjective signals (owner sentiment) are legitimate health inputs but decay without discipline; products that support them pair them with expectations that owners keep them current.
- **Signal granularity matters.** Survey scores are typically collected per user; aggregating them to the account can mask the difference between a champion and a casual user. Usage events must be aggregated into account-level measures before they can feed health. These are known design pitfalls the products themselves document.
- **Definitions should be stable.** Frequent changes to health definitions undermine the team's ability to reason across time; changes are periodic, previewed, and often recalculated retroactively so history stays comparable.
- **Hierarchy health is derived.** Parent/child rollups are computed from child health by a chosen method; the parent's health is a view over its children, not an independently observed fact.
- **Health is an input, not the workflow.** The system classifies and surfaces; the response — the call, the save plan, the renewal negotiation — lives in the neighboring systems (customer success platform, CRM, renewal management).
leaves.rules_zh:
- **健康度是一个受管理的定义，而非原始事实。** 两个供应商——或同一供应商的两个细分——可以合法地为相同的可观察行为计算不同的健康度，因为定义编码了业务对“表现良好”含义的判断。定义，而非数字，是记录在案的产物。
- **区间携带行动约定。** 不良/风险区间不仅仅是一个标签：在采样的产品中，它明确是“需要行动”的状态。监控循环围绕使该状态不可能被忽视而构建。
- **存在未分类账户。** 一个不匹配任何健康度定义——或已被取消——的账户可以处于明确的“未知”/未分类状态。成熟的配置确保默认定义捕获其他所有内容，并将未知健康度视为需要修复的配置问题。
- **手动输入需要协议。** 主观信号（负责人情绪）是合法的健康度输入，但缺乏纪律就会衰减；支持它们的产品会将其与要求负责人保持其最新性的期望配对。
- **信号粒度很重要。** 调查分数通常按用户收集；将它们聚合到账户可能会掩盖倡导者与休闲用户之间的差异。使用事件必须在输入健康度之前被聚合为账户级度量。这些是产品本身记录在案的已知设计陷阱。
- **定义应保持稳定。** 频繁更改健康度定义会削弱团队跨时间推理的能力；更改是周期性的、经过预览的，并且通常回溯重新计算，以保持历史可比性。
- **层级健康度是派生的。** 父/子汇总通过选定方法从子健康度计算；父级的健康度是其子级的一个视图，而非独立...

leaves.name: Customer Identity / CIAM
leaves.overview:
A **Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM)** application is an identity platform operated by an organization for its own external end-customers — the consumers and business customers of the organization's digital products. It maintains a persistent population of customer identity records, lets customers **enroll and manage their own accounts without administrator involvement**, and **authenticates those customers on behalf of the organization's customer-facing applications**, which delegate sign-in to the platform and admit customers based on the sessions and tokens it issues.

The defining structure is small:

```text
External Customer Identity Population (separate from the workforce)
└── Self-service identity lifecycle
    (enroll → confirm → recover → manage one's own account)
└── Delegated authentication
    (apps register with the platform; sign-in is brokered; sessions/tokens are issued)
└── Organization-side administration
    (register apps, choose sign-in methods and flows, operate on accounts)
```

Everything else the market associates with CIAM — social login, multi-factor authentication, branded hosted sign-in pages, consent capture, bot protection, engagement analytics, usage-based pricing — is widespread in current products but is not part of the defining core. The legacy products of the previous product generation, and in-house account systems built before this category was productized, satisfy the core without any of those specifics.

When the identity population becomes organization-provisioned (employees), the product drifts toward workforce **Identity & Access Management**. When the platform stops administering identity and only evaluates account events for risk, it becomes **Account Abuse Protection**.
leaves.overview_zh:
一个**客户身份与访问管理（CIAM）** 应用，是一个由组织为其外部最终客户（即该组织数字产品的消费者与商业客户）运营的身份平台。它维护一个持久的客户身份记录库，让客户**无需管理员介入即可自行注册和管理账户**，并**代表组织的客户面向应用认证这些客户**，这些应用将登录委托给该平台，并根据平台签发的会话和令牌接纳客户。

其核心结构精简如下：

```text
外部客户身份群体（与员工群体分离）
└── 自助式身份生命周期
    （注册 → 确认 → 恢复 → 管理自身账户）
└── 委托认证
    （应用注册到平台；登录由平台协调；签发会话/令牌）
└── 组织侧管理
    （注册应用、选择登录方法和流程、操作账户）
```

市场上与CIAM相关联的其他一切功能——社交登录、多因素认证、品牌化托管登录页面、同意采集、机器人防护、互动分析、基于用量的定价——在现有产品中普遍具备，但并非其定义核心的一部分。前几代遗留产品，以及在该类别产品化之前构建的内部账户系统，满足了核心定义，而无需任何这些具体功能。

当身份群体变为组织配置时（即员工），产品会向员工**身份与访问管理**方向演变。当平台不再管理身份，而仅评估账户事件的风险时，它就变成了**账户滥用防护**。
leaves.dc:
- **External customer identity population** — persistent records for the organization's end-customers: identifiers, credentials or references to external identity providers, verified contact channels, and profile attributes. The population is kept separate from the workforce directory (some products make the separation a physically distinct directory/tenant; others a logically separate store). Without it, there is nothing to authenticate.
- **Self-service identity lifecycle** — the customer, not an administrator, drives the account's lifecycle: self-service enrollment with confirmation of a contact channel, self-service credential management and recovery, profile editing, and account deletion. Without this, the population becomes organization-provisioned and the product has become workforce IAM.
- **Delegated authentication** — the organization's customer-facing applications are registered with the platform and delegate sign-in to it. The platform verifies the customer — using its own credential checks or an identity the customer brings from an external provider — and issues the session or token through which the applications admit the customer. Without this, the product is a profile database, not access management.
- **Organization-side administration** — a control plane where the organization registers applications, chooses and configures sign-in methods and registration flows, manages branding and signing keys, and performs administrative operations on accounts (search, reset, block, delete). Administration here governs configuration and exceptions; it does not routinely provision the population.
leaves.dc_zh:
- **外部客户身份池** — 为组织的终端客户维护的持久化记录：包括标识符、凭证或对外部身份提供者的引用、经过验证的联系渠道以及个人资料属性。此身份池与员工目录保持分离（部分产品将其物理隔离为独立的目录/租户；另一部分则在逻辑上独立存储）。若缺乏此要素，将无身份可供认证。
- **自助身份生命周期** — 由客户（而非管理员）驱动其账户生命周期：通过联系渠道验证的自助注册、自助凭证管理与恢复、个人资料编辑以及账户删除。若缺失此特性，身份将变为组织统一配置，该产品也将退化为员工身份与访问管理（IAM）。
- **委托认证** — 组织的客户面向应用在平台注册，并将登录认证委托给平台处理。平台通过自身凭证检查或客户从外部身份提供者获取的身份进行验证，并颁发会话或令牌，应用凭此接纳客户访问。若不具备此能力，该产品仅为个人资料数据库，而非访问管理平台。
- **组织端管理** — 提供管控平面，供组织注册应用、选择并配置登录方式与注册流程。
leaves.rules:
### Credentials are brokered, never shared

Applications registered with the platform never see the customer's password. Authentication happens on the platform's surface (or through its APIs), and the application receives a session or token. This is the structural reason one identity can serve every application the organization operates.

### The verified channel anchors unassisted recovery

Self-service password recovery sends a code or link to a **verified** contact method. A customer without any verified channel generally cannot recover unassisted — products treat verification at enrollment as the guard against permanent lockout.

### Unconfirmed accounts do not sign in

A self-registered account typically exists in a pre-active state until its contact channel is confirmed. Products define explicit account states between "registered" and "active," and administrative confirmation is a documented alternative where organizations want human review of sign-ups.

### Federated identities shift factor ownership

When a customer authenticates through an external provider, credential and second-factor control belong to that provider. The platform maps the external identity to the customer record; locally enforced factors may not apply to federated sign-ins — a constraint products document explicitly.

### The organization governs the system, not the population

Administrators decide methods, flows, branding, and protection — and intervene on individual accounts only exceptionally (support, abuse, deletion requests). The absence of routine per-customer provisioning is the behavioral signature separating CIAM from workforce IAM.

### Consent is an access-adjacent record

Acceptance of terms/privacy policies captured at enrollment, and consent records maintained thereafter, are part of the identity record because the customer's agreement governs the use of their account and data. Depth varies by product and regulatory region.

### Built for an unassisted, high-volume audience

Defaults bend toward the audience: low-friction enrollment, brand-consistent surfaces, automated recovery, elastic scale, and protection that intervenes only when risk warrants it. Features that require an administrator's time are structurally de-emphasized.
leaves.rules_zh:
### 凭证被协调，永不共享
注册到平台的应用永远看不到客户的密码。认证在平台的界面（或通过其API）发生，应用接收一个会话或令牌。这是一个结构性原因，使一个身份能够为组织运营的每个应用服务。

### 已验证的渠道是无需协助恢复的锚点
自助式密码恢复向一个**已验证的**联系方法发送验证码或链接。没有任何已验证渠道的客户通常无法进行无需协助的恢复——产品将注册时的验证视为防止永久锁定的保障。

### 未确认的账户无法登录
自注册账户在联系渠道被确认之前，通常处于预激活状态。产品在“已注册”和“激活”之间定义了明确的账户状态，当组织希望人工审核注册时，管理确认是一种记录在案的替代方案。

### 联合身份转移因素所有权
当客户通过外部提供商认证时，凭证和第二因素控制权属于该提供商。平台将外部身份映射到客户记录；本地强制的因素可能不适用于联合登录——这是一个产品明确记录的限制。

### 组织治理系统，而非群体
管理员决定方法、流程、品牌和防护——并且只在特殊情况下（支持、滥用、删除请求）干预单个账户。缺乏常规的按客户配置，是将CIAM与员工IAM区分开来的行为特征。

### 同意是访问的邻接记录
在注册时采集的接受条款/隐私政策的同意记录，以及此后维护的同意记录，是

leaves.name: Customer Onboarding Platform
leaves.overview:
A **Customer Onboarding Platform** is vendor-side software for running one specific new customer's transition from closed deal to first value. Its unit of record is a per-customer onboarding engagement — a persistent, individually identified engagement that carries a structured plan of work, distributes that work across both the vendor's team and the customer's team, and tracks progress toward a defined completion: go-live, activation, or handoff to steady-state management.

The problem it solves is structural: onboarding a new B2B customer is a joint project. The vendor must configure, migrate, integrate, and train; the customer must supply data, make decisions, complete setup steps, and attend sessions. Neither side's work fits a private to-do list, and email-and-spreadsheet coordination loses track of who owes what. The platform holds the shared plan of work, makes each side's obligations visible and actionable, and records how the transition is progressing.

Boundary: the Type covers the managed transition engagement. It does not cover the ongoing management of the account after handoff (customer success territory), the measurement of product usage (product analytics territory), or guidance experiences deployed inside the vendor's own product UI (in-app onboarding tools, a different product family).
leaves.overview_zh:
一个**客户入职平台**是供应商侧的软件，用于执行特定新客户的从成交到首次产生价值的过渡过程。其记录单元是每位客户的入职参与——一个持久且可单独识别的参与过程，它承载结构化的工作计划，将该工作分配给供应商团队和客户团队，并追踪向既定完成目标（上线、激活或移交至稳态管理）的进展。

它解决的问题是结构性的：为新的B2B客户进行入职是一个联合项目。供应商必须配置、迁移、集成和培训；客户必须提供数据、做出决策、完成设置步骤并参加会话。任何一方的工作都不适合放在私人的待办事项列表中，而通过电子邮件和电子表格进行协调会失去对谁欠什么的追踪。该平台持有共享的工作计划，使每一方的义务可见且可操作，并记录过渡的进展情况。

边界：该类型涵盖受管理的过渡参与。它不包括移交后账户的持续管理（客户成功领域）、产品使用量的测量（产品分析领域），或部署在供应商自身产品UI内的引导体验（应用内入职工具，属于不同的产品族）。
leaves.dc:
```text
Customer
  └── Onboarding Engagement (one per customer transition)
        └── Plan of Work
              ├── Stages / Phases / Milestones
              └── Tasks (owner, status, dates, instructions)
                    ├── owned by vendor-side users
                    ├── owned by the customer (and sometimes third parties)
                    └── visibility-controlled per item
        └── Progression → defined completion (go-live / activation / handoff)
```

Four properties together make the Type recognizable. Remove any one and it becomes a different kind of software:

- **Per-customer engagement of record.** A persistent, named engagement for one specific customer, distinct from the account record itself. It exists to take that customer from signed to live. Without it, there is only account management.
- **Structured plan of work.** The engagement carries a plan organized as stages, phases, or milestones containing tasks; each task has an owner, a status, and dates. Without it, the engagement is a contact with notes.
- **Two-sided work distribution.** Tasks are owned by vendor-side users *and* by the customer — sometimes by third parties such as implementation partners. The customer is a tracked worker in the plan, not merely its subject. Without this, the software is an internal implementation project tracker.
- **Tracked progression to a defined completion.** Statuses and milestones roll up to an explicit end state — go-live, activation, first value, handoff. Without it, the plan is a checklist with no journey.
leaves.dc_zh:
客户
  └── 入职互动（每个客户过渡一次）
        └── 工作计划
              ├── 阶段/时期/里程碑
              └── 任务（负责人、状态、日期、说明）
                    ├── 由供应商侧用户拥有
                    ├── 由客户拥有（有时由第三方）
                    └── 每项可见性受控
        └── 进展 → 定义的完成（上线/激活/交接）
leaves.rules:
- **The customer is a worker, not an audience.** Customer-owned tasks carry the same structure as vendor tasks — owner, status, dates — and the plan cannot complete without them. Notifications, email/SMS status updates, and file-upload requests exist to make customer participation low-friction.
- **Visibility is per item, not per person.** The shared surface shows a curated subset: internal tasks, notes, and sensitive fields are hidden or name-only, while the shared plan stays honest about overall progress. This two-layer visibility is a structural behavior, not a cosmetic setting.
- **Dependencies gate the work.** A task becomes available when its predecessors complete; assignment notifications fire on unlock. The plan is a small state machine, and the onboarding manager's job is keeping it unblocked.
- **The engagement ends at a defined completion.** Go-live/activation/handoff is an explicit milestone; after it, the engagement is closed and the account continues in other systems (customer success, support). The engagement record remains as history.
- **Templates encode methodology; instances carry reality.** The template is the vendor's repeatable best practice; the per-customer instance diverges as reality demands — dates shift, tasks are added, phases are re-ordered — without breaking the link to what was planned.
- **Time tracking, where present, is primarily vendor-side effort capture.** Some products exclude customer and third-party assignees from logging time; portal-side time features vary by product.
leaves.rules_zh:
- **客户是工作者，而非受众。** 客户拥有的任务与供应商任务具有相同的结构——负责人、状态、日期——没有它们计划无法完成。通知、电子邮件/短信状态更新和文件上传请求的存在是为了使客户参与低摩擦。
- **可见性是逐项的，而非按人的。** 共享界面显示经过策划的子集：内部任务、备注和敏感字段被隐藏或仅显示名称，而共享计划保持对整体进度的诚实。这种双层可见性是结构性行为，而非表面设置。
- **依赖项门控工作。** 任务在其前置任务完成时变为可用；分配通知在解锁时触发。计划是一个小型状态机，入职经理的工作是保持其不被阻塞。
- **参与在既定完成时结束。** 上线/激活/移交是一个明确的里程碑；之后，参与关闭，账户在其他系统（客户成功、支持）中继续。参与记录保留为历史。
- **模板编码方法论；实例承载现实。** 模板是供应商可重复的最佳实践；每位客户的实例随现实需求而偏离——日期调整、任务添加、阶段重排——而不破坏与计划内容的链接。
- **时间追踪，若存在，主要是供应商侧的努力捕获。** 某些产品将客户和第三方负责人排除在时间记录之外；门户侧的时间功能因产品而异。

leaves.name: Customer Portal
leaves.overview:
A **Customer Portal** is an organization's authenticated, customer-facing surface where its own customers can see and manage their side of the relationship: one persistent place holding the customer's own records with the organization — purchases and orders, money and billing, entitlements and subscriptions, documents, requests, and profile — together with the ability to act on those records without going through staff.

The defining core is small:

```text
Identified customers of the organization
+ The customer's own account space (scoped, persistent view of their own records)
+ Self-service action on those records
```

The organization decides what appears in the space and which actions are allowed; the customer operates the surface. What fills the space varies with the business — an order history for a supplier, invoices and subscriptions for a software vendor, files and approvals for a service firm, cases and entitlements for a support-heavy business — but the structure is the same: a login-gated, per-customer window onto the relationship, built for the customer to use alone.

Everything else commonly associated with modern portals — knowledge bases, white-label branding, notifications, company-level views, in-portal purchasing, AI assistants — is widespread in current products but is not what makes the surface a customer portal.
leaves.overview_zh:
一个 **客户门户** 是一个组织经过认证的、面向客户的交互界面，其自身客户可以在此查看和管理与该组织关系中的自身一侧：这是一个持久化的空间，集中存放客户与该组织的自身记录——采购与订单、款项与账单、权益与订阅、文档、请求及个人资料——并提供了无需通过工作人员即可直接对这些记录进行操作的能力。

其定义的核心十分简洁：

```text
组织的已识别客户
+ 客户自身的账户空间（一个有范围限定的、持久化的视图，展示其自身记录）
+ 对这些记录的自助操作
```

由组织决定空间中显示哪些内容以及允许哪些操作；客户则操作这个界面。空间中填充的内容因业务而异——供应商的订单历史、软件供应商的发票与订阅、服务公司的文件与审批、支持密集型业务的案例与权益——但结构是相同的：一个需要登录、针对每个客户的窗口，用于查看双方关系，其设计目的是让客户能够单独使用。

现代门户通常关联的其他一切——知识库、白标品牌、通知、公司级视图、门户内采购、AI助手——在当今产品中普遍存在，但并非使该界面成为客户门户的核心要素。
leaves.dc: Every person in the portal is an identified customer of the organization, gated by an identity mechanism: a username and password, federated single sign-on, a passwordless flow, or — in some products — a lighter mechanism such as a secure link that identifies the recipient. Anonymous visitors and internal staff do not belong here; the public website and the internal systems are different surfaces. Identity is what makes everything else possible: the portal can only show a customer their own records because the customer is known.
leaves.dc_zh: 门户中的每个人都是组织的已识别客户，通过身份机制把关：用户名和密码、联合单点登录、无密码流程，或在某些产品中，更轻量的机制如识别接收者的安全链接。匿名访客和内部员工不属于此处；公共网站和内部系统是不同的界面。身份使得其他一切成为可能：门户只能向客户显示他们自己的记录，因为客户是已知的。
leaves.rules:
### Visibility is scoped, deliberately

A customer sees their own records — and, where configured, those of the customer organization they belong to. Company-level visibility is granted by the organization (sometimes with criteria for who in the account may see it), never inferred. No customer ever sees another customer's records.

### The customer sees a projection, not the operation

Internal handling detail — assignments, internal notes, internal statuses, internal email — never appears. Organizations keep internal discussion out of the customer-visible conversation deliberately (separate internal notes, filtering rules). The customer-side status is a curated view of the record's state.

### Actions are curated

Every action available in the portal exists because the organization enabled it: which record types can be acted on, which actions, under which conditions (for example, whether a closed request may be reopened, or whether a customer may close their own request). The customer's power is real but bounded by configuration.

### Identity gates everything personal

Nothing personal is visible before the customer is identified. The mechanism varies — full accounts, federated sign-on, passwordless flows, secure links — but the gate is always there. Some organizations restrict access to specific groups of customers; some let anyone with a relationship self-register.

### The portal and the back office stay coherent

What the customer does in the portal lands in the organization's systems (a submitted request becomes a case; a payment posts to the account; a message logs against the customer's record), and what the organization records surfaces in the portal. The two sides work on the same relationship, from their own surfaces.

### Sensitive data can be deliberately withheld

Organizations can exclude sensitive content from the portal surface even when it exists in their systems — a structural reminder that the portal shows a curated subset of the relationship, chosen for what the customer should handle directly.
leaves.rules_zh:
### 可见性是有范围限定的，这是有意为之

客户只能看到其自身的记录——在配置允许的情况下，也可以看到其所属客户组织的记录。公司级别的可见性由组织授予（有时会限定账户中谁可以看到），绝不会被推断出来。任何客户都绝不会看到其他客户的记录。

### 客户看到的是投影，而非实际操作

内部处理细节——任务分配、内部备注、内部状态、内部邮件——永不出现在客户界面。组织会有意地将内部讨论与客户可见的对话分开（通过独立的内部备注、过滤规则）。客户侧的状态是对记录状态的一种策划后视图。

### 操作是经过策划的

门户中提供的每一项操作都存在，是因为组织启用了它：哪些记录类型可以操作、可以执行哪些操作、在哪些条件下（例如，已关闭的请求是否可以重新打开，或者客户是否可以关闭自己的请求）。客户的权限是真实的，但受到配置的约束。

### 身份验证是访问所有个人信息的门禁

在客户身份未被识别之前，任何个人信息都是不可见的。实现机制各不相同——完整账户、联合登录、无密码流程、安全链接——但这道门禁始终存在。有些组织将访问权限制在特定的客户群体；有些则允许任何有业务关系的人自行注册。

### 门户与后台办公系统保持数据一致

客户在门户中的操作会同步到组织系统中（提交的请求会生成一个案例；支付会记入账户；消息会记录到客户档案中），而组织记录的信息也会在门户中呈现。双方基于各自的交互界面，围绕同一份关系数据协同工作。

### 敏感数据可以被有意地

leaves.name: Customer Relationship Management / CRM
leaves.overview:
A **Customer Relationship Management (CRM) application** is a selling organization's shared system of record for its customer and prospect relationships. It holds persistent records of the people and organizations the organization does business with — or wants to — attaches a cumulative history of interactions to those records, and manages the commercial progression toward outcomes: deals moving through pipeline stages toward closed-won or closed-lost.

The defining core is deliberately small: relationship records, interaction history, and managed commercial progression, worked as shared organizational records rather than personal address-book entries. Everything else commonly associated with CRMs — lead objects, forecasting dashboards, email integration, custom objects, AI assistance, whole marketing and service suites — is widely supported by mature products but is not what makes a CRM a CRM. A paper-era sales office (card file of contacts, client folders, correspondence log, forecast board) already contains this core.

When the working center shifts to stewarding standing customer organizations rather than the acquisition-to-close selling motion, the product is drifting toward the Account Management CRM Type; when only the deals remain, toward Sales Pipeline Management; when the records serve service recovery rather than commercial progression, toward customer service Types.
leaves.overview_zh:
一个**客户关系管理（CRM）应用**是销售组织用于记录其客户与潜在客户关系的共享系统。它保存着该组织正在或希望与之开展业务往来的人员与组织的持久化记录，为这些记录附加累积的互动历史，并管理通向商业结果的进展过程：交易在管道阶段中推进，直至达成成交（closed-won）或流失（closed-lost）。

其定义性核心被刻意保持精简：关系记录、互动历史以及受管理的商业进展，这些作为共享的组织记录而非个人通讯录条目来运作。通常与CRM关联的其他功能——如线索对象、预测仪表盘、邮件集成、自定义对象、AI辅助、完整的营销与服务套件——虽被成熟产品广泛支持，但并非构成CRM本质的要素。一个纸质时代的销售办公室（联系人卡片档案、客户文件夹、往来信函日志、预测看板）已然包含这一核心。

当工作重心从获取至成交的销售动作转向维护长期客户组织时，该产品便向账户管理CRM类型漂移；当仅保留交易时，则向销售管道管理漂移；当记录服务于服务恢复而非商业进展时，则向客户服务类型漂移。
leaves.dc:
```text
Selling organization
└── Relationship records
    ├── Person records (contacts)
    ├── Organization records (accounts / companies)
    │     └── associations bind persons ↔ organizations ↔ deals,
    │         often with labeled roles (e.g. decision maker)
    ├── Interaction history on every record
    │     (calls, emails, meetings, notes, tasks — the record's timeline)
    └── Shared working
        (ownership, assignment, permission-scoped visibility, dedup/merge)
        └── Managed commercial progression
            └── Deal / opportunity (value, owner, expected close)
                └── Pipeline = ordered, customer-defined stages
                    └── open stages → closed-won / closed-lost
```

Four structures. If any one is removed, the product stops being recognizable as a CRM:

- **Relationship records of record** — persistent, individually identified records for people (contacts) and organizations (accounts or companies) the organization has or pursues commercial relationships with. Records carry their own profile fields and unique identifiers, and are held by the organization: owned, assignable, permission-scoped. Without this, the product is a personal address book or a directory.
- **Cumulative interaction history** — every touch (call, email, meeting, note, task) is recorded against the relationship as a durable timeline. This history is why the record has value: it is the organization's memory of the relationship, surviving personnel change. Without it, the system is a contact list with no relationship memory.
- **Managed commercial progression** — the deal (or opportunity): a trackable potential outcome with a value, an owner, and an expected close, moving through the stages of a pipeline until it closes as won or lost. This is the structure that connects the relationship records to the organization's revenue motion. Without it, the product is a contact/account book, not a CRM.
- **Shared working over the records** — the records are worked collaboratively: each has an owner, visibility follows permission rules, duplicates are found and merged, and records move between people as circumstances change. Without it, the product is single-person contact software.
leaves.dc_zh:
销售组织
└── 关系记录
    ├── 人员记录（联系人）
    ├── 组织记录（客户/公司）
    │     └── 关联关系连接人员 ↔ 组织 ↔ 交易，
    │         通常带有角色标签（例如决策者）
    ├── 每条记录的交互历史
    │     （通话、邮件、会议、笔记、任务——记录的时间线）
    └── 共同协作
        （所有权、分配、基于权限的可见性、去重/合并）
        └── 管理商业化进程
            └── 交易/商机（金额、所有者、预计成交时间）
                └── 销售管道 = 有序的、客户自定义阶段
                    └── 开放阶段 → 赢单/丢单
leaves.rules:
- **Ownership governs work.** Records and deals have owners; most day-to-day work happens on records a user owns or is granted access to. Visibility and edit rights follow role/team structures, and enterprise implementations expose record-level sharing (grant/modify/revoke access) as first-class machinery.
- **The pipeline's stages are configuration, not constants.** Stage names, order, and count are defined per organization (and an organization can run several parallel pipelines — new sales and renewals, for instance). The only fixed points in observed products are the terminal outcomes: won and lost.
- **Closed is a real state.** A deal that closes as won or lost leaves the open pipeline; forecasting counts open deals. Lost deals can typically be reopened, and stage regression is either allowed, flagged, or restricted depending on the product's rules.
- **Deduplication protects the record.** Because the record is the system of record, duplicate persons/organizations are treated as defects: products detect likely duplicates (using key identifiers) and provide merge machinery that consolidates them without losing history.
- **History is additive, not a scratchpad.** Logged interactions accumulate as a timeline; the expected behavior is that anyone stepping onto the record can reconstruct the relationship from it.
- **Records outlive relationships' active phases.** Ended relationships are typically deactivated rather than deleted, preserving history and reporting integrity.
- **Contact governance lives on the record.** Suppression-style flags (do not email / do not call) can be recorded against the person or organization and are respected by outbound actions — an organizational rule, not merely a setting.
leaves.rules_zh:
- **所有权支配工作。** 记录与交易均有负责人；日常大部分工作发生在用户拥有或被授予访问权限的记录上。可见性与编辑权限遵循角色/团队结构，企业级实现将记录级共享（授予/修改/撤销访问）作为一等机制暴露。
- **管道阶段是配置，而非常量。** 阶段名称、顺序与数量按组织定义（一个组织可运行多个并行管道——例如新销售与续约）。在观察到的产品中，唯一固定的点是最终结果：成交与流失。
- **关闭是真实状态。** 以成交或流失关闭的交易离开开放管道；预测统计开放交易。流失交易通常可重新开启，阶段回退则依产品规则被允许、标记或限制。
- **去重保护记录。** 因记录是系统记录源，重复的人员/组织被视为缺陷：产品检测可能的重复项（使用关键标识符）并提供合并机制，在不丢失历史的前提下整合它们。
- **历史是累加的，而非草稿纸。** 记录的互动累积为时间线；预期行为是任何接手该记录者均可从中重建关系。
- **记录存续于关系活跃期之后。** 结束的关系通常被停用而非删除，以保留历史与报告完整性。
- **联系人治理存在于记录上。** 抑制类标记（勿发邮件/勿致电）可记录在人员或组织上，并被出站动作遵守——这是一项组织规则，而非单纯设置。

leaves.name: Customer Service Chatbot Platform
leaves.name_zh: 客户服务聊天机器人平台
leaves.overview:
A **Customer Service Chatbot Platform** is the business-side system for operating automated conversational agents — chatbots — that conduct customer service conversations on the business's digital channels. The platform lets a service organization author and publish a bot that carries its knowledge, policies, and persona; run that bot in live conversations with customers; resolve what the bot can on its own; and hand everything else to human service with full context.

The defining structure is small:

```text
Business-operated service bot
└── Customer service conversation (the unit of work)
    └── Managed bot ↔ human service seam
        (handoff with context · intervention · push-back · measured split)
```

Everything else commonly associated with these products — knowledge grounding, multi-channel deployment, pre-deploy testing, automation analytics, per-resolution pricing, AI disclosure controls — is standard capability of mature products, not what makes the product a chatbot platform. Older, pre-LLM dialog-tree bots and regional messaging-app bots fit the same definition without any of the modern AI machinery.

When the automation disappears and human agents conduct the conversations, the product is a customer support chat tool. When the record — not the conversation — is the center, it is a help desk. When the medium is the phone with designed voice flows, it is an IVR platform. When the deliverable is a grounded answer rather than a managed conversation, it is a knowledge question-answering application.
leaves.overview_zh:
一个**客户服务聊天机器人平台**是业务端系统，用于操作自动化对话代理——聊天机器人——在企业数字渠道上进行客户服务对话。该平台允许服务组织创建和发布一个承载其知识、政策和人格的机器人；在与客户的实时对话中运行该机器人；机器人自行解决其能解决的问题；并将所有其他问题连同完整上下文交给人工服务。

定义结构很小：

```text
企业运营的服务机器人
└── 客户服务对话（工作单元）
    └── 受管机器人 ↔ 人工服务接口
        （上下文交接 · 干预 · 回退 · 可度量的分工）
```

所有其他与这些产品常见关联的功能——知识接地、多渠道部署、部署前测试、自动化分析、按解决定价、AI披露控制——是成熟产品的标准能力，而非使该产品成为聊天机器人平台的关键。较旧的、前LLM对话树机器人和区域性消息应用机器人符合相同定义，无需任何现代AI机制。

当自动化消失而人工代理进行对话时，该产品是客户支持聊天工具。当记录——而非对话——是中心时，它是帮助台。当媒介是带有设计语音流程的电话时，它是IVR平台。当交付物是接地答案而非受管对话时，它是知识问答应用。
leaves.dc:
Three structures, held together. Remove any one and the product stops being recognizable as this Type.
