Journal-ready output feeds the corporate general ledger — the platform produces investment books; it does not replace the corporate ledger.

### Everything is attributable

Actions on the record — decisions, orders, checks, settlements, entries — are logged with attribution. The audit trail is a first-class output, positioned for regulator and auditor questions.

### Access follows role

Surfaces and actions are scoped by role: portfolio teams see and do portfolio things, traders trade, compliance governs, operations settle, accountants close. Approval workflows and versioning govern changes to critical configurations.

### The platform ends at its edges

Custodians hold the assets, brokers execute, the corporate GL holds the firm's full ledger, fund administrators may hold official fund books. The platform integrates with all of them and remains the investment organization's own operating record in between.
leaves.rules_zh:
### 一个记录，一个数字

平台的中心行为规则：每个功能从同一记录工作，因此同一头寸或现金余额的冲突版本是要通过工程消除的缺陷，而非需要事后协调的正常状态。当维护不同的账簿时（投资与会计视图），它们在平台内保持协调，而非跨系统边界。

### 合规门控流程

预期活动在生效前针对编码规则进行测试——交易前在订单点检查是标准模式——完成活动之后再次测试。违规作为带文档化解决的受管异常浮现，而非静默通过。

### 账簿必须关闭

会计环节以每个所需基础产生结果并具有完全可追溯性；头寸、现金、交易和估值的协调是持续的控制活动，差异作为异常处理。日记账就绪输出馈送公司总账——平台生成投资账簿；它不替代公司总账。

### 一切都可归因

记录上的操作——决策、订单、检查、结算、分录——都带有归因地记录。审计线索是一流输出，针对监管机构和审计师的问题而定位。

### 访问跟随角色

界面和操作按角色限定范围：投资组合团队查看和执行投资组合事务，交易员交易，合规治理，运营结算，会计师结账。审批工作流和版本控制管理关键配置的更改。

### 平台在其边缘结束

托管人持有资产，经纪人执行，公司总账持有公司的完整账簿，基金行政可能持有官方基金账簿。平台与外部系统集成。

leaves.name: Investment Research Platform
leaves.overview:
An **Investment Research Platform** is an investor's research workspace: it maintains a continuously updated body of research material about investable subjects — companies, securities, funds — and provides the machinery an investor uses to interrogate that material: finding information across the corpus, monitoring subjects for new developments, and capturing the work into their own research output.

The defining structure is small:

```text
Identified investable subjects (issuers / securities / funds)
└── Maintained research corpus bound to those subjects
    ├── primary issuer documents (filings, earnings-call transcripts, IR material)
    ├── structured financial data (fundamentals, estimates)
    └── professional analysis (broker research, expert calls, contributor analysis)
└── Research interrogation loop
    ├── find (search and screening across the corpus)
    ├── monitor (subjects and saved queries for new material)
    └── capture / synthesize (watchlists, saved queries, models, exports, deliverables)
└── Informational-only posture (no order execution, no custody)
```

Everything else commonly associated with these products — AI question-answering, valuation model builders, expert-call networks, licensed broker research, brokerage-account connections, office add-ins, APIs — is widespread in current products but is not what makes the product an investment research platform. Older, pre-AI research databases and differently positioned products fit the same definition without any of those specifics.

When the center of gravity shifts to a live-data workspace organized around instruments and functions, the product is a Financial Market Data Terminal; when it shifts to a platform-edited content stream for a broad audience, it is a Financial News & Research Platform; when it adds accounts and order routing, it becomes a Brokerage or Trading Platform.
leaves.overview_zh:
**投资研究平台**是投资者的研究工作空间：它持续更新关于可投资标的——公司、证券、基金——的研究资料库，并提供投资者用于查询这些资料库的机制：在资料库中搜索信息、监控标的动态，并将工作成果整合为自己的研究报告。

其核心结构较为简洁：

```text
已识别的可投资标的（发行人/证券/基金）
└── 绑定至这些标的的维护研究资料库
    ├── 主要发行人文件（备案文件、财报电话会议记录、投资者关系材料）
    ├── 结构化财务数据（基本面、预测）
    └── 专业分析（经纪商研究、专家访谈、贡献者分析）
└── 研究查询循环
    ├── 查找（在资料库中搜索和筛选）
    ├── 监控（标的与已保存查询的更新内容）
    └── 记录/整合（关注列表、已保存查询、模型、导出内容、交付物）
└── 纯信息立场（不涉及订单执行、不托管资产）
```

这些产品通常包含的其他功能——AI问答、估值模型构建器、专家访谈网络、授权经纪商研究、券商账户连接、办公软件插件、API——在当前产品中普遍存在，但它们并非构成投资研究平台的核心要素。早期、前AI时期的研究数据库，以及定位不同的产品，即使没有这些特定功能，也符合上述定义。

当重心转向以工具和功能组织的实时数据工作空间时，该产品即成为**金融市场数据终端**；当转向面向广泛受众的平台编辑内容流时，即成为**财经新闻与研究平台**；当增加账户与订单路由功能时，则演变为**券商或交易平台**。
leaves.dc:
### One Structure, Many Implementations

The Core Model is written in conceptual terms. Products realize each concept differently:

```text
Concept:          Maintained research corpus
Implementations:  licensed third-party data + aggregated filings/transcripts,
                  proprietary extraction pipelines audited to source documents,
                  licensed broker research, expert-network transcripts,
                  contributor-written analysis

Concept:          Find machinery
Implementations:  keyword/document search, natural-language generative search,
                  criteria screeners, saved screen libraries

Concept:          Monitor machinery
Implementations:  email alerts on saved queries, watchlist event feeds,
                  dashboards of information streams, brokerage-connected holdings display

Concept:          Capture / synthesis
Implementations:  saved valuation models, in-platform dashboards,
                  spreadsheet exports, office add-ins, AI-drafted reports and decks
```

A reader who encounters only one implementation (say, an AI-search enterprise platform) should still be able to recognize a data-first prosumer terminal or a consumer research community as the same Type from the Core Model.
leaves.dc_zh:
### 一种结构，多种实现

核心模型以概念性术语编写。产品以不同方式实现每个概念：

```text
概念：          维护的研究语料库
实现：          许可的第三方数据 + 聚合的备案/记录，
                  专有的提取管道，审计至源文档，
                  许可的经纪人研究，专家网络记录，
                  贡献者撰写的分析

概念：          查找机制
实现：          关键词/文档搜索，自然语言生成搜索，
                  标准筛选器，保存的筛选库

概念：          监控机制
实现：          保存查询的电子邮件警报，监视列表事件源，
                  信息流仪表板，连接经纪商的持仓显示

概念：          捕获 / 综合
实现：          保存的估值模型，平台内仪表板，
                  电子表格导出，Office插件，AI起草的报告和演示文稿
```

一个只遇到一种实现（例如，AI搜索企业平台）的读者，仍然应该能够从核心模型识别出数据优先的专业终端或消费者研究社区是同一类型。
leaves.rules:
### The corpus keeps moving

New issuer material (filings, transcripts, presentations) enters the corpus as it is published, and analysis accumulates continuously. Update speed is a competitive dimension — some products emphasize near-real-time ingestion of new filings — but the structural rule is simpler: the corpus is current, and monitoring exists precisely because it changes.

### Provenance is visible and load-bearing

Research material is either licensed from third-party data providers, aggregated from issuers, or extracted from source documents by the platform. Mature products make provenance a feature: data linked or auditable to source documents, AI answers with citations, licensed content attributed. The user is expected to be able to trace a number or a claim back to its origin.

### Access is gated by entitlement

The corpus and tooling are subscription-gated; different tiers expose different depth (history length, exports, events, seats). Enterprise products add usage metering and organization-level access. What is gated is depth and breadth of the same corpus, not a different product.

### Informational-only by design

The platform takes no orders and holds no custody. Where it connects to brokerage accounts, the connection is for display and monitoring. This is a structural boundary, not a missing feature.

### AI outputs are positioned as grounded

Where AI answers or drafts deliverables, products emphasize grounding in the corpus with citations — because in this domain an untraceable claim is worthless. The AI layer changes the delivery of research, not the ownership of the corpus or the loop.
leaves.rules_zh:
### 资料库持续更新

新的发行人材料（备案文件、会议记录、演示文稿）在发布后即进入资料库，分析内容也持续积累。更新速度是竞争维度之一——部分产品强调近乎实时地接收新备案文件——但其结构规则更为简单：资料库必须保持最新，而监控功能的存在正是为了应对其变化。

### 溯源性清晰可见且至关重要

研究资料要么来自第三方数据提供商的授权许可，要么从发行人处聚合，要么由平台从源文件中提取。成熟的产品将溯源性作为一项特色功能：数据链接至或可审计至源文件，AI回答附带引用，授权内容明确标注。用户应能追溯数字或主张的原始出处。

### 访问权限受授权等级控制

资料库和工具通过订阅进行权限控制；不同的层级提供不同的深度（历史时长、导出功能、事件数据、席位数量）。企业级产品还增加用量计量和组织级访问控制。受控的是同一资料库的深度和广度，而非不同的产品。

### 设计上属于纯信息平台

本平台不执行订单，不托管资产。当它连接券商账户时，连接仅用于显示和监控。这是一条结构性边界，而非缺失的功能。

### AI输出被定位为基于资料库的

在AI回答或草拟交付物的地方，产品强调基于资料库并附带引用——因为在这个领域，无法追溯来源的主张毫无价值。AI层改变了研究的呈现方式，而非资料库的所有权或查询循环。

leaves.name: Investor Portal
leaves.overview:
An **Investor Portal** is a permissioned, sponsor-operated online surface through which the investors in private investment vehicles — funds, deals, and other pooled vehicles — access their own investment records: their positions, their statements and notices, the manager's reports and documents, and the actions those items require of them.

The defining structure is small:

```text
Sponsor / Administrator (manager side, systems of record)
└── publishes content and sets access
    └── Investor Portal (permissioned delivery surface)
        └── per-investor scoped view
            ├── the investor's own positions across the vehicles they hold
            ├── the documents and notices published for that investor
            └── the actions those items require (sign, fund, update own details)
```

Four properties hold across the Type:

- **Authenticated external investors** — investors are outside parties who log in to a system operated by the manager side. They are guests of the sponsor's environment, not its staff.
- **Per-investor scoped investment view** — each investor sees only their own positions across the vehicles they hold.
- **Operator-published documents and reports** — statements, notices, reports, and tax documents are produced by the manager side and delivered through the same surface.
- **Operator-controlled publication and access** — the sponsor or its administrator decides what each investor sees, when it becomes visible, and who on the team may publish.

The portal does **not** keep the books. The official records — fund ledgers, NAVs, investor capital accounts, ownership registers — live in accounting, administration, and registry systems. The portal is the standing, permissioned window between those records and the investor. When the dominant center shifts to maintaining the records themselves, the product has moved into Fund Administration, Cap Table Management, or Transfer Agency; when the record owner flips to the investor's own side, it has moved into the investor-side platform family.
leaves.overview_zh:
投资者门户是经许可、由赞助商运营的在线平台，投资者通过该平台访问其在私人投资工具（基金、交易和其他集合投资工具）中的投资记录：持仓情况、报表与通知、管理人的报告与文件，以及这些材料所要求的行动。

其核心结构较为精简：

```text
赞助商/管理员（管理人一方，记录系统）
└── 发布内容并设置访问权限
    └── 投资者门户（经许可的交付平台）
        └── 按投资者划分的视图
            ├── 投资者持有的各类工具中的自身持仓
            ├── 为该投资者发布的文件与通知
            └── 这些材料所要求的行动（签署、缴款、更新个人信息）
```

该类型贯穿四项关键属性：

- **经认证的外部投资者** — 投资者为外部方，登录管理人运营的系统。他们是赞助商环境中的访客，而非其员工。
- **按投资者划分的投资视图** — 每位投资者仅能看到自身在所持工具中的持仓情况。
- **运营方发布的文件与报告** — 财务报表、通知、报告和税务文件由管理人一方生成，并通过同一平台交付。
- **运营方控制的发布与访问** — 赞助商或其管理员决定每位投资者查看的内容、可见时间以及团队中何人有权发布。

该门户**不**负责记账。官方记录——基金台账、净资产值、投资者资本账户、所有权登记册——存储于会计、管理和注册系统中。门户是这些记录与投资者之间的常态化、经许可的窗口。当产品重心转向维护记录本身时，它就进入了基金管理、股权表管理或过户代理领域；若记录所有者转为投资者自身一方，则它属于投资者端平台系列。
leaves.dc:
- **Statements and notices machinery** — generation and delivery of capital call, distribution, and contribution notices; capital account statements; NAV statements where the regime calls for them; fee notices; personalized summaries; asset reports
- **Performance reporting** — fund-level performance, cash flows, valuations, and in several products asset-level metrics
- **Secure document repository** — role-based access, reviewer workflows before documents reach investors, per-investor scoping of everything
- **Investor self-service data maintenance** — contact details, banking and payment instructions (commonly with operator-side verification or secondary approval before changes take effect), tax and regulatory documents (FATCA, AML/KYC), communication and delivery preferences
- **Onboarding** — invitation and account activation, subscription document handling (delivery of the documents; in some products electronic signature in the portal), subscribing to new funds or vehicles
- **White-label presentation** — investors see the sponsor's brand, not the portal vendor's
- **Notification and engagement tracking** — investors are notified of new content; the operator can see logins, document views, and other engagement signals
- **Back-office publishing console** — content preparation, permission configuration, and publishing controls on the manager side, connected to the systems of record so portal figures reconcile to the books
leaves.dc_zh: 为基金管理人与投资者之间提供安全交互的在线平台，核心功能涵盖投资人沟通、文档交付、数据服务及后台管理。其本质是作为投资人关系管理（IRM）与客户服务的数字化中枢，集中实现投资人沟通、文件管理、数据自助服务、合规处理、流程自动化与品牌化呈现，并整合后台管理控制台，以提升运营效率、透明度与投资人体验。
leaves.rules:
### Per-investor scoping is access control

Every position, document, and notice is scoped to the specific investor it belongs to. Role-based access determines that each investor sees only their own materials, and entity investors see only what their role entitles them to. This is the portal's security spine and its reason for existing: it replaces email attachments with a controlled, auditable channel.

### The operator, not the system, decides visibility

Across the researched sample, publication timing and audience are operator-controlled: content is prepared in the back office and released deliberately — staged until an explicit publish act in some products, released when finalized from accounting in others. Nothing investor-visible exists without an operator decision behind it.

### The portal mirrors records kept elsewhere

Positions, balances, and statement figures originate in the sponsor's accounting and administration systems; the portal is a delivery surface onto them. Mature products emphasize that portal content flows from, or is produced by, the same records — not re-keyed into a parallel system — so that what the investor sees reconciles to the books.

### Sensitive investor actions are verified

Changes with payment or compliance consequences — banking and payment instructions, tax and regulatory documents — are commonly subject to verification or secondary approval before taking effect, protecting both sides against fraud and error.

### Distribution replaces a manual, error-prone process

The portal's value case is the replacement of mailed and emailed packages: documents are generated from records, delivered scoped and branded, and their delivery is tracked. Operator-side engagement analytics (who logged in, what was viewed) are a structural feature of this channel, not an afterthought — and they mean visibility flows asymmetrically: the operator can see investor engagement; investors see only their own content.
leaves.rules_zh:
### 按投资者划分的范围即访问控制

每项持仓、文件和通知都限定于其所属的具体投资者。基于角色的访问控制确保每位投资者仅能查看自己的材料，而机构投资者仅能查看其角色权限内的内容。这是门户的安全支柱和存在理由：它用一个受控、可审计的渠道取代了电子邮件附件。

### 可见性由运营方而非系统决定

在所研究的样本中，发布时机和受众均由运营方控制：内容在后台准备后有目的地发布——在一些产品中分阶段存放，直至明确执行发布操作；在另一些产品中，会计定稿后即发布。任何对投资者可见的内容，其背后都有运营方的决策。

### 门户镜像存储于他处的记录

持仓、余额和财务报表数据源自赞助商的会计和管理系统；门户是其交付平台。成熟产品强调门户内容来自或由同一记录生成，而非重新录入一个并行系统，从而确保投资者所见与账簿一致。

### 敏感的投资者行动需经验证

涉及付款或合规后果的变更——银行及付款指令、税务和监管文件——通常需经过验证或二次批准后方可生效，以保护双方免受欺诈和错误影响。

### 分发取代了人工、易出错的流程

门户的价值在于取代通过邮寄和电子邮件发送的文件包：文件从记录生成，经限定范围和品牌定制后交付，并且交付过程可追踪。运营方的参与度分析（谁登录了、查看了什么）是一个结构性特征。

leaves.name: Invoice Processing Platform
leaves.overview:
An **Invoice Processing Platform** is the finance back-office application that carries an organization's **inbound supplier invoices** from arrival to accounting: it receives invoice documents that come in from outside (email, scan, portal, EDI or e-invoicing network), converts them into structured invoice records, validates them against the organization's own business context, routes them through coding and approval, and releases them to the ERP or accounting system as accounting-ready, approved records — retaining the invoice and everything that happened to it as the auditable trail.

It solves a specific operational problem: companies receive large volumes of invoices from many suppliers in many formats, and every one of them must be turned into a valid, correctly coded, authorized liability record before it can affect the books. Doing this by hand is slow, error-prone, and hard to audit; the platform makes the document pipeline itself a managed, governed process.

The defining core is small:

```text
Inbound supplier invoice (a document received from a supplier)
└── Captured into a structured invoice record
    └── Validated against the organization's business context
        └── Routed and approved under the organization's own rules
            └── Released as accounting-ready, coded data into the financial system
                └── with the invoice and its processing history retained
```

The defining scope **ends at the accounting-ready handoff**. Paying the invoice is not part of invoice processing: across the market, payment execution is either absent, deliberately externalized to whatever payment system the company chooses, or sold as a separate module. Once the validated, approved invoice reaches the financial system, the processing job is done — downstream posting cycles and payment runs belong to the broader accounts-payable process.

What the platform is not: it does not *generate* invoices (that is the mirror-image invoicing/billing side, where the company bills customers); it does not create purchase orders (it consumes them for matching); and it is not a generic document-approval tool (the invoice object, the validation machinery, and the accounting consequence are the point).
leaves.overview_zh:
一个**发票处理平台**是财务后台应用程序，负责将组织的**入站供应商发票**从接收传递到会计环节：它接收来自外部的发票文件（通过电子邮件、扫描、门户、EDI或电子发票网络），将其转换为结构化的发票记录，根据组织自身的业务背景进行验证，通过编码和审批流程进行路由，并将它们作为会计就绪、已批准的记录发布到ERP或会计系统中——同时保留发票及其处理过程中的所有信息作为可审计的轨迹。

它解决了一个具体的运营问题：公司从众多供应商那里收到大量不同格式的发票，每一份发票在影响账簿之前，都必须转化为有效、编码正确且经过授权的负债记录。手动执行这一过程速度慢、易出错且难以审计；该平台使文档处理流程本身成为一个受管理和受治理的过程。

其定义性的核心很小：

```text
入站供应商发票（从供应商处接收的文件）
└── 捕获为结构化发票记录
     └── 根据组织的业务背景进行验证
         └── 根据组织自身的规则进行路由和审批
             └── 作为会计就绪、已编码的数据发布到财务系统
                 └── 同时保留发票及其处理历史
```

定义性的范围**在会计就绪的交接处结束**。支付发票不属于发票处理的一部分：在整个市场中，支付执行要么缺失，要么被刻意外部化到公司选择的任何支付系统，要么作为独立模块出售。一旦经过验证和批准的发票到达财务系统，处理工作即告完成——下游的过账周期和支付运行属于更广泛的应付账款流程。

该平台不是什么：它不*生成*发票（那是镜像般的开票/计费端，即公司向客户开票）；它不创建采购订单（它消费采购订单以进行匹配）；它也不是通用的文档审批工具（发票对象、验证机制和会计后果才是重点）。
leaves.dc:
- **Multi-channel intake** — dedicated email addresses, drag-and-drop upload, mobile capture, scanners, supplier portals, EDI and e-invoicing connections, all normalized into one workflow.
- **Intelligent extraction** — AI/ML-based reading of arbitrary layouts (the historical alternative was per-supplier templates), with a human validation surface showing the document beside the extracted fields, and the system learning from corrections.
- **Supplier resolution** — matching extracted supplier data to the vendor master, typically pulled from the ERP.
- **Duplicate and fraud detection** — algorithms flag suspected duplicates for human inspection alongside the originals; anomaly checks run before data enters downstream systems.
- **PO and receipt matching** — comparing invoice lines against purchase orders, goods receipts, and sometimes contracts at line or header level, with tolerance rules; non-PO invoices (rent, utilities, recurring services) are handled as a first-class path, often learned as recurring.
- **Coding automation** — proposed GL account / cost-center / dimension / project distributions, learned from the organization's own history, with line-level splits and human review.
- **Workflow machinery** — delegation, reminders, escalations, approval from email or mobile, and AI assistance that answers approvers' questions about an invoice in context.
- **Exception handling and collaboration** — comments, questions, and attached documents kept with the invoice; automated supplier communication for missing or mismatched information.
- **Payment-status reflection** — where payment happens elsewhere, its status flows back so the invoice record stays complete.
- **Process analytics** — touchless/straight-through rate, cycle time, exception rate, volumes; dashboards for AP managers and controllers.
- **Audit and access machinery** — a full action history per invoice, role-based access, segregation of duties.
- **AI assistants and agents** — the current-era implementation of capture, coding, matching, approver support, and supplier correspondence.
leaves.dc_zh:
- **多渠道接入** — 专用电子邮件地址、拖放上传、移动捕获、扫描仪、供应商门户、EDI和电子发票连接，所有这些都标准化为一个工作流。
- **智能提取** — 基于AI/ML的任意布局读取（历史替代方案是每个供应商模板），带有人工验证界面，显示文档与提取的字段并排，系统从更正中学习。
- **供应商解析** — 将提取的供应商数据与供应商主数据匹配，通常从ERP中拉取。
- **重复与欺诈检测** — 算法标记疑似重复项供人工检查，与原件并排；异常检查在数据进入下游系统之前运行。
- **采购订单与收据匹配** — 将发票行与采购订单、收货单，有时与合同进行比较，在行级或头级，带有容差规则；非PO发票（租金、公用事业、经常性服务）作为一等路径处理，通常学习为经常性。
- **编码自动化** — 建议的总账账户/成本中心/维度/项目分配，从组织自身历史中学习，带有行级拆分和人工审查。
- **工作流机制** — 委托、提醒、升级、从电子邮件或移动设备审批，以及AI辅助，回答审批者关于发票的上下文问题。
- **异常处理**
leaves.rules:
- **The ERP or accounting system stays the system of record.** Every sampled product states this explicitly in some form: the platform processes and governs, the ledger owns the books. Approved data reaches the ledger only through the configured integration.
- **Nothing reaches the books without passing the gate.** The approval workflow is not decoration; an invoice that has not passed the organization's authorization rules is not released, no matter how clean its data.
- **Humans stay accountable for what automation does.** Automation acts under limits the organization sets; recommendations are reviewable and explainable; auto-approval happens only inside policy-configured bounds. The recurring market phrase for this is some variant of "autonomous, but governed."
- **Suspected duplicates surface for inspection, not silent deletion.** Detection algorithms flag likely duplicates, and a human decides — a false positive block on a legitimate invoice is itself a failure mode the products design against.
- **Non-PO invoices are a first-class path.** Matching presupposes a purchase order; a large share of real invoices have none. Recurring supplier invoices are learned and automated on their own logic (schedules, budgets, historical amounts).
- **Exceptions stop the flow.** A failed validation or out-of-tolerance match halts the invoice in a visible exception state with an owner, rather than passing known-bad data downstream.
- **The invoice record is the audit trail.** Every action — capture, correction, comment, approval, rejection — is attributed and retained with the invoice. This is positioned in the market as audit and dispute protection, and it is structural: the retained record is part of the end state, not an add-on.
- **Payment status is reflected, payment execution is not required.** Where payment happens in another system, its status flows back onto the invoice so the record stays complete.
leaves.rules_zh:
- **ERP或会计系统保持作为记录系统。** 每个抽样产品都以某种形式明确陈述这一点：平台进行处理和治理，总账拥有账簿。已批准的数据仅通过配置好的集成到达总账。
- **未经过关卡的内容不得进入账簿。** 审批工作流并非装饰；未通过组织授权规则的发票不会被发布，无论其数据多么干净。
- **人类对自动化的行为负责。** 自动化在组织设定的限制下运行；建议是可审查和可解释的；自动审批仅在策略配置的范围内发生。市场上反复出现的短语是“自主但受治理”的某种变体。
- **疑似重复项被标记以供检查，而非静默删除。** 检测算法标记可能的重复项，由人类决定——对合法发票的误报阻断本身也是产品设计的失败模式。
- **非PO发票是一等路径。** 匹配预设了采购订单；但大量真实发票没有PO。经常性供应商发票根据其自身逻辑（时间表、预算、历史金额）进行学习和自动化。
- **例外情况停止流程。** 验证失败或超出容差的匹配会将发票停在可见的例外状态并指定负责人，而不是将已知错误的数据传递到下游。
- **发票记录是审计轨迹。** 每个操作——捕获、更正、评论、批准、拒绝——都与发票一起归因和保留。这在市场上被定位为审计和争议保护，并且是结构性的：保留的记录是最终状态的一部分，而非附加功能。
- **支付状态被反映，支付执行

leaves.name: Invoicing Application
leaves.overview:
An **Invoicing Application** is a seller-side application for demanding payment: it keeps records of the clients a business bills, composes each **invoice** as a numbered, dated, itemized document of record stating what a specific client owes for goods or services supplied — line items, prices, taxes, discounts, the amount due, and payment terms — issues and delivers that document to the client, and then tracks the request to fulfillment by recording payments, showing what is paid and outstanding, following up on overdue amounts, and correcting issued documents when reality diverges.

The defining core is small:

```text
Client records (the "bill-to" parties)
        │  each invoice is issued to one
        ▼
Invoice — a persistent, numbered, itemized document of record
          (line items · amounts · taxes · dates · payment terms)
        │  drafted, then
        ▼
Issuance & delivery to the client
          (email / link / print / portal)
```

Everything else commonly associated with invoicing software — online payment buttons, card-on-file auto-billing, recurring invoice series, automated reminders and late fees, estimates, client portals, time-and-expense capture — is standard equipment in mature products that makes the core work in the field, not what makes the product an invoicing application. The core was checked against paper-era practice (numbered carbon-copy invoice books plus a client ledger, with payment tracked by hand), desktop-era tools, and single-currency regional products, and it holds without any of the modern machinery.

The boundaries matter because this is a crowded neighborhood: the invoicing application creates the payment demand but does not keep the books (accounting software), does not compute charges at platform scale (billing platforms), and does not run a collections operation after issuance (accounts receivable management). It ends where the client opens the invoice and owes the money; the world beyond that belongs to other Types.
leaves.overview_zh:
一个**开票应用程序**是卖方端的应用，用于索取付款：它记录企业向其开具账单的客户，将每张**发票**编制为一份编号、带日期、列明明细的记录文件，说明特定客户为已供应的商品或服务所欠款项——包括行项目、价格、税费、折扣、应付金额及付款条款——将该文件发出并交付给客户，随后通过记录付款、显示已付与未付金额、跟进逾期款项以及在现实情况与记录不符时更正已发出的文件，来追踪该请求直至履行。

其定义性核心很小：

```text
客户记录（“账单接收方”）
         │ 每张发票开具给其中一方
         ▼
发票——一份持久化、编号、列明明细的记录文件
           （行项目 · 金额 · 税费 · 日期 · 付款条款）
         │ 起草后
         ▼
向客户发出与交付
           （电子邮件 / 链接 / 打印 / 门户）
```

通常与开票软件相关联的其他一切——在线付款按钮、卡信息存档自动计费、循环发票系列、自动提醒与滞纳金、估算单、客户门户、工时与费用捕获——在成熟产品中已是标准配置，它们使核心功能在实地运作，而非使产品成为开票应用程序。该核心已对照纸质时代实践（编号复写发票簿加客户分类账，付款靠手工追踪）、桌面时代工具以及单币种区域产品进行检验，且在没有任何现代机制的情况下依然成立。

边界之所以重要，是因为这是一个拥挤的领域：开票应用程序创建付款请求，但不记账（会计软件），不在平台规模上计算费用（计费平台），也不在发出后运行催收作业（应收账款管理）。它止于客户打开发票并欠下款项之处；其后的世界属于其他类型。
leaves.dc:
Three structures. Remove any one and the product stops being an invoicing application:

- **Client records** — identified parties (person or business) with billing details — name, contact, addresses, tax identifiers, custom terms — maintained in the application. Every invoice is issued *to* a client record, and the client's history of invoices and payments accumulates on the record. This is what separates an invoicing application from a one-off invoice generator: the application knows who it bills, over time.
- **The invoice as a document of record** — the central object. A persistent, individually numbered, dated document that itemizes what the client owes: line items with descriptions, quantities, and unit prices; taxes and discounts; adjustments; the total amount due; payment terms with a due date; notes and terms & conditions. It is drafted in the application and retained as the seller's record of the demand. The invoice is a *demand for payment for something already supplied or agreed* — not the commercial negotiation itself and not the accounting entry.
- **Issuance and delivery** — the act that turns a draft into an issued invoice: the document is sent to the client (typically as an emailed PDF, a hosted link the client can open, a print/postal copy, or a presentation in a client portal) and takes its place in the seller's issued-invoice record. Before issuance, the invoice is a draft the seller can still freely edit; issuance marks the moment the demand exists.
leaves.dc_zh:
三个核心结构。移除任何一个，产品便不再是开票软件：

- **客户记录** — 被识别的交易对方（个人或企业）及其开票详情——名称、联系方式、地址、税务标识、自定义条款——维护在应用中。每张发票都开具*给*一个客户记录，客户的发票和付款历史会在此记录上累积。这是开票软件与一次性发票生成器的核心区别：应用能够随着时间推移，记住向谁开票。
- **作为记录凭证的发票** — 核心对象。一份持久存在、独立编号、注明日期的文件，详细列明客户所欠项目：包含描述、数量和单价的行项目；税费与折扣；调整项；应付总额；附带到期日的付款条款；备注及条款与条件。它在应用中起草，并作为卖方要求付款的记录被保留。发票是*对已提供或已约定的商品/服务的付款要求*——本身并非商业谈判过程，也不是会计分录。
- **签发与送达** — 将草稿转变为已开具发票的动作：文件被发送给客户（通常通过电子邮件PDF、客户可访问的托管链接、打印/邮寄副本或客户门户展示），并纳入卖方的已开具发票记录。在签发之前，发票
leaves.rules:
### The invoice is a financial record

Issued invoices are numbered, retained documents. Products treat them accordingly: drafts are freely editable; issuance is the commitment point; corrections after issuance go through defined, traceable mechanisms (credit note, void, reissue — or in-place edit with re-send, depending on the product) rather than silent overwrites. Voided invoices typically remain visible in the record.

### Terms create the clock

The payment terms on an invoice (payment within a stated number of days, due on receipt, due at month end, or a custom date) derive the due date; the due date drives status. Overdue is not a judgment — it is the due date passing with the balance unpaid.

### Payment status is per-invoice, not a ledger

The application tracks what each invoice's balance is — paid, partially paid, unpaid — and records payments against specific invoices, including out-of-band ones. It does not run cash application against a receivables ledger, does not manage aging worklists, and does not decide write-offs. When a business needs those, the invoicing application feeds a bookkeeping or receivables process; it does not become one.

### Delivery state is visible to the seller

A distinctive behavior of this Type: the seller sees the life of the demand — sent, viewed, paid, overdue — directly on the invoice. This is the payment-demand analogue of delivery receipts in messaging, and it is what makes the follow-up loop work.

### The client record scopes the relationship

Every invoice, estimate, and payment binds to a client record; the client's page answers "what have we ever billed them, and what do they still owe?" Statements and reminders are generated from this binding. Duplicate client records are a real operational nuisance for the same reason.

### Payment methods are the product's economics

Where online payments run through the product's integrated gateways, the gateway's processing fees apply and funds settle on the processor's schedule; where clients pay out-of-band, the seller records the money manually. Both routes must exist for the invoicing workflow to be practical — online-only collection is not assumed, and several products deliberately treat manual recording of cash and transfers as a first-class action.

### Automation is configured policy, not product doctrine

Reminder timing, late fees, recurring schedules, and partial-payment acceptance are the seller's settings. Two businesses on the same product can run materially different billing disciplines.
leaves.rules_zh:
### 发票是财务记录

已发出的发票是编号、保留的文件。产品据此对待：草稿可自由编辑；发出是承诺点；发出后的更正通过定义明确、可追溯的机制（贷项通知单、作废、重开——或视产品而定就地编辑并重发）而非静默覆盖进行。作废发票通常在记录中仍可见。

### 条款创造时钟

发票上的付款条款（在既定天数内付款、收到即付、月末到期，或自定义日期）推导出到期日；到期日驱动状态。逾期并非判断——它是到期日已过而余额未付。

### 付款状态是按发票的，而非分类账

应用程序追踪每张发票的余额——已付、部分已付、未付——并将付款记入特定发票，包括带外付款。它不运行针对应收账款分类账的现金应用，不管理账龄工作清单，也不决定核销。当企业需要这些时，开票应用程序为记账或应收账款流程提供数据；它本身不成为该流程。

### 交付状态对卖方可见

此类型的独特行为：卖方直接在发票上看到请求的生命周期——已发送、已查看、已付、逾期。这是消息传递中交付回执的付款请求类比，也是使跟进循环得以运作的原因。

### 客户记录界定关系范围

每张发票、估算单和付款都绑定到客户记录；客户页面回答“我们曾向他们开具过什么，他们仍欠什么？”对账单与提醒由此绑定生成。重复的客户记录是真实的运营困扰，原因相同

leaves.name: IoT Security Platform
leaves.overview:
An **IoT Security Platform** is a security team's system of record for the organization's connected-device estate: the population of network-attached devices — printers, cameras, sensors, badge readers, medical devices, building systems, and, in the same platforms, industrial equipment — that conventional endpoint security does not instrument.

These devices share a structural property that shapes everything the platform does: they typically cannot run security software. They have lightweight or proprietary operating systems, no user logins, no patch pipeline, and no place to install an agent. A security platform therefore cannot protect them the way it protects laptops. Instead, it builds its knowledge of each device from the outside — by watching the network, querying infrastructure, and drawing on tools that already know something about the device — and then assesses, monitors, and defends the device population from that vantage point.

The defining core is three structures held together:

```text
Connected-device population of record
└── Per-device security assessment
    └── Continuous device-behavior monitoring with security alerting
```

- Remove the device population, and nothing in the system has a subject.
- Remove the per-device assessment, and the system is a network inventory.
- Remove continuous monitoring and alerting, and the system is a static exposure report.

Everything else commonly associated with the category — distributed sensor appliances, cloud consoles, network segmentation, AI-driven prioritization, vertical editions for hospitals or factories — is mature structure or a variant posture, not what makes the product an IoT security platform.
leaves.overview_zh:
一个**物联网安全平台**是安全团队用于管理组织内联网设备资产的系统记录：这些网络连接设备——包括打印机、摄像头、传感器、门禁读卡器、医疗设备、楼宇系统，以及在同一平台中还包括工业设备——是传统端点安全工具所无法检测和管理的。

这些设备共享一个结构性特征，这塑造了平台的所有运作方式：它们通常无法运行安全软件。它们拥有轻量级或专有操作系统、没有用户登录、没有补丁更新管道、也没有安装代理的位置。因此，安全平台无法像保护笔记本电脑那样保护它们。相反，它从外部构建对每个设备的认知——通过监控网络、查询基础设施，并利用已了解该设备信息的工具——然后从这个有利位置对设备群体进行评估、监控和防御。

其定义性的核心是由三个结构紧密结合而成：

```text
联网设备资产记录
└── 每设备安全评估
    └── 持续的设备行为监控与安全告警
```

- 移除设备资产，系统就失去了监控对象。
- 移除每设备评估，系统就只是一个网络资产清单。
- 移除持续监控和告警，系统就只是一个静态暴露报告。

与此类别常相关联的其他所有内容——分布式传感器设备、云控制台、网络分段、AI驱动的优先级排序、针对医院或工厂的垂直版本——都是成熟的功能结构或变体形态，而非使产品成为物联网安全平台的本质要素。
leaves.dc:
```text
Connected-device population of record
    (self-assembled: observed on the network, not enrolled)
└── Per-device security assessment
    (classification + vulnerabilities/exposures + risk standing)
└── Continuous device-behavior monitoring
    (baseline → deviation → security alert)
```

**The connected-device population of record.** Every device the platform sees is held as an individually identified record. Identity is anchored in network identifiers — the address pairings through which the device communicates — and enriched with what the platform can infer: vendor, model, device type and function, operating system or firmware family, location, and the protocols it speaks. Crucially, the population is assembled *by the system itself*: passive observation of network traffic, carefully limited active queries, and enrichment from tools that already hold device knowledge (endpoint agents elsewhere in the estate, mobile-device management, DHCP, asset databases, maintenance systems). No one enrolls a printer or an infusion pump the way a user enrolls a laptop. The population exists because it is observed. This is the structural opposite of endpoint management, where the management relationship is deliberately established on the device first.

**Per-device security assessment.** Each device record carries a security posture, not just a network presence. The platform classifies the device (what it is, who made it, what it does), matches known vulnerabilities and exposures against that classification, flags configuration and credential weaknesses — factory-default passwords, insecure management protocols, unauthorized services or connections — and synthesizes a risk standing. The risk standing is what makes the population manageable: with thousands of devices, the security team's first question is never "list them" but "which of them can hurt us most." Assessment turns the inventory into a prioritizable risk surface.

**Continuous device-behavior monitoring with security alerting.** The platform watches how devices actually communicate over time, learns the expected pattern — which devices talk to which, using which protocols, on which schedules — and raises security alerts when reality departs from that baseline: a device suddenly reaching a new destination, an unexpected command sent to a controller, traffic that matches known malware behavior, a protocol used in a way its specification forbids, or a device that stops responding altogether. Detection is behavioral and continuous because the devices themselves cannot report on their own health or compromise. Alongside security alerts, mature platforms commonly surface *operational* signals — a device that appears to have failed or disconnected — because in device estates, security and operations share the same observation point.
leaves.dc_zh:
记录的连接设备群体
    (自组装：在网络上观察到，而非注册)
└── 每设备安全评估
    (分类 + 漏洞/暴露 + 风险状况)
└── 持续设备行为监控
    (基线 → 偏差 → 安全警报)
记录的连接设备群体。平台看到的每个设备都作为单独标识的记录被保留。身份锚定在网络标识符上——设备通信的地址配对——并由平台推断的信息丰富：供应商、型号、设备类型和功能、操作系统或固件系列、位置，以及它使用的协议。关键的是，该群体是由系统本身组装的：通过网络流量的被动观察、精心限制的主动查询，以及从已拥有设备知识的工具（其他地方的端点代理、移动设备管理、DHCP、资产数据库、维护系统）中丰富信息。没有人像用户注册笔记本电脑那样注册打印机或输液泵。群体存在是因为它被观察到。这与端点管理在结构上相反，端点管理中管理关系首先在设备上有意建立。每设备安全评估。每个设备记录都承载安全态势，而不仅仅是网络存在。平台分类
leaves.rules:
### The security relationship is observational, not enrolled

No device is asked to cooperate. Everything the platform knows, it knows from the network side and from integrations. This has a defining consequence: the platform's knowledge is only as good as its observation points, and coverage gaps (unmonitored network segments) translate directly into invisible devices.

### Identity is network-anchored

A device is identified by how it presents on the network — address pairings and behavioral fingerprints — not by an account or a management registration. Devices that change addresses, or that share infrastructure, are resolved by the platform's identity logic. Products differ on devices already covered by endpoint security: some exclude them from the device population to avoid double-counting, others include them with their managed status visible — but in both cases the platform's own knowledge of the device comes from observation, not from the device's management registration.

### Detection quality depends on the learned baseline

Behavioral alerting matures with observation. Products commonly operate through an initial learning period, and alerts raised before the baseline stabilizes are treated with caution. A sudden legitimate change (a new device class deployed at scale) can generate a burst of anomalies until the baseline absorbs it.

### Most devices cannot be remediated directly

The defining constraint of the population: patching is frequently impossible for the operator (vendor-locked firmware, no update channel, availability requirements). Exposure management therefore leans on isolation and segmentation as compensating controls, and on vendor coordination for actual fixes. A platform that assumed patchability would not fit this Type.

### Security and operational risk share one observation point

A device that stops responding may be compromised — or may have failed. Mature platforms surface both readings and route them to different owners (security vs. device-owning operations), because in device estates the two failure modes are operationally intertwined.

### Enforcement is deliberately cautious

Where platforms enforce (or orchestrate enforcement), the posture is conservative: passive observation first, active techniques only where they cannot disrupt operations, and enforcement actions that avoid taking critical devices offline. In industrial and clinical settings, availability outranks containment, and the platform's rules reflect that ordering.
leaves.rules_zh:
### 安全关系基于观察，而非注册

不要求任何设备配合。平台所知的一切，均来自网络侧和集成工具。这导致了一个决定性后果：平台的知识质量取决于其观察点的质量，覆盖缺口（未被监控的网段）直接转化为不可见的设备。

### 身份基于网络锚定

设备通过其在网络上的呈现方式——地址配对和行为指纹——来识别，而非通过账户或管理注册。对于更换地址或共享基础设施的设备，平台通过其身份解析逻辑进行处理。对于已被端点安全产品覆盖的设备，各产品处理方式不同：有些将其排除在设备群体之外以避免重复计算，有些则将其包含在内并显示其受管状态——但在两种情况下，平台对设备的自身认知均来自观察，而非设备自身的管理注册。

### 检测质量取决于学习基线

行为告警的质量随观察而成熟。产品通常在初始学习期内运行，基线稳定前触发的告警需谨慎处理。突发的合法变化（例如大规模部署的新设备类别）可能会在基线吸收该变化之前产生一波异常告警。

### 多数设备无法直接修复

这是设备群体的决定性约束：打补丁对于运维人员通常不可行（厂商锁定的固件、没有更新通道、可用性要求）。因此，暴露风险管理更依赖于隔离和分段作为补偿性控制措施，并依赖于厂商协调以进行实际修复。一个假设设备可打补丁的平台并不符合此**类型**。

### 安全与运营...

leaves.name: IP Address Management / IPAM
leaves.overview:
An **IP Address Management (IPAM) application** is the network team's system of record for an organization's IP address space: it holds the space itself — blocks, subnets, and individual addresses — as a structured, searchable record, and it is the medium through which that space is planned, allocated, tracked, and reclaimed.

The problem it solves is as old as networking itself: IP addresses are a finite shared resource consumed by many teams, systems, and sites at once. Without a ledger, the same address gets assigned twice, orphaned allocations are never reclaimed, nobody can say how full a subnet is, and planning for growth means guessing. IPAM turns "who has what address, what is free, and how much is left" into questions answered from a maintained record instead of tribal memory and spreadsheets.

The defining core is deliberately small — two structures held together:

```text
The address space as a structured record
└── CIDR-organized containers (blocks / aggregates → subnets)
    └── Individually addressable entries, each carrying state and attributes
        plus
The allocation lifecycle performed against that record
    (divide → allocate / reserve → track → find free → reclaim → report)
```

Everything else commonly associated with the category — automated network scanning, DNS/DHCP integration, VLAN and VRF overlays, cloud sync, approval workflows, REST APIs — is widespread in current products but is not what makes a product an IPAM. Pure address ledgers without any of those capabilities satisfy this definition; the pre-software form of this discipline, a maintained spreadsheet of subnets and assignments, satisfies it too.
leaves.overview_zh:
一个 **IP Address Management (IPAM) 应用程序** 是网络团队用于组织 IP 地址空间的官方记录系统：它以结构化、可搜索的记录形式保存空间本身——包括块、子网和单个地址——并且是规划、分配、跟踪和回收该空间的媒介。

它所解决的问题与网络本身一样古老：IP 地址是由许多团队、系统和站点同时消耗的有限共享资源。如果没有一本账簿，同一个地址会被分配两次，孤立的分配永远不会被回收，没有人能说出一个子网已使用多少，而规划增长就意味着猜测。IPAM 将“谁拥有什么地址、哪些是空闲的、还剩多少”这些疑问，从依赖团队记忆和电子表格的状态，转变为从一个被维护的记录中获得答案。

其定义性核心故意保持小巧——由两个紧密关联的结构组成：

```text
作为结构化记录的地址空间
└── 按 CIDR 组织的容器（块 / 聚合 → 子网）
    └── 可独立寻址的条目，每个条目都带有状态和属性
        加上
对该记录执行的分配生命周期
    （划分 → 分配 / 保留 → 跟踪 → 查找空闲 → 回收 → 报告）
```

通常与此类别相关的其他所有功能——自动化网络扫描、DNS/DHCP 集成、VLAN 和 VRF 覆盖、云同步、审批工作流、REST API——在当前产品中很普遍，但并非使产品成为 IPAM 的要素。没有任何这些功能的纯地址账簿也满足此定义；此学科的前软件形式，即一份维护的子网与分配电子表格，也满足此定义。
leaves.dc:
- **Space organization layer** — groupings above subnets (sections, sites, regions, locations) used to structure large estates and scope permissions.
- **Named state vocabulary** — explicit statuses and roles on addresses and subnets (for example: in use, reserved, free, abandoned; functional roles such as loopback or virtual IP). Exact state names vary by product.
- **Free-space and capacity machinery** — find the next free address; find a free subnet of a requested size; utilization percentages, thresholds, and depletion alerts.
- **Reconciliation against the live network** — automated scanning, ping checks, or infrastructure discovery that compares the record with reality. Posture varies: some products make continuous discovery central, while source-of-truth-oriented products center on documenting the intended network rather than live scanning.
- **IP ↔ DNS name linkage** — a DNS name held as an address attribute; in some products, creating or deleting an address creates or removes the corresponding DNS record. Operating DNS itself belongs to a different Type (see Related Application Types).
- **DHCP visibility** — pool and lease data feeding the address picture; in products that bundle service management, DHCP servers and scopes are operated from the same console. Pure IPAM products lack this entirely.
- **Context overlays** — VLAN association, VRF / routing-table separation (allowing the same address range to exist in several contexts), NAT relationships, device or virtual-machine interface binding, tenancy.
- **Governance** — permission scoping down to section and subnet; authentication against directory systems; in some products, request/approval workflows for allocations.
- **Search and reporting** — estate-wide search by address, hostname, or MAC; utilization history and audit trails.
- **IPv4 and IPv6 dual-stack** throughout the data model.
- **API surface** — the same objects and operations exposed for automation.
leaves.dc_zh:
- **空间组织层** — 子网之上的分组（部分、站点、区域、位置），用于构建大型网络并限定权限范围。
- **命名状态词汇** — 地址和子网上的显式状态和角色（例如：使用中、保留、空闲、已废弃；功能角色如回环地址或虚拟IP）。确切的状态名称因产品而异。
- **空闲空间与容量机制** — 查找下一个空闲地址；查找指定大小的空闲子网；利用率百分比、阈值和耗尽警报。
- **与实时网络的对账** — 自动扫描、ping检查或基础设施发现，将记录与实际情况进行对比。姿态各异：一些产品以持续发现为核心，而面向真实来源的产品则侧重于记录预期网络而非实时扫描。
- **IP ↔ DNS名称关联** — DNS名称作为地址属性保存；在一些产品中，创建或删除地址会创建或删除相应的DNS记录。操作DNS本身属于不同类别（参见相关应用类型）。
- **DHCP可见性** — 池和租约数据为地址图像提供信息；在捆绑服务管理的产品中，DHCP服务器和范围从同一控制台操作。纯IPAM产品完全缺乏此功能。
- **上下文覆盖** — VLAN关联、VRF / 路由表分离。
leaves.rules:
### Every address counts against the hierarchy

Allocation state is computed within CIDR containment: a child subnet consumes its parent's space; utilization, free space, and overlap are consequences of the tree structure. Products therefore enforce or at least surface structural facts — a subnet cannot meaningfully exceed its parent, overlaps are detectable, and the "same" range can coexist only when explicitly separated into different routing contexts.

### Allocation state is explicit and user-visible

The distinction between free, reserved, in-use, and abandoned is a first-class part of every record, not a footnote. Reservations differ from assignments (space held for the future versus space with a holder), and both differ from free. Exact state names vary by product.

### The record is authoritative — but its truthfulness is a posture

In the documentation-first posture, the record is the intent and wins by definition. In the scanning-led posture, the record is continuously corrected against the network. Either way, the record — not ad-hoc live queries — is the basis for allocation decisions; drift between record and reality is treated as a condition to be fought (scans, checks, audits), not ignored.

### Uniqueness is per context

An address is unique within its routing context (VRF / table). Products that support multiple contexts can hold the same address range several times; products that do not, cannot. Uniqueness enforcement within a context is what prevents the classic duplicate-address failure.

### Space is reclaimed, not just consumed

The lifecycle is deliberately closed: releasing, deleting, or re-marking entries is as much a part of the model as allocation, because finite space runs out. Depletion planning — knowing how soon a subnet or scope will be exhausted — is the reporting consequence of this rule.

### Couplings exist but are not the ledger

DNS names and DHCP pool data commonly attach to addresses, and some products write DNS records or read leases as part of address operations. The ledger, however, remains complete without any of these couplings — a product can be a fully functional IPAM while never operating a DNS or DHCP service.
leaves.rules_zh:
### 每个地址都计入层次结构

分配状态在 CIDR 包含关系内计算：一个子网消耗其父级的空间；利用率、空闲空间和重叠是树结构的结果。因此，产品强制执行或至少揭示结构事实——一个子网在意义上不能超过其父级，重叠是可检测的，并且只有当显式分离到不同的路由上下文时，才可以存在“相同”的范围。

### 分配状态是显式且用户可见的

空闲、保留、使用中和废弃之间的区别是每个记录的一等组成部分，而非脚注。保留不同于分配（为未来保留的空间与带有持有者的空间），两者都不同于空闲。确切的状态名称因产品而异。

### 记录是权威的——但其真实性是一种姿态

在文档优先的姿态下，记录是意图，根据定义胜出。在扫描主导的姿态下，记录根据网络持续校正。无论如何，记录——而非临时实时查询——是分配决策的基础；记录与现实之间的偏差被视为需要对抗的状况（扫描、检查、审计），而非被忽略。

### 唯一性是基于上下文的

一个地址在其路由上下文（VRF / 表）内是唯一的。支持多个上下文的产品可以在多个上下文中持有相同的地址范围；不支持的产品则不能。在上下文内强制唯一性是防止经典重复地址故障的关键。

### 空间被回收，而不仅仅是消耗

生命周期是刻意闭环的：释放、删除或重新标记条目与分配一样，是模型的一部分，因为有限的空间会耗尽。耗尽规划——了解一个子网或范围将何时耗尽——是回收工作的自然延伸。

leaves.name: IRB / Research Ethics Management
leaves.name_zh: IRB（机构审查委员会）/研究伦理管理
leaves.overview:
An **IRB / Research Ethics Management** application is a research institution's system of record for the ethical and regulatory review of research involving human subjects. It manages the full life of a research protocol: preparation and submission by the research team, pre-review by ethics-office staff, review and determination by the institutional review board (ethics committee), and continued oversight of the approved study — amendments, continuing reviews, reportable events, and closure.

Its purpose is to make the institution's participant-protection obligations operational: every study that needs ethics review is captured as a persistent record, every review action is structured and routed, every determination is recorded and communicated formally, and the institution retains a complete compliance memory of each study.

The defining core is deliberately small: a protocol record, a submission-driven review workflow ending in a recorded determination, the committee's review machinery, and the post-approval oversight lifecycle. Everything else commonly associated with these products — smart forms, training verification, dashboards, multi-board consolidation, regulatory-grade e-signatures — is widespread but not what makes the system this Type.
leaves.overview_zh:
一个 **IRB / 研究伦理管理** 应用程序是研究机构用于记录涉及人类受试者研究的伦理与法规审查的主系统。它管理研究方案的全部生命周期：由研究团队准备与提交、伦理办公室工作人员预审、机构审查委员会（伦理委员会）审查与决定，以及对已批准研究的持续监督——包括修正案、继续审查、需报告事件与结题。

其目的是使机构的受试者保护义务得以操作化：每个需要伦理审查的研究都被捕获为一条持久记录，每个审查行动都经过结构化并路由，每个决定都被记录并正式传达，且机构保留了每个研究的完整合规记录。

其定义的核心被有意保持精简：一个方案记录、一个由提交驱动的审查工作流（最终产生一个已记录的决定）、委员会的审查机制，以及批准后的监督生命周期。通常与此类产品相关联的其他一切——智能表单、培训验证、仪表板、多委员会整合、监管级电子签名——虽然普遍存在，但并非使该系统成为此 **类型** 的本质特征。
leaves.dc: The system's world is organized around one central object and four structures held together:
leaves.dc_zh: 该系统的组织围绕一个中心对象和四个结构紧密相连：
leaves.rules:
- **Certification gates submission.** The PI (and commonly all key personnel) must certify or attest before a submission is accepted; resubmissions after modifications typically require re-certification.
- **Submitted packages are locked.** Once a submission is under review it is locked; changes happen through a new submission (amendment or revision), preserving the record of what was reviewed.
- **Modifications-required is a loop, not a rejection.** The common outcome is a return to the team with section-bound comments; the submission is resubmitted after all comments are addressed, and review resumes.
- **Review route determines the path.** Exempt and expedited submissions are typically processed by staff or a designated reviewer without a meeting deadline; full-board submissions are tied to convened meetings and their deadlines. The board can change the route a submission initially received.
- **Approvals expire.** Continuing review keeps an approval alive; systems track expiry and generate reminders, and an expired approval halts the study.
- **One pending action at a time.** Several products allow only one open submission per protocol at a time, keeping the review record unambiguous.
- **Access follows role and study assignment.** Researchers see their own studies; reviewers see assigned submissions; office staff and administrators see the institution's portfolio. Access on a study is granted at the minimum level needed.
- **The record is the compliance evidence.** Statuses, comments, decisions, and letters are retained and attributable — the system's audit trail is a primary institutional artifact.
leaves.rules_zh:
- **认证是提交的门槛。** 主要研究者（通常还包括所有关键人员）必须在提交被接受前进行认证或证明；修改后的重新提交通常需要重新认证。
- **已提交的资料包会被锁定。** 一旦提交进入审查状态即被锁定；变更通过新的提交（修正案或修订）进行，从而保留所审查内容的记录。
- **“需修改”是一个循环，而非拒绝。** 常见的结果是将带有章节意见的提交退回给团队；在所有意见得到处理后重新提交，然后继续审查。
- **审查路径决定流程。** 豁免和简化路径的提交通常由工作人员或指定审查员处理，无会议截止日期；全体委员会提交则与召开的会议及其截止日期挂钩。委员会可以更改提交最初收到的路径。
- **批准会过期。** 继续审查保持批准有效；系统跟踪到期情况并生成提醒，已过期的批准将终止研究。
- **同一时间只允许一个待处理动作。** 多个产品只允许每个方案同时有一个开放的提交，以保持审查记录的明确性。
- **访问权限遵循角色和研究指派。** 研究人员查看自己的研究；审查员查看分配的提交；办公室工作人员和管理员查看机构的整体项目组合。对研究的访问权限按所需最低级别授予。
- **记录即合规证据。** 状态、意见、决定和信函均被保留并可追溯——系统的审计跟踪是主要的机构级证明材料。

leaves.name: Irrigation Management
leaves.overview:
An **Irrigation Management** application is the grower-side water-decision system for irrigated crop production. It holds a farm's irrigated areas — fields, zones, blocks, bays, pivots — as decision units, maintains a current and forward-looking picture of each area's water status and crop water demand, and turns that picture into dated, area-bound irrigation decisions: recommendations and schedules stating **when, where, and how much** water to apply. What is actually applied is recorded back against the plan, and the status picture updates as water goes on, rain falls, and the crop grows.

The defining core is the decision loop itself:

```text
Irrigated areas (decision units)
    └── Water-status & demand picture  (sensed, modeled, or expert-entered)
        └── Irrigation decision        (dated, area-bound: when / where / how much)
            └── Application            (manual, or executed through connected equipment)
                └── Recorded against the plan → status picture updates → next decision
```

Everything else commonly associated with the category — soil-moisture probes, remote pivot control, automated valves, fertigation, satellite imagery, variable-rate prescriptions — is standard capability or optional depth. A product can be genuine irrigation management with no sensors at all (a modeled schedule built from weather data and expert-entered field records), and a product full of sensors and remote-controlled valves is not irrigation management unless it produces the water decision.
leaves.overview_zh:
**灌溉管理**应用是灌溉作物生产中，面向种植者的水决策系统。它将农场的灌溉区域——田块、分区、单元、转盘、支轴——作为决策单元，维护每个区域当前及前瞻性的水状态与作物需水图景，并将该图景转化为按日期、按区域绑定的灌溉决策：说明**何时、何地、以及施加多少**水量的建议与计划。实际施水量会记录回计划中，并且随着灌溉进行、降雨发生、作物生长，状态图景会不断更新。

其定义性的核心是决策循环本身：

```text
灌溉区域（决策单元）
    └── 水状态与需求图景（感知、建模或专家输入）
        └── 灌溉决策（按日期、按区域绑定：何时/何地/多少）
            └── 执行（手动，或通过连接设备执行）
                └── 按计划记录 → 状态图景更新 → 下一个决策
```

与此类别通常关联的其他一切——土壤湿度探头、远程转盘控制、自动化阀门、水肥一体化、卫星影像、变量施肥处方——属于标准能力或可选深度。一个产品可以是真正的灌溉管理，即使没有任何传感器（一个基于天气数据和专家输入的田间记录构建的模型化计划）；而一个满是传感器和远程控制阀门的产品，除非它能产出水决策，否则就不属于灌溉管理。
leaves.dc:
**The irrigated area as the decision unit.** Every water decision attaches to an identified production area. The area carries the context the decision depends on — the crop, its stage, the soil, the application equipment that serves it. Areas are held persistently across seasons, so status history and application history accumulate per area. Without this layer, water-related software is just sensing or equipment control with nothing to decide *for*.

**The water-status and demand picture.** For each area the system maintains where water stands against what the crop needs. This picture is built from whatever data sources the product offers — the substrate is a variant, the picture is not:

- measured soil moisture (probe- or sensor-based), often shown against defined thresholds or named bands indicating how close the soil is to its refill point
- a water balance: water used by the crop (evapotranspiration), water added by irrigation and rain
- modeled estimates from weather, soil, and crop data entered by the user or an advisor
- increasingly, remote-sensing inputs such as satellite-derived water-use estimates over broad areas

The picture is forward-looking as well as current — mature products commonly show water fill levels for past and coming dates, and a rolling multi-day forecast of irrigation need, updated as weather updates. Without this layer, there is no basis to decide anything; the product collapses into equipment control or weather display.

**The irrigation decision.** The system produces a dated, area-bound statement of when, where, and how much water to apply. Three realizations appear in the market and often coexist in one product:

- a **recommendation** — advisory output the grower reads and acts on (commonly presented as map or list views per field)
- a **schedule** — an explicit plan the user edits: dates/times, durations or depths or run hours per area
- a **program** — an executable configuration driving equipment: sequences of gate, valve, or pump actions, either time-based or triggered by sensor events

The decision is *recurring and revisable*: it is regenerated or adjusted as the status picture changes. Without it — if the software only shows conditions and never lands on "what to do" — the product is a monitoring platform, not irrigation management.
leaves.dc_zh:
**以灌溉区域为决策单元。** 每一项用水决策都归属于一个已定义的生产区域。该区域承载了决策所需的全部背景信息——作物种类、生长阶段、土壤状况以及为之服务的灌溉设备。各区域在季节间被持续记录，因此每个区域都会积累其状态历史和灌溉历史。缺少这一层面，涉水软件就只是传感或设备控制，而没有需要决策的*对象*。

**水情与需求画像。** 系统为每个区域持续跟踪水分状态与作物需求的匹配情况。此画像是基于产品所支持的数据源构建的——数据基质是可变的，但画像本身是稳定的：
- 实测土壤湿度（基于探针或传感器），通常与预设的阈值或表示土壤距补灌点远近的命名区间进行对比；
- 水分平衡：作物耗水量（蒸散量）、灌溉与降雨的补水量；
- 基于用户或农艺顾问输入的天气、土壤和作物数据生成的模型估算；
- 日益增加的遥感输入，如基于卫星的大范围用水估算。

该画像既是当前的，也是前瞻性的——成熟的产品通常会展示过去与未来日期的水位填充状态，以及随天气更新而滚动更新的多日灌溉需求预测。缺少这一层面，则决策无据可依。
leaves.rules:
- **The decision loop runs on the status picture, not on the calendar alone.** Recommendations and schedules are regenerated or adjusted as weather, sensors, and crop stage change; a fixed season-long plan is a special case, not the norm.
- **Plan and execution are distinct records.** What was recommended, what was scheduled, and what actually ran are tracked separately; mature products surface the gaps, because equipment faults, dead batteries, channel shortfalls, and connectivity loss routinely break execution.
- **Automation is gated by equipment readiness.** A program synchronized to devices is not a program that will run: blocking alarms must be cleared, devices must respond, and some products explicitly prevent commands that would be hydraulically illogical.
- **Status is evaluated against defined thresholds.** Whether expressed as named bands or numeric targets, the product's judgment of "too dry / adequate / full" rests on thresholds set per area (soil, crop, method) — often calibrated by an expert during setup.
- **Water is accounted, not just applied.** Applications feed a per-area water ledger used for the status picture, for reporting, and commonly for compliance and traceability.
- **Advisory mode is a full mode, not a crippled one.** Recommendation-only configurations are deliberately marketed (for modeled scheduling without hardware); the absence of control does not demote the product out of the Type.
- **Fertigation may be inseparable or absent.** In drip-centric implementations, irrigation and nutrient dosing are planned, executed, and reported as one; in pivot and surface implementations, nutrients are typically out of scope.
leaves.rules_zh:
- **决策循环基于状态图景运行，而不仅仅基于日历。**建议和计划会随着天气、传感器和作物阶段的变化而重新生成或调整；一个固定、贯穿全季的计划是一种特例，而非规范。
- **计划和执行是不同的记录。**建议的内容、计划的内容以及实际执行的内容被分开跟踪；成熟的产品会揭示其中的差距，因为设备故障、电池耗尽、渠道供水不足以及连接丢失通常会破坏执行。
- **自动化受设备就绪状态门控。**一个已同步到设备的方案并不等同于一个将要运行的方案：必须清除阻塞性警报、设备必须响应，并且一些产品会明确阻止水力学上不合逻辑的指令。
- **状态评估基于定义的阈值。**无论是以命名的区间还是数值目标表示，产品对“过干/适中/饱和”的判断，依赖于为每个区域（土壤、作物、方法）设定的阈值——这些阈值通常在设置时由专家校准。
- **水被核算，而不仅仅是施用。**施用量会反馈到一个按区域记录的水量账本中，该账本用于状态图景、报告，并通常用于合规性和可追溯性。
- **建议模式是一个完整模式，而非残缺模式。**仅推荐配置是有意为之的市场定位（用于无硬件的模型化调度）；缺乏控制功能并不会将该产品降级到此类别之外。
- **水肥一体化可能不可分割或完全不存在。**在滴灌为主的实施中，灌溉和养分施用的计划、执行和报告是一体的；而在转盘和地面灌溉实施中，养分管理通常不在其范围内。

leaves.name: IRT / RTSM
leaves.name_zh: 交互式随机化和试验供应管理系统（IRT/RTSM）
leaves.overview:
An **IRT / RTSM** is the clinical trial's treatment-allocation and drug-supply system: the software that, at the moment a subject is enrolled at a trial site, decides and records what treatment that subject receives — and then manages the trial's investigational drug so that the right blinded medication kit is physically there to dispense, at that visit and every subsequent one, across every depot, site, and country the trial touches.

The defining structure is small:

```text
The study's allocation design
  (randomization scheme held and applied by the system —
   configured per protocol before go-live)
└── The subject's assignment
    (created by a site-side interactive transaction at enrollment:
     request in → treatment allocation out → recorded)
    └── The trial supply chain of blinded kits
        (identified medication units tracked from depot to site
         to subject, dispensed against assignments, reconciled
         through returns and destruction)
```

Everything else the category is known for — automated resupply algorithms, supply forecasting, direct-to-patient shipping, temperature-excursion handling, mid-study design changes, analytics — is standard equipment built on that core. The name itself encodes the two halves: *randomization and trial supply management* describes the function; *interactive response technology* describes the interaction heritage (sites first reached these systems by telephone — IVRS — then by web and mobile; the interaction, not the channel, is what the system is).

Its boundary is deliberate. Capturing the subjects' clinical data is the EDC's territory. Managing the trial's operations — sites, milestones, monitoring, budgets — is the CTMS's. Physically storing, packaging, and distributing the drug is the clinical supply chain's. The IRT/RTSM holds the one thing none of those hold: **the trial's allocation design and the blinded chain of custody that carries each assignment to the subject it belongs to.**
leaves.overview_zh:
**IRT / RTSM** 是临床试验的治疗分配和药物供应系统：该软件在试验点受试者入组时，决定并记录该受试者接受的治疗——然后管理试验的研究药物，以便在访视时及后续每次访视中，在试验涉及的每个仓库、试验点和国家，都有正确的盲法药物包可供分发。

结构定义如下：

```text
研究的分配设计
  （系统持有并应用的随机化方案——
   在试验启动前根据方案配置）
└── 受试者的分配
    （通过入组时的站点侧交互事务创建：
     请求输入 → 治疗分配输出 → 记录）
    └── 盲法药物包的试验供应链
        （从仓库到站点到受试者的已识别药物单元，
         根据分配分发，通过退回和销毁进行核对）
```

该类别所知的其他一切——自动补货算法、供应预测、直接患者运输、温度偏差处理、研究中设计变更、分析——都是建立在这个核心上的标准装备。名称本身编码了两个部分：*随机化和试验供应管理* 描述功能；*交互式响应技术* 描述交互传统（试验点最初通过电话——IVRS——访问这些系统，然后通过网络和移动设备；交互本身，而非渠道，是该系统的本质）。

其边界是刻意的。捕获受试者的临床数据是EDC的领域。管理试验的运营——试验点、里程碑、监控、预算——是CTMS的。物理存储、包装和分发药物是临床供应链的。IRT/RTSM持有其他系统都不持有的东西：**试验的分配设计和盲法监管链，将每个分配传递给所属的受试者。**
leaves.dc:
**1. The study's allocation design.** Before a trial opens, its randomization scheme — a pre-generated allocation list or an algorithm such as minimization, with its stratification and balance factors (for example site, sex, age band, disease severity), its cohorts, stages, and treatment ratios — is configured into the system as protected content. The system holds the mapping between allocation sequence and actual treatment; sites never receive it. The design is versioned as the protocol changes. This is what makes assignments statistically sound and centrally consistent across every site in the trial, and it is the reason the system cannot be replaced by a form: the design is knowledge the trial must hold somewhere, and this is where it lives.

**2. The subject's assignment.** When site staff register a subject's enrollment and request randomization — at or near the protocol's randomization visit — the system applies the design and returns that subject's allocation in real time: a treatment-arm assignment (expressed in blinded form where the trial is blinded) and, typically, the specific medication kit to dispense for it. The assignment is a persistent record: it anchors every later dispensing for that subject, every dose modification, and the subject's entire treatment history. Its creation is the *interactive response* the category is named for — a transaction, not a lookup.

**3. The trial supply chain of blinded kits.** The trial's drug exists in the system as identified, individually numbered units — kits — whose treatment content is unknown to the people handling them. The system tracks each kit through its life: released at a depot, shipped to a site (or directly to a patient), received and confirmed into site inventory, assigned and dispensed to a subject against that subject's assignment, and finally accounted for — returned, or destroyed — until every kit is reconciled. Kits are interchangeable: they are not labeled for particular patients but assigned at dispensing time, which is what allows site inventory to stay small, waste to stay low, and the blind to stay intact.

The three bind into one loop: **the assignment drives the dispensing; the dispensing draws down the inventory; the inventory drives the resupply; the resupply is shaped by the enrollment forecast and the visit schedule.** Remove any leg and the rest collapses into something else — a statistics tool, a warehouse system, or the sealed-envelope paper method this category replaced.

The **blinding thread** runs through all three: in a blinded trial, the system strictly controls who may see the treatment mapping (role-based blinding management), keeps site inventory and resupply parameters from revealing it, and provides a controlled, auditable emergency-unblinding path as the only sanctioned exception. In open-label trials the same structures operate without concealment — the machinery is the same; the mapping simply stops being sensitive.
leaves.dc_zh:
1. 研究的分配设计。试验开始前，其随机化方案——一个预先生成的分配列表或算法如最小化法，带有分层和平衡因素（例如中心、性别、年龄组、疾病严重程度）、队列、阶段和治疗比例——作为受保护内容配置到系统中。系统持有分配序列和实际治疗之间的映射；中心从不接收它。设计随方案更改而版本化。这就是为什么分配在统计上合理并在试验每个中心间保持中心一致，也是系统不能被表单替代的原因：设计是试验必须保存的某处知识，而这里就是它的所在。

2. 受试者的分配。当中心工作人员注册受试者入组并请求随机化——在方案随机化访视或附近——系统应用设计并实时返回该受试者的分配：治疗组分配（在试验盲态时以盲法形式表达），通常还有要分发的特定药物包。分配是一个持久记录：它锚定该受试者的每个后续分发、每个剂量调整和受试者的整个治疗历史。其创建就是该类别命名的*交互式响应*——一个事务，而不是查找。
leaves.rules:
### The blind is structural, not cosmetic

Treatment mapping is withheld by design: sites see blinded kit numbers, never arms; inventory and resupply parameters are withheld from sites because inventory patterns themselves can leak the blind (a documented concern in the supply-methods literature); reports and exports are filtered by the user's blinding status. Breaking the blind is a permissioned, recorded transaction with defined consequences — never a side effect of browsing.

### Assignments come from the design, not from users

Site staff cannot choose a subject's treatment. The system applies the held scheme or algorithm; the site's transaction requests and receives. This is what makes the trial's randomization auditable and bias-free.

### Kits are interchangeable until dispensed

Blinded kits are not pre-allocated to patients. They are assigned at dispensing time from site inventory, which is what decouples supply from enrollment count, minimizes waste, and keeps site stock small.

### Resupply is algorithmic

Shipments are generated by the system's supply logic — triggered by inventory levels and/or predicted from visit schedules — not by site staff placing ad-hoc orders. The supply engine balances availability, expiry, and waste.

### Everything is attributable

Who randomized, who dispensed, who confirmed receipt, who broke a code, when and why — every transaction is recorded for the trial's regulatory inspection. The accountability chain must reconcile at close-out: every kit the trial made is either dispensed, returned, or destroyed, with a record.

### The system changes while the trial runs

Protocols are amended mid-study: new cohorts, changed doses, revised schedules. Mature systems apply such changes to the live study under governance — some by permissioned users directly, some through vendor change processes — without stopping enrollment, and without disturbing the assignments already made.
leaves.rules_zh:
### 盲法是结构性的，而非装饰性的

治疗映射按设计被隐瞒：站点看到盲法药物包编号，从不看到组别；库存和补货参数向站点隐瞒，因为库存模式本身可能泄露盲法（供应方法文献中记录的担忧）；报告和导出按用户的盲法状态过滤。打破盲法是经过许可、记录的事务，具有定义后果——从不是浏览的副作用。

### 分配来自设计，而非用户

站点工作人员无法选择受试者的治疗。系统应用持有的方案或算法；站点的事务请求并接收。这使得试验的随机化可审计且无偏。

### 药物包在分发前可互换

盲法药物包未预先分配给患者。它们在分发时从站点库存分配，这使得供应与入组计数脱钩、最小化浪费并保持站点库存较小。

### 补货是算法化的

发货由系统的供应逻辑生成——由库存水平触发和/或从访视时间表预测——而非由站点工作人员下达临时订单。供应引擎平衡可用性、过期和浪费。

### 一切可归因

谁随机化、谁分发、谁确认收货、谁打破代码、何时及为何——每个事务都为试验的监管检查记录。责任链必须在关闭时核对：试验生产的每个药物包要么已分发、退回或销毁，并有记录。

### 系统在试验运行时变化

方案在研究中修订：新队列、改变剂量、修订时间表。成熟系统在治理下将此类变更应用于实时研究——有些通过许可

leaves.name: Issue Tracker
leaves.overview:
An **Issue Tracker** is a software team's system of record for its work items. It holds each discrete item of work or problem that arises in the team's work on its product — a bug, a feature, a task, an improvement, an idea — as an individually addressable record, and carries each record through a lifecycle from open to a recorded done or closed state. Around that core it keeps the accumulated population of issues organized, searchable, and reportable, so the team can see what is open, what is being worked on, who is responsible for what, and what remains.

The defining core is small:

```text
The issue of record
(one discrete item of work or problem, individually addressable,
 kind — bug/feature/task/idea — as a classification on a uniform record)
└── Work-shaped lifecycle (open → worked → done/closed, reopen as a normal operation)
    └── Ownership (who raised it, who is responsible for it)
        └── Organized, queryable population
            (held in a container for the body of work — project/repository/team —
             partitioned by classification, listable/filterable/searchable/reportable)
```

Two properties of this core deserve emphasis. First, the record grammar is **uniform**: the same fields, states, and lifecycle apply regardless of what kind of work the issue represents — the kind is a classification on the record, not a different record model. This is what makes one tool able to hold bugs next to features next to chores. Second, the record exists to be **driven to a disposition**: an issue is not a conversation or a note, it is tracked work with a state and an owner.

Everything else commonly associated with these products — type systems, labels, comments, boards, backlogs, sprints, roadmaps, code linkage, automation, AI triage — is standard machinery that mature products add around the core. Older and minimal products have functioned without most of it and are still recognizably issue trackers.

When the record model narrows so that the defect and its fix/verify lifecycle become the primary structure, the product is drifting toward a different Application Type (Bug Tracking System). When records exist to process incoming demands from requesters rather than to carry the team's own work, that is the Ticketing System boundary.
leaves.overview_zh:
问题跟踪器是软件团队对其工作项的记录系统。它将团队在产品工作中产生的每个独立工作项或出现的问题——缺陷、功能、任务、改进、想法——作为可独立寻址的记录保存，并携带每个记录经历从开放到记录完成或关闭状态的生命周期。围绕这个核心，它将累积的问题集合保持有序、可搜索和可报告，以便团队能够查看哪些是开放的、哪些正在处理中、谁负责什么以及还剩什么。

其定义核心很小：

```text
记录的问题
（一个独立的工作项或问题，可独立寻址，
  kind — 缺陷/功能/任务/想法 — 作为统一记录上的分类）
└── 工作导向的生命周期（开放 → 处理中 → 完成/关闭，重新打开为常规操作）
    └── 所有权（谁提出的，谁负责）
        └── 有序、可查询的集合
            （保存在工作主体的容器中 — 项目/代码库/团队 —
             按分类划分，可列表/可筛选/可搜索/可报告）
```

这个核心的两个特性值得强调。首先，记录语法是**统一的**：无论问题代表何种类型的工作，相同的字段、状态和生命周期都适用——类型是记录上的分类，而非不同的记录模型。这使得一个工具能够将缺陷与功能、杂务并列存放。其次，记录的存在是为了**推动处理**：问题不是对话或笔记，它是被跟踪的工作，具有状态和所有者。

其他通常与这些产品相关的内容——类型系统、标签、评论、看板、待办事项、迭代、路线图、代码链接、自动化、AI分类——是成熟产品围绕核心添加的标准机制。较旧和极简的产品在没有这些功能的情况下仍能正常运行，并且仍然是可识别的问题跟踪器。

当记录模型变得狭窄，以致缺陷及其修复/验证生命周期成为主要结构时，产品就向不同类型（缺陷跟踪系统）演变。当记录存在是为了处理来自请求者的需求，而不是承载团队自身工作时，那就是票务系统的边界。
leaves.dc: The issue is the unit of record: a persistent, individually addressable entry with its own identity (a number, or a key plus number) that represents one discrete item of work or problem. Minimally it carries a title or summary, a description, a state, and an owner — one modern product's documentation states the requirement plainly: an issue must have a title and a status, and every other property and relation is optional. Everything else is layered on.
leaves.dc_zh: 问题作为记录单位：一个持久的、可独立寻址的条目，拥有自己的身份（一个数字，或一个键加数字），代表一项离散的工作或问题。最小化地，它包含一个标题或摘要、一个描述、一个状态和一个所有者——一个现代产品的文档明确指出要求：一个问题必须有一个标题和一个状态，其他所有属性和关系都是可选的。其他一切都层叠其上。
leaves.rules:
### State is product-managed, not free-form

An issue's state changes only through defined transitions, and transitions may demand justification (a disposition, a note) or authority (per-transition permission). This is what makes the lifecycle trustworthy enough to plan against.

### Kind is a classification, not a record model

A bug, a feature, and a chore live on the same record grammar; reclassifying an issue does not change its nature. This is the structural reason one tracker serves the whole team — and the line that separates this Type from defect-centric tracking.

### Duplicates are merged, not deleted

Repeat reports of the same problem are marked as duplicates of the canonical record — often with the duplicate's attachments and interest carried over — so the population stays clean without losing reporters. Deletion of records is usually restricted or discouraged; closing with a disposition is the normal exit.

### The record outlives the conversation

Decisions, requests for information, fixes, and dispositions all happen on the record, and the history is retained. The registry is organizational memory: an issue closed years ago remains findable when a pattern reappears. Products themselves mark the contrast — conversations that are not tracked work belong in separate discussion surfaces, and some products even provide an explicit conversion from issue to discussion.

### Assignment makes work legible

An unassigned issue is visibly unowned; assigning it is the act that makes responsibility public. Watching and notifications extend visibility without transferring responsibility.

### Visibility is a first-class dimension

Issues routinely contain sensitive detail (security problems, customer data, internal plans), so per-record or per-area visibility — private issues, restricted components, security levels — is a common structural feature.
leaves.rules_zh:
### 状态由产品管理，非自由形式

问题的状态仅通过定义的转换来改变，转换可能需要理由（处理决定、备注）或权限（按转换设置的权限）。这使得生命周期足够可靠，可以据此进行计划。

### kind 是分类，而非记录模型

缺陷、功能和杂项共存于相同的记录语法中；重新分类一个问题不会改变其本质。这是一个跟踪器能服务于整个团队的结构性原因——也是将此类型与以缺陷为中心的跟踪区分开来的界限。

### 重复项被合并，而非删除

对同一问题的重复报告被标记为规范记录的重复项——通常保留重复项的附件和关注度——这样问题集合在不丢失报告者的情况下保持干净。记录的删除通常受限或不鼓励；以处理决定关闭是正常的退出方式。

### 记录的寿命长于对话

决策、信息请求、修复和处理决定都发生在记录上，并且历史记录被保留。登记册是组织的记忆：一个多年前关闭的问题，当模式重现时仍然可找到。产品本身也标记了这一点——不属于跟踪工作的对话应该放在单独的讨论界面中，一些产品甚至提供从问题到对话的明确转换。

### 分配使工作清晰可见

一个未分配的问题明显无人认领；分配它是使责任公开的行为。关注和通知在不转移责任的情况下扩展了可见性。

### 可见性是一等维度

问题通常包含敏感细节（安全问题、客户数据、内部计划），因此需要按记录或按领域的可见性设置——

leaves.name: IT Asset Management
leaves.overview:
An **IT Asset Management** application is the organization's system of record for its IT assets: it keeps individually identified records of the hardware and software the organization owns or controls — each carrying the commercial facts of its existence — holds every record in an explicit lifecycle from acquisition to disposal, and continuously reconciles and reports the estate's financial and compliance position from those records.

The defining structure is small:

```text
IT asset records of record (hardware + software entitlements, identified & classified,
    each carrying cost / supplier / warranty-contract-license terms)
└── Lifecycle of record (acquisition → deployment → in-use service → retirement/disposal,
    transitions recorded, record retained)
    └── Estate-level commercial reconciliation & reporting
        (entitlements vs deployments, coverage & expirations, value over time, audit readiness)
```

Everything else commonly associated with the category — automated network discovery, barcode/QR/RFID labeling, checkout workflows, purchase-order systems, dependency mapping, CMDB views, AI assistants — is widespread in current products but is not what makes a product an IT Asset Management application. A manually populated, self-hosted asset register with depreciation and license seats is squarely this Type; a discovery platform without the commercial lifecycle is drifting toward neighboring Types.
leaves.overview_zh:
一个 **IT Asset Management**（IT资产管理）应用程序是组织IT资产的系统记录：它保存组织拥有或控制的硬件和软件的个别识别记录——每条记录都带有其存在的商业事实——在从获取到处置的明确生命周期中保存每条记录，并根据这些记录持续对账和报告资产组合的财务与合规状况。

其定义结构很小：

```text
IT资产记录（硬件 + 软件权益，已识别和分类，
    每条记录附带成本 / 供应商 / 保修-合同-许可条款）
└── 记录生命周期（获取 → 部署 → 使用中服务 → 退役/处置，
    状态转移被记录，记录被保留）
    └── 资产组合级别的商业对账与报告
        （权益 vs 部署，覆盖范围与过期，价值随时间变化，审计就绪状态）
```

通常与此类别相关的其他一切——自动化网络发现、条形码/二维码/RFID标签、借出工作流、采购订单系统、依赖关系映射、CMDB视图、AI助手——在当前产品中很普遍，但它们并非使一个产品成为IT资产管理应用程序的关键。一个手动填充、自托管的、包含折旧和许可座位的资产登记本正是这种 **类型**（Type）；而一个缺乏商业生命周期发现的平台则正向相邻的 **类型** 偏移。
leaves.dc:
- **Population machinery** — automated discovery of devices and software from the network and cloud environments, agent-based or agentless; import from spreadsheets; manual entry; APIs. Discovery is the dominant method in modern products, but population by hand or import remains fully supported — a product does not stop being ITAM without it.
- **Verification loops** — scheduled audits with due dates and reminders, mobile scanning walks, reconciliation of discovered reality against the records.
- **Custody workflow** — check-out/check-in of assets to people with exclusivity (one holder at a time), acceptance confirmations, reminders for unaccepted items.
- **Type/model layer** — a model or template per product class carrying defaults (depreciation profile, end-of-life) that individual assets inherit.
- **Contract and purchase machinery** — purchase orders, vendor/supplier records, contract terms, cost centers and accounting codes, renewal tracking.
- **Financial value machinery** — depreciation computation and current-value estimates fed to finance.
- **License engine** — entitlement records with seats, allocation of seats to users or devices, installed/deployed counts compared against purchased counts, compliance status.
- **Reporting & dashboards** — estate composition, compliance position, upcoming expirations, spend.
- **Integration surfaces** — links to ITSM/ticketing (assets attached to incidents), endpoint-management tools, finance systems; APIs for data exchange.
leaves.dc_zh: 资产填充机制——通过代理或无代理方式自动从网络和云环境中发现设备和软件；从电子表格导入；手动输入；API。在现代产品中，发现是主要方法，但手动或导入填充仍然完全支持——没有它，产品不会停止成为ITAM。验证循环——安排有截止日期和提醒的审计，移动扫描步行，将发现的现实与记录进行核对。保管工作流——资产借出/归还给人员，具有排他性（一次只有一个持有者），接受确认，未接受项目的提醒。类型/模型层——每个产品类别的模型或模板，带有默认值（折旧配置、生命周期结束），单个资产继承。合同和采购机制——采购订单、供应商记录、合同条款、成本中心和会计代码、续订跟踪。财务价值机制——折旧计算和当前价值估算，提供给财务部门。许可证引擎——授权记录，具有席位，将席位分配给用户或设备，安装/部署数量与购买数量比较，合规状态。报告和仪表板——资产组合、合规状态、即将到期的项目、支出。集成表面——链接到ITSM/工单系统。
leaves.rules:
### Identity is unique and physical-anchored

Each hardware asset carries one unique organizational identifier (asset tag/number). Duplicate identity is prevented; the tag is the join between the physical thing (its label) and its record. Serial numbers may stand in for the tag, and non-physical assets use their own identity (license key, subscription line).

### Custody is exclusive where checkout mechanics exist

In products built around check-out/check-in, an asset can normally have only one holder at a time, and check-in is a required step before reassignment. Other products express the same idea through deployment/assignment records. Either way, the intended outcome is the same: "who has it" should be an authoritative answer, not a guess.

### Status governs deployability

An asset's status determines what can be done with it: some statuses mean "can be assigned", others "cannot yet" (e.g., awaiting preparation), others "no longer assignable" (retired/archived). Assigning a deployable asset typically moves it into a deployed/assigned meta-state. Products differ in vocabulary; the pattern is stable.

### Disposal does not delete

Retired and disposed assets remain as archived records. The historical record is the point: audits, total-cost questions, and replacement planning all depend on what the estate *was*, not just what it is.

### The type/model layer inherits downward

Common attributes — depreciation profile, end-of-life, category defaults — are defined once on the type/model and inherited by instances, so an estate of thousands of assets stays administrable.

### Entitlement bounds allocation

License seats and subscription quantities cap how many users or devices may be allocated; the system compares purchased entitlement against actual deployment and exposes the compliance position. Over-deployment is a visible, reportable condition, not a silent one.

### Records require reconciliation

Discovery data, audits, and imports all serve one structural need: the record drifts from reality as assets move, and the system's authority depends on closing that gap. Verification is therefore a standing behavior of the Type, not an occasional feature.
leaves.rules_zh:
### 身份唯一且以物理锚定

每个硬件资产携带一个唯一的组织标识符（资产标签/编号）。防止身份重复；该标签是物理实体（其标签）与其记录之间的联接。序列号可以代替标签，非物理资产使用其自身的身份（许可密钥、订阅线路）。

### 在借出机制存在时，保管权是排他性的
