The library's resource universe.** The search domain is institution-bound and library-configured: the library's own catalog holdings plus the sources the library chooses to enable — subscription indexes, open-access content, institutional repository and digital-collection content, and (in some products) live connections to remote databases. The patron searches "what my library can get me," not an unbounded corpus. This is the platform's organizing container and the main structural fact separating it from general scholarly search.

**2. The query → record loop.** A search box (basic or fielded/advanced) returns a ranked list of **bibliographic records** — descriptions of works and resources with title, author, subject, format, publication data. Records are the unit of result; refinement (facets, filters, sort) narrows the list. The loop is the platform's primary interaction.

**3. Per-record obtainability.** Each record carries an availability/access expression and at least one path to obtain the item through this library:

- a link to read the item online (full text, e-book, streaming media)
- the print copy's location and loan status (which branch, on shelf / on loan)
- a request action (place a hold, request via interlibrary loan)
- shelf-position help for physical items

The success condition of the Type is "get this item from my library" — not merely "find a description of it."
leaves.dc_zh:
三大核心结构协同构成，移除其一则产品不再属于图书馆发现平台：
1. 图书馆的资源宇宙。搜索范围受机构绑定与图书馆配置限定：包含图书馆自有馆藏及图书馆授权启用的各类资源——订阅型索引、开放获取内容、机构知识库与数字馆藏内容，以及（部分产品中）对远程数据库的实时连接。用户搜索的是“本馆可提供的资源”，而非无界语料库。此为平台的组织容器，也是将其与通用学术搜索区分开的主要结构事实。
2. 查询→记录循环。搜索框（基础或字段化/高级）返回按相关性排序的书目记录列表——即对作品与资源的描述性元数据，包含题名、作者、主题、格式、出版信息等。记录是结果单元；通过分面、筛选与排序可细化结果。此循环构成平台的核心交互逻辑。
3. 单条记录的可获取性。每条记录承载资源状态表达，并至少提供一种通过本馆获取该资源的路径：
- 在线阅读链接（全文、电子书、流媒体）
- 纸本馆藏位置与流通状态（所属分馆、在架/借出中）
- 请求操作（预约、馆际互借申请）
- 实体文献的架位导航辅助
leaves.rules:
- **The universe is configured, not crawled.** What patrons can find is determined by what the library enabled. A missing subscription or unconfigured collection is invisible to the search, not merely unlinked.
- **Availability is live and external.** Loan status and access rights come from other systems (circulation, knowledge base, subscriptions) at display time. Stale or missing connections surface as patron-visible problems — wrong availability, missing full-text links, broken links — which libraries actively troubleshoot.
- **Entitlement gates access, not discovery.** Records for items the library does not own may still appear (from indexes or as requestable items); what changes is the get-it path — access links appear only where the library is entitled, and requests take over where it is not.
- **Guest vs signed-in.** Search and discovery are typically open; consequential actions (holds, ILL, and in most products saved lists) require sign-in with the library account.
- **Requests are handed off, not fulfilled.** The platform records the patron's request and forwards it to the operational system; fulfillment status lives in that system.
- **Same work, many records.** Editions, formats, and copies of a work may exist as multiple records across sources; products commonly group or link them and show availability per version.
- **Access links can break.** Because links are computed from holdings data against live publisher platforms, products provide patron-facing "report a problem" paths and staff-side diagnostics.
leaves.rules_zh:
- **宇宙是配置的，不是爬取的。** 读者能发现什么取决于图书馆启用了什么。缺少的订阅或未配置的馆藏对搜索不可见，而不仅仅是未链接。
- **可用性是实时和外部的。** 借出状态和访问权限来自其他系统（流通、知识库、订阅），在显示时获取。过时或缺失的连接会作为读者可见的问题出现——错误的可用性、缺失的全文链接、损坏的链接——图书馆会积极排查这些问题。
- **授权控制访问，而非发现。** 图书馆未拥有的物品记录仍可能显示（来自索引或作为可请求的物品）；改变的是获取路径——访问链接仅在图书馆有授权时出现，请求则在无授权时接管。
- **访客与已登录用户。** 搜索和发现通常开放；有后果的操作（预约、馆际互借，以及大多数产品中的保存列表）需要使用图书馆账户登录。
- **请求被转发，而非直接执行。** 平台记录读者的请求并将其转发给运营系统；执行状态存在于该系统中。
- **同一作品，多条记录。** 作品的版本、格式和副本可能在不同来源中作为多条记录存在；产品通常对这些记录进行分组或链接，并按版本显示可用性。
- **访问链接可能损坏。** 因为链接是从馆藏数据计算并链接到实时出版商平台，所以产品提供面向读者的“报告问题”路径和员工端的诊断工具。

leaves.name: Life Cycle Assessment Application
leaves.overview:
A **Life Cycle Assessment Application** is a modeling and assessment environment for product life cycles: it lets a practitioner build a quantified model of the processes behind a product, compile the environmental flows of that model into a life cycle inventory, and translate that inventory into environmental impact results using selectable impact assessment methods.

The defining core is small and held jointly:

```text
Product system (linked network of quantified unit processes)
└── anchored to a functional unit (the demand everything is normalized to)
    └── life cycle inventory (compiled flows over the whole network)
        └── impact assessment (characterization methods → impact results)
```

Everything else commonly associated with modern LCA software — licensed background databases, method libraries, contribution trees, Sankey diagrams, Monte Carlo uncertainty, parameters, EPD generation, cloud delivery — is widespread in current products but is not what makes the product an LCA application. Older desktop generations of the same product lineage, built before cloud delivery and bundled mega-databases, satisfy the same core; so does a code framework with no graphical interface at all.

When the center of gravity shifts from the product system to an organization's scopes and activity data, the product is drifting toward a different Application Type (Carbon Accounting Platform). When the deliverable narrows to a single impact category as the customer-facing output, it approaches the Product Carbon Footprint Platform.
leaves.overview_zh:
生命周期评估应用是一种用于产品生命周期的建模和评估环境：它允许从业者构建产品背后过程的量化模型，将该模型的环境流量汇编成生命周期清单，并使用可选择的评估方法将该清单转化为环境影响结果。

其定义核心小而共同持有：

```text
产品系统（量化单元过程的连接网络）
└── 锚定到功能单位（所有内容正常化的需求）
    └── 生命周期清单（整个网络的汇编流量）
        └── 影响评估（特征化方法 → 影响结果）
```

其他与现代 LCA 软件通常相关的所有内容——授权的背景数据库、方法库、贡献树、桑基图、蒙特卡洛不确定性、参数、EPD 生成、云交付——在当前产品中很普遍，但并非使该产品成为 LCA 应用的要素。同一产品系列的较旧桌面版本，在云交付和捆绑大型数据库之前构建，满足相同的核心；一个完全没有图形界面的代码框架也是如此。

当重心从产品系统转向组织的范围和活动数据时，该产品正漂移向不同的应用类型（碳核算平台）。当交付物缩减为以客户为导向的单一影响类别输出时，它接近产品碳足迹平台。
leaves.dc:
Three structures, held jointly, make the application what it is.

**1. The product system — a linked network of quantified unit processes.**
The central modeled object is not a document or a form; it is a *system*: a set of unit processes (raw material extraction, transport, manufacturing steps, energy provision, use, waste treatment) connected by flows. Each process carries quantified inputs and outputs of two kinds:

- **technosphere flows** (also called product or intermediate flows) — goods, materials, energy, and services exchanged *between* processes; these are the links of the network;
- **elementary flows** — resources drawn from, and emissions released to, the environment; these are what eventually become impacts.

Processes may be modeled at fine granularity (unit processes, each with its own inputs and links) or as aggregated blocks (a cradle-to-gate summary of everything upstream, treated as one record). Expert tools expose both forms and let the practitioner choose; the aggregated form is faster but hides its internals. The network is typically visualized as a graph the practitioner can inspect and edit link by link.

**2. The functional unit — the quantified anchor.**
Every model is calculated *for a demand*: a stated amount of function or reference flow (for example, a quantity of material, a packaged unit, a painted area). All flows in the network are scaled to deliver this demand, and all results are expressed per this unit. This is what makes two products comparable and what distinguishes an assessment from a pile of process data. Some studies, especially cradle-to-gate ones, use a simpler declared unit (per kilogram, per piece) instead of a full function-based unit; declarations under product category rules often prescribe the unit for a product group.

**3. The inventory → impact assessment calculation chain.**
When the practitioner runs a calculation, the application does two things in sequence:

- **Life cycle inventory (LCI):** it resolves the whole linked network — following every upstream link, scaling every flow — and compiles the total elementary flows attributable to the functional unit;
- **Life cycle impact assessment (LCIA):** it applies an impact assessment method — a set of characterization factors that convert each elementary flow into contributions to impact categories (climate change, acidification, eutrophication, resource use, human toxicity, and similar) — and produces the impact results.

The method layer is *selectable and separable*: the same model can be calculated under different methods, and methods are managed objects (importable, editable, with per-flow characterization factors). Single-category methods (for example, climate change only) are legitimate members of this layer; multi-impact breadth is the typical posture, not the definition.
leaves.dc_zh:
三个结构共同构成了该应用的本质。

1. 产品系统——量化单元过程的链接网络。
中心建模对象不是文档或表单，而是一个*系统*：一组单元过程（原材料提取、运输、制造步骤、能源供应、使用、废物处理）通过流连接。每个过程携带两种量化的输入和输出：技术圈流（也称为产品或中间流）——在过程之间交换的货物、材料、能源和服务；这些是网络的链接；基本流——从环境获取的资源和向环境排放的物质；这些最终成为影响。过程可以以精细粒度建模（每个单元过程有自己的输入和链接），或作为聚合块建模（所有上游的从摇篮到大门的摘要，作为一个记录处理）。专家工具暴露两种形式，让从业者选择；聚合形式更快但隐藏其内部结构。网络通常可视化为图，从业者可以逐链接检查和编辑。

2. 功能单元——量化锚点。
每个模型都是*为一个需求*计算的：指定数量的功能或参考流（例如，材料量、包装单元、涂漆面积）。网络中的所有流都缩放到这个功能单元。
leaves.rules:
### Everything is per functional unit

Results have no absolute meaning; they are impacts *of delivering the functional unit*. Changing the unit rescales the entire model. Comparing two products requires the same functional unit — a rule that also drives declaration standards, which prescribe units per product group.

### Boundary choices change results

Cradle-to-gate and cradle-to-grave models of the same product produce different numbers by construction. Omitting a known part of the value chain underestimates impacts; practitioners are expected to document boundaries and justify exclusions.

### Multifunctional processes force allocation decisions

Real processes often yield several products (and recycling loops couple systems). The practitioner must choose how to split burdens and benefits — allocation factors, recycled-content (cut-off) approaches, closed-loop assumptions, or substitution-based formulas. Different standards prescribe different approaches, and the choice materially changes results. This is one of the most consequential modeling decisions in the domain.

### Unit process vs aggregated process is a transparency trade-off

Fine-grained unit processes keep every upstream link inspectable; aggregated (system) processes collapse the upstream chain into a single record — faster and simpler, but a black box. Products ship databases in both forms and let the practitioner choose per study.

### Database and method must fit together

Background datasets are tied to database versions and, in some products, to method families. Mixing incompatible datasets and methods can silently produce zero or missing impacts — a known failure mode that products surface through validation checks and workspace settings.

### Cut-off is a modeling lever, not an error

Practitioners can exclude tiny contributors below a threshold to keep large networks manageable; the exclusion is deliberate, applied across the supply chain, and must be documented.

### Results feed claims, and claims invite scrutiny

Public comparisons and declarations typically require third-party verification. The application's role is to make the model transparent and reproducible — full network visibility, documented assumptions, exportable evidence — so that a verifier can reconstruct the result.

### The loop is iterative

Scope, data, and even the functional unit may be revised as data arrives; models are living artifacts that get updated when databases, methods, or products change.
leaves.rules_zh:
### 一切都按功能单位

结果没有绝对意义；它们是*提供功能单位*的影响。更改单位会重新缩放整个模型。比较两个产品需要相同的功能单位——这一规则也驱动声明标准，标准规定了每个产品组的单位。

### 边界选择改变结果

同一产品的摇篮到大门和摇篮到坟墓模型在结构上产生不同的数字。省略已知的价值链部分会低估影响；从业者需要记录边界并证明排除的合理性。

### 多功能过程迫使分配决策

实际过程通常产生多个产品（回收循环耦合系统）。从业者必须选择如何分割负担和收益——分配因素、回收含量（扣除）方法、闭环假设或基于替代的公式。不同的标准规定不同的方法，选择实质性地改变结果。这是该领域中最具影响力的建模决策之一。

### 单元过程与聚合过程是透明度权衡

精细的单元过程使每个上游链接可检查；聚合（系统）过程将上游链折叠成单个记录——更快更简单，但像一个黑匣子。产品以两种形式提供数据库，让从业者按研究选择。

### 数据库和方法必须匹配

背景数据集绑定到数据库版本，在某些产品中，绑定到方法族。混合不兼容的数据集和方法可能悄无声息地产生零或缺失的影响——一种已知的故障模式，产品通过验证检查和工作区设置来揭示。

### 扣除是建模杠杆，而非错误

从业者

leaves.name: Life Planning Application
leaves.overview:
A **Life Planning Application** is a personal application in which one person plans their own life. The person defines goals for the life they want — health, career, finances, relationships, personal growth — breaks each goal down into smaller tracked steps and supporting habits, records progress against those steps over time, and periodically reviews and adjusts the plan.

The defining structure is deliberately small:

```text
The person's own life (the subject of the plan)
└── Personally-defined goals of record
    └── Smaller tracked units (subgoals / milestones / action tasks)
        └── Progress recorded on those units, surfaced over time
```

Everything else commonly associated with this category — values and life-area taxonomies, vision and mission statements, SMART goal templates, habit trackers, journals, weekly review rituals, sharing with supporters or teams — is widespread in current products but is not what makes the product a life planning application. The same model works on paper with a worksheet and a pen; nothing in the definition requires cloud sync, apps, or AI.

When the system's subject stops being the person's own life and becomes an organization's objectives, or when the goal layer disappears and only tasks or habits remain, the product has crossed into a different Application Type (organizational goal/OKR platforms, task managers, habit trackers).
leaves.overview_zh:
一款**人生规划应用**是个人使用的软件，用于个人规划自身的人生。用户定义其期望人生的目标——健康、职业、财务、人际关系、个人成长——将每个目标分解为更小的可追踪步骤和支撑性习惯，随时间记录相对于这些步骤的进展，并定期审查和调整计划。

其定义性结构刻意保持精简：

```text
用户自身的人生（计划的主体）
└── 个人定义的目标记录
     └── 更小的可追踪单元（子目标 / 里程碑 / 行动任务）
         └── 记录在这些单元上的进展，随时间呈现
```

通常与此类别关联的其他所有内容——价值观和人生领域分类法、愿景和使命宣言、SMART 目标模板、习惯追踪器、日记、每周审查仪式、与支持者或团队共享——在当前产品中很普遍，但这并非使产品成为人生规划应用的关键。相同的模型在纸上配合工作表和笔即可运作；定义中没有任何内容要求云同步、应用程序或 AI。

当系统的主体不再是用户自身的人生，而变成组织的目标，或者当目标层消失且仅剩下任务或习惯时，该产品已跨越到不同的应用类型（组织目标/OKR 平台、任务管理器、习惯追踪器）。
leaves.dc:
- **Habits and trackers as support machinery.** Recurring behaviors (exercise, reading, saving) tracked on calendars or typed trackers (numeric, binary, count, monetary), and — where the product links them — attached to the goals they serve. In some products the tracker entries feed the goal's progress calculation.
- **Review and reflection surfaces.** Journals that combine free entries with an automatic, timestamped record of goal and task activity; charts and reports of progress over time; guidance or structure for a weekly or monthly review.
- **Time and scheduling surfaces.** Target dates and timescales on goals, recurring tasks, calendar views or calendar-feed sync, and weekly planning views that turn next actions into a scheduled week.
- **Sharing and accountability.** Opt-in sharing of goals with supporters or fellow goal-setters; comments and encouragement; team modes with per-goal privacy.
- **Templates.** Pre-authored goals with suggested action plans (and sometimes habits), for people who do not know how to decompose a goal themselves.
- **Motivation apparatus.** Vision boards, streaks, habit-strength measures, achievement charts — optional mechanics aimed at keeping the person engaged.
- **AI assistance.** Era-current: drafting a goal hierarchy from a described objective, suggesting action plans, advising on progress.
leaves.dc_zh:
- **习惯与追踪器作为支撑机制。** 在日历或专用追踪器（数值、二进制、计数、金额类型）上记录重复行为（如锻炼、阅读、储蓄），并——在产品相关联的情况下——与它们所服务的目标挂钩。在某些产品中，追踪器条目会为为目标的进度计算提供数据。
- **回顾与反思界面。** 结合自由记录与目标及任务活动的自动、带时间戳记录的日志；随时间推移的进度图表和报告；用于周度或月度回顾的指导或结构化视图。
- **时间与日程界面。** 目标上的目标日期和时间范围、重复任务、日历视图或日历源同步，以及将下一步行动转化为周计划的周计划视图。
- **分享与监督。** 选择性与支持者或共同目标设定者分享目标；评论与鼓励；具有按目标隐私控制的团队模式。
- **模板。** 预先编写的、附带建议行动计划（有时包含习惯）的目标模板，供不擅长自行分解目标的用户使用。
- **激励机制。** 愿景板、连续记录、习惯强度指标、成就图表——旨在保持用户参与度的可选机制。
- **AI辅助。** 时代特征功能：根据描述的目标草拟目标层级、建议行动计划、提供进度建议。
leaves.rules:
### Progress rolls upward

The most consequential behavior in the model: recording progress at the smallest units changes the state of everything above them. Completing a task moves its subgoal; moving subgoals moves the goal; the goal map or dashboard reflects the change immediately. In some products this roll-up is a literal computation (child task amounts summing to a goal quantity; completion percentages averaging up the hierarchy); in others it is a live visual update. Either way, the person records at the bottom and reads at the top.

### Goals are durable and revisited

Goals persist across sessions, weeks, and years, with target dates rather than disappearing after completion of a single action. The application is built for long-term return visits; stale goals are adjusted or retired during reviews rather than silently lost.

### Sharing changes visibility, not ownership

Even in products with sharing, supporters, or team modes, the default posture is private, and shared goals remain the person's own: others view and encourage, they do not reassign or re-scope the plan. Team modes expose progress of opted-in members only.

### Habits serve the plan where they exist

When a product includes habits, they are framed as machinery supporting goals — checked off on calendars, measured over time — rather than as an independent life record. Products whose habits stand alone with no goal above them are drifting toward a different shape of product.

### Motivation mechanics stay optional

Vision boards, streaks, and celebration moments are present in several products but are not load-bearing: the plan's integrity does not depend on them, and many products in the Type have none.
leaves.rules_zh:
### 进展向上汇总

模型中最具影响力的行为：在最小单元记录进展会改变其上方所有内容的状态。完成任务推动其子目标；子目标移动推动目标；目标地图或仪表盘立即反映变化。在某些产品中，这种汇总是一个字面计算（子任务数量相加得到目标数量；完成百分比沿层级平均向上）；在其他产品中，它是一个实时视觉更新。无论如何，用户在底部记录，在顶部阅读。

### 目标是持久且被重访的

目标跨会话、周和年持续存在，具有目标日期，而不是在完成单个行动后消失。应用为长期回访而构建；陈旧的目标在审查期间被调整或退役，而不是静默丢失。

### 共享改变可见性，而非所有权

即使在具有共享、支持者或团队模式的产品中，默认姿态是私有的，共享的目标仍属于用户个人：他人查看和鼓励，他们不重新分配或重新界定计划。团队模式仅暴露已选择加入成员的进展。

### 习惯在存在时服务于计划

当产品包含习惯时，它们被框定为支持目标的机制——在日历上勾选，随时间测量——而不是作为独立的人生记录。习惯独立存在且上方没有目标的产品正在漂向不同形态的产品。

### 动机机制保持可选

愿景板、连续记录和庆祝时刻存在于多个产品中，但不是承重的：计划的完整性不依赖于它们，且该类型中的许多产品没有任何这些机制。

leaves.name: Life Sciences QMS
leaves.name_zh: 生命科学质量管理系统(QMS)
aliases_zh: 生命科学质量管理软件
leaves.overview:
A **Life Sciences QMS** — in practice almost always sold as an **eQMS** (electronic quality management system) — is the quality function's system of record in regulated life-sciences organizations: pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device companies, plus closely adjacent regulated industries. It holds the organization's quality events (deviations, nonconformances, out-of-specification results, complaints), its corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), its change controls, and its audits as individually identified, state-tracked, cross-linked records; it moves every record through a governed closed-loop workflow with recorded approvals; and it maintains all of it as traceable evidence that the organization is operating its quality system as regulators expect.

Three properties together define the Type:

```text
Quality records of record
└── events (deviations / nonconformances / OOS / complaints)
    + actions (investigations / CAPA / change controls)
└── governed closed-loop workflows
    └── capture → investigation → approval → implementation → verification → closure
└── regulated-regime evidence posture
    └── attributed approvals, complete history, retained and retrievable for inspection
```

Remove the record population and what remains is a document library or training tracker. Remove the workflow machinery and what remains is a static quality register. Remove the evidence posture — attributed signatures, complete history, inspection readiness — and what remains is a generic issue tracker with quality vocabulary.

Everything else the category is known for — controlled SOP documents, training management, risk management, supplier quality, analytics, validation support — is a standard and nearly universal capability layer, but it is modular rather than definitional: vendors package these as add-ons or entry tiers, and each is also a standalone product category in its own right.
leaves.overview_zh:
一个**生命科学QMS** — 实际上几乎总是作为**eQMS**（电子质量管理系统）销售 — 是受监管生命科学组织中质量职能的记录系统：制药、生物技术和医疗设备公司，以及密切相关的受监管行业。它保存组织的质量事件（偏差、不符合项、规格外结果、投诉），其纠正和预防措施（CAPA），其变更控制，以及其审计，作为单独标识、状态跟踪、交叉链接的记录；它将每个记录通过一个受控的闭环工作流移动，带有记录的批准；并将所有这些维护为可追溯的证据，表明组织正在按照监管机构的期望运行其质量系统。

三个属性共同定义了类型：

```text
正式质量记录
└── 事件（偏差 / 不符合项 / OOS / 投诉）
    + 行动（调查 / CAPA / 变更控制）
└── 受控闭环工作流
    └── 捕获 → 调查 → 批准 → 实施 → 验证 → 关闭
└── 受监管体制证据姿态
    └── 归因批准、完整历史、保留并可检索以供检查
```

移除记录填充，剩下的就是一个文档库或培训跟踪器。移除工作流机制，剩下的就是一个静态质量登记册。移除证据姿态 — 归因签名、完整历史、检查准备就绪 — 剩下的就是一个带有质量词汇的通用问题跟踪器。

该类别已知的所有其他内容 — 受控SOP文档、培训管理、风险管理、供应商质量、分析、验证支持 — 是一个标准且几乎通用的能力层，但它是模块化的而非定义性的：供应商将这些打包为附加组件或入门级，每个本身也是一个独立的产品类别。
leaves.dc:
**Quality events.** The reactive record class: something departed from expectation and must be formally recorded and resolved. Common event types share one abstract shape:

- **Deviation** — a departure from an approved process or procedure during production or testing
- **Nonconformance** — identified nonconforming material, product, or component, with a disposition (use-as-is, rework, reject, return)
- **Out-of-specification (OOS) result** — a laboratory result outside acceptance criteria, with its own investigation discipline
- **Complaint** — an external report of a product problem, received through a dedicated intake and evaluated for regulatory reportability

Every event is an individually identified record carrying what happened, where, when, on which product/batch, its classification and risk, and its workflow state.

**Investigation.** The record (or phase) in which causes are established — root cause analysis, evidence, impact assessment. Events that are trivial may close without deep investigation; significant ones require a documented one.

**CAPA (corrective and preventive action).** The signature action record of the Type: a planned response to an event or risk — corrections, corrective actions addressing root cause, preventive actions preventing recurrence — with owners, due dates, and a verification step. In mature implementations an event can escalate into a CAPA, and a CAPA can spawn further records.

**Change control.** The proactive record class: a proposed change to a process, document, product, specification, or system — requested, assessed for risk and downstream impact, approved, implemented, and verified. In regulated operations *nothing significant changes informally*; the change control record is how change becomes legitimate.

**Audit.** The scheduled record class: internal audits, supplier audits, and compliance/registration audits, each producing findings that become tracked actions connected to the rest of the system.

**Approval and signature.** Every meaningful stage transition is gated by a recorded approval. In current products this is an attributed electronic signature under e-records regulations; conceptually it is simply that *a named person approved this step, at this time, and that approval is preserved*.

**Traceability links.** The connective tissue that makes the system a system rather than a set of forms: events link to affected products, batches, documents, and suppliers; CAPAs link to the events that triggered them and the changes they launch; changes link to the documents they revise and the training those revisions trigger; audit findings link to CAPAs. The links are first-class records — surfacing "what is affected" is one of the main things the software does.
leaves.dc_zh:
质量事件。反应性记录类别：某些内容偏离了预期，必须正式记录并解决。常见事件类型共享一个抽象形状：
- 偏差——在生产或测试过程中偏离批准的过程或程序
- 不合格——识别出的不合格材料、产品或组件，附带处置（使用现状、返工、拒绝、退货）
- 超出规格(OOS)结果——超出接受标准的实验室结果，有其自身的调查规程
- 投诉——通过专用接收渠道收到的关于产品问题的外部报告，并评估其监管报告性
每个事件都是一个单独标识的记录，携带发生的内容、地点、时间、涉及的产品/批次、其分类和风险，以及其工作流状态。
调查。建立原因的记录（或阶段）——根本原因分析、证据、影响评估。琐碎的事件可能无需深入调查即可关闭；重要的事件需要有文档记录的调查。
CAPA（纠正和预防措施）。该类型的标志性行动记录：对事件或风险的计划响应——纠正、针对根本原因的纠正行动、防止复发的预防行动——附带责任人、截止日期和验证步骤。在成熟的实施中，一个事件可以升级为CA
leaves.rules:
- **Nothing moves without recorded approval.** Stage transitions are gated; each approval is attributed to a named person with a timestamp. Separation of duties is common — the person who performs work is often not the person who approves it, and QA holds disposition authority for significant decisions.
- **History is never silently rewritten.** Every change to a record leaves a trace — who, what, when. Records are corrected by adding to the record, not overwriting it. This is the behavior regulators check first, and the products are built around it.
- **Closure is earned.** CAPAs close only after effectiveness verification; changes close only after implementation is verified; deviations close after investigation and disposition. Overdue and aging records are surfaced, not hidden.
- **The document is the law.** Work is performed against the current effective version of a controlled document; superseded versions are withdrawn from use but preserved. A document revision propagates: new version → training assignments → affected records updated.
- **Linkage is systemic, not optional.** Creating a record prompts (or requires) linking affected products, documents, batches, and suppliers; deleting or ignoring the links breaks the traceability the system exists to provide.
- **Records are retained and retrievable.** Long retention periods and on-demand assembly of records for inspection are baseline expectations; export of complete linked records is a real, exercised capability.
- **The software itself is regulated.** The QMS is expected to run as a validated, e-records-compliant system; vendors support this by delivering validated releases, validation documentation, and audit-trail/e-signature machinery. This is a constraint on how the product evolves and how customers may configure it — a rule unusual among application types.
leaves.rules_zh:
- **没有记录批准，任何事情都不会发生。** 阶段转换被把关；每个批准归因于带时间戳的指定人员。职责分离很常见 — 执行工作的人通常不是批准它的人，QA对重大决策持有处置权。
- **历史从未被静默重写。** 记录的每个更改都留下痕迹 — 谁、什么、何时。记录通过添加到记录来纠正，而不是覆盖它。这是监管机构首先检查的行为，产品也是围绕它构建的。
- **关闭是赢得的。** CAPA仅在有效性验证后关闭；变更仅在实施验证后关闭；偏差在调查和处置后关闭。过期和逾期记录被显示，而不是隐藏。
- **文档是法律。** 工作针对受控文档的当前有效版本执行；废止版本被撤回使用但保留。文档修订传播：新版本 → 培训分配 → 更新受影响的记录。
- **链接是系统性的，而不是可选的。** 创建记录会提示（或要求）链接受影响的产品、文档、批次和供应商；删除或忽略链接会破坏系统存在的可追溯性。
- **记录被保留并可检索。** 长保留期和按需组装记录供检查是基线期望；导出完整链接记录是实际行使的能力。
- **软件本身受监管。** QMS被期望作为已验证的、符合电子记录的系统运行；供应商通过提供已验证版本、验证文档和审计跟踪/电子签名机制来支持这一点。这对产品如何演进和客户如何可能配置是一个约束。

leaves.name: Link-in-Bio Platform
leaves.overview:
A **Link-in-Bio Platform** is a self-service web application that publishes a single, stable-addressed public micro-page for a person or brand — a compact, mobile-first page whose content is an ordered stack of tappable outbound links with a few supporting blocks — assembled without code from the platform's blocks and themes, hosted by the platform at a stable URL (commonly a username address), and built to be placed in the single external-link slot of a social profile so that one URL carries the profile's audience to all of the owner's destinations.

The defining structure is small:

```text
Personal identity with one stable public URL (the bio page)
└── Ordered stack of blocks
    └── Tappable outbound link (label → destination) as the primary unit
└── No-code assembly and instant hosting by the platform
└── Profile-slot distribution: one URL standing in for all destinations
```

Everything else commonly associated with the category — themes, per-link click analytics, QR codes, email capture, social-post grids, payment blocks, custom domains — is standard in current products or optional, but is not what makes the product a link-in-bio platform. When the page becomes content-first (a site or blog), campaign-first (a landing page distributed through ads), or transaction-first (a shop with a catalog and checkout), it has drifted into a different Application Type.
leaves.overview_zh:
一个 **Link-in-Bio 平台** 是一个自助式网络应用，为个人或品牌发布一个单一、地址稳定的公共微型页面——这是一个紧凑的、移动优先的页面，其内容是一个有序堆叠的可点击外向链接以及一些辅助模块——无需代码，由平台的模块和主题组装而成，并由平台托管在一个稳定的 URL 上（通常是用户名地址），其设计目的是放置在社交媒体档案的单一外部链接插槽中，从而让一个 URL 将档案的所有受众引导至所有者的所有目标地址。

其定义性结构很小：

```text
拥有一个稳定公共 URL（即 bio 页面）的个人身份
└── 有序的模块堆叠
    └── 可点击的外向链接（标签 → 目的地）作为主要单元
└── 由平台进行无代码组装和即时托管
└── 档案插槽分发：一个 URL 代表所有目的地
```

其他通常与此类别相关的一切——主题、每个链接的点击分析、QR 码、邮件捕获、社交帖子网格、支付模块、自定义域名——在现有产品中是标准配置或可选项，但并非定义该产品为 link-in-bio 平台的本质。当页面变为内容优先（如一个网站或博客）、活动优先（一个通过广告分发的落地页），或交易优先（一个带有商品目录和结账功能的商店）时，它就已偏离到另一种应用类型。
leaves.dc:
Four properties, each load-bearing. Remove any one and the product stops being recognizable as this Type:

- **One hosted micro-page per identity at a stable address.** The platform serves the page; the owner does not run infrastructure. The address is stable over time — typically a username URL on the platform's domain, with a custom domain as an upgrade. Without hosting and stable addressing, it is just a collection of links, not a product.
- **Link aggregation as the content model.** The page's content is an ordered stack of blocks, and the primary block is the tappable outbound link — a label pointing to a destination elsewhere (another profile, a shop, a video, an article, a booking page). The page is deliberately not content-first: it aggregates destinations rather than hosting articles, products, or feeds of its own. Without aggregation-first content, it is a personal homepage or blog.
- **No-code, tool-owned assembly and instant publishing.** The owner composes from tool-provided blocks and themes, toggles items on and off, reorders them, and the change is live on the public URL with no engineering and no deployment step. Without this, it is a hand-built website.
- **Profile-slot distribution posture.** The page exists to be parked in the external-link slot of a social profile (or an equivalent personal surface — email signature, QR code, embedded tile), so the audience that already follows the owner can reach everything through one URL. Without this posture, it is a campaign landing page, distributed through advertising or search.

The single-link constraint of modern social profiles is the category's historical trigger — products name it explicitly in their own pitch ("social networks allow only one link in a profile") — but the definition does not depend on any particular platform's rule set: the posture is "one stable personal URL aggregating all destinations, placed wherever a profile allows."
leaves.dc_zh:
四项核心属性，缺一不可。移除任何一项，产品将不再符合此类型：

- **为每个身份提供一个托管于稳定地址的微型页面。** 平台托管该页面；所有者无需自行运维。该地址随时间保持稳定——通常是平台域名下的用户名网址，自定义域名为可选升级。若无托管和稳定地址，它只是一个链接集合，而非产品。
- **以链接聚合为内容模型。** 页面内容是一个有序的区块堆栈，其中首要区块是可点击的外链——一个指向外部目的地（如另一账号、商店、视频、文章、预约页）的标签。页面内容并非以内容本身为核心，而是聚合外部目的地，而非托管文章、产品或自身内容流。若无聚合优先的内容，它只是个人主页或博客。
- **无代码、工具化组装与即时发布。** 所有者通过工具提供的区块和主题进行组合，启用/禁用项目并重新排序，更改即刻在公开URL生效，无需工程开发或部署步骤。若无此特性，它只是一个手工构建的网站。
- **个人主页插槽的分发定位。** 该页面旨在被置于社交账号简介（或等效个人界面——如邮件签名、二维码、嵌入式卡片）的外链插槽中，以便受众。
leaves.rules:
- **The address is permanent; the content is not.** The page's URL is meant to be set once and never changed — that is what makes it safe to print, embed, and paste into a bio. Everything else on the page is disposable and frequently rearranged.
- **Visibility is per-link state.** A hidden or disabled link simply does not render on the public page; owners hide rather than delete when a destination is temporary. Pinned links commonly resist reordering — pinning is a deliberate override of the stack order.
- **Everything must fit through one URL.** The profile-slot constraint is structural: the page's value comes from aggregating destinations that the profile itself cannot host. Products that add on-page commerce are extending past the profile slot, toward commerce Types.
- **Commerce is outbound by default.** The canonical page points to shops, bookings, and payment pages elsewhere; it does not itself operate a catalog and checkout. Where a product lets the page take payments or sell files directly, it is approaching the storefront and digital-product Types (see Related Application Types).
- **The page lives on the platform's domain unless upgraded.** Custom domains and branding removal are monetization levers; the free page is hosted under the platform's brand.
- **Usernames are claimable and disputable.** Identity is first-come; some products run dispute processes when usernames conflict, and some throttle how often a username can be changed.
- **Measurement is plan-tiered.** Click and view tracking is standard at every tier in the researched sample, but history windows, filters, and export are commonly reserved for paid plans.
- **Trust is enforced on the page.** Published content rules, violation reporting, and content-level gates (sensitive-content warnings, age confirmation) exist because the page is a public destination operated by an anonymous-capable owner.
leaves.rules_zh:
- **地址是永久的；内容不是。** 页面的 URL 旨在设置一次且永不更改——这就是为什么它可以安全地打印、嵌入和粘贴到个人简介中的原因。页面上的其他所有内容都是可丢弃且经常重新排列的。
- **可见性是每个链接的状态。** 隐藏或禁用的链接只是不在公共页面上渲染；当目的地是临时的时，所有者会选择隐藏而不是删除。置顶链接通常抵制重新排序——置顶是对堆叠顺序的刻意覆盖。
- **所有内容必须通过一个 URL 容纳。** 档案插槽的限制是结构性的：页面的价值来自于聚合档案本身无法托管的目的地。添加页面内电子商务的产品正在超越档案插槽，向电商类型拓展。
- **电子商务默认是外向的。** 典型的页面指向其他地方的商店、预订和支付页面；它本身不运营商品目录和结账。如果产品允许页面直接收取支付或销售文件，则它正在接近店面和数字产品类型（参见相关应用类型）。
- **除非升级，否则页面托管在平台的域名上。** 自定义域名和品牌移除是变现手段；免费页面托管在平台品牌下。
- **用户名可注册且可争议。** 身份遵循先到先得原则；一些产品在用户名冲突时运行争议流程，一些产品则限制用户名更改的频率。
- **度量功能按套餐层级划分。** 在研究样本中，每个层级都提供点击和浏览跟踪功能，但历史记录窗口、筛选器和导出功能通常仅限于付费计划。
- **信任在页面上强制执行。** 已发布的内容规则、违规举报以及内容级别限制（敏感内容警告、年龄限制）。

leaves.name: Liquidity Management Platform
leaves.overview:
A **Liquidity Management Platform** is finance-team software that keeps an organization's liquidity adequate over time. It consolidates the organization's available cash and funding — held across many bank accounts, legal entities, and currencies — into a single inspectable position; projects that position forward against scheduled and expected inflows and outflows to expose future headroom or shortfall; and turns those projections into funding and deployment actions: moving cash where it is needed, drawing or repaying funding, deploying surpluses, and timing payments.

The defining structure is deliberately small:

```text
Consolidated whole-organization liquidity position
└── Date-aware projection of future liquidity
    └── Steering loop: funding and deployment decisions
        └── Results recorded back into the position
```

Everything else commonly bundled into these products — automated bank connectivity, transaction tagging, scenario modeling, cash pooling, AI forecasting, in-product payment execution — is standard mature machinery or optional extension, not what makes the product a liquidity management platform. A treasurer working from bank statements, a rolling forecast, and a list of credit facilities satisfies the same conceptual core without any of them.

When the product's center of gravity shifts to only today's balances and money movement, it becomes a cash management platform. When instrument-level management (debt portfolios, derivatives, hedge accounting) becomes primary, it becomes a treasury management system.
leaves.overview_zh:
一个**流动性管理平台**是财务团队使用的软件，旨在确保组织的流动性在整个周期内保持充足。它将组织分散在多个银行账户、法律实体和币种中的可用现金与资金，整合到一个可集中审视的头寸中；基于该头寸，结合已知与预期的现金流入流出，向前预测未来头寸的变化，以揭示未来的资金富余或短缺；并将这些预测转化为资金调配与运用的行动：将现金调拨至所需之处，提取或偿还资金，部署富余资金，并安排支付时机。

其核心结构刻意设计得非常精简：

```text
跨整个组织整合后的流动性头寸
└── 基于日期的未来流动性预测
    └── 控制环路：资金与部署决策
        └── 结果反馈回录至头寸
```

其他通常包含在此类产品中的功能——自动化银行连接、交易标签、情景模拟、现金池、AI预测、产品内支付执行——都是成熟的标准化组件或可选扩展，并非定义流动性管理平台的核心。一位财务主管仅依靠银行对账单、滚动预测和信贷额度清单，无需上述任何技术，也能满足同一核心概念。

当产品的重心仅转移至当日余额与资金划转时，它就演变为一个现金管理平台。当以工具级别管理（债务组合、衍生品、套期会计）成为主要功能时，它则成为一个财资管理系统。
leaves.dc:
**1. The consolidated liquidity position.** The platform's foundational object is one picture of the organization's immediately available liquid resources, assembled from all its bank accounts and organized by entity, bank, account, and currency. In mature products the position extends beyond raw balances to what is *available*: unused credit lines and overdraft facilities, liquid investments, and intercompany balances. Without this consolidation the product degenerates into per-bank portals; the whole-organization, one-picture property is what the Type exists to provide.

**2. The date-aware liquidity projection.** On top of the position sits a projection: dated inflows and outflows — committed payments, scheduled receipts, recurring flows, debt service, plan-derived estimates — laid onto the current balances to produce expected liquidity by date, entity, and currency over a defined horizon. The projection converts a static balance sheet into an answer to the question that defines liquidity itself: *can the organization meet its obligations as they fall due?* It exposes, at any chosen date, the expected headroom or shortfall.

**3. The liquidity steering loop.** The projection is not a report; it is the input to decisions the platform tracks. Expected shortfalls trigger funding actions — moving cash between accounts and entities, drawing facilities, intercompany funding. Expected surpluses trigger deployment — investments, debt repayment. The projected and actual positions are the shared reference against which these actions are chosen, and their results flow back into the position. Without this loop the product is liquidity monitoring; with it, it is management.

The three are jointly load-bearing: a position with actions but no projection is a cash-positioning tool; a projection without a consolidated actual position is budgeting; a position and projection with no action machinery is reporting.
leaves.dc_zh:
**1. 整合的流动性头寸。** 该平台的基础对象是组织即时可用的流动性资源的一幅全景图，这些资源汇集自所有银行账户，并按实体、银行、账户和币种组织。在成熟产品中，该头寸超越原始余额，延伸至 *可用的* 部分：未使用的授信额度和透支便利、流动性投资以及公司间余额。缺乏这种整合，该产品会退化为按银行划分的门户；而提供组织级、全景式的视图，正是该软件类型存在的意义。

**2. 日期感知的流动性预测。** 在头寸之上，是一个预测：将有日期的流入和流出——已承诺的付款、计划内的收款、经常性现金流、债务偿还、基于计划的估算——叠加到当前余额之上，从而生成一个定义的时间范围内、按日期、实体和币种划分的预期流动性状况。该预测将静态的资产负债表转化为一个回答流动性本质问题的答案：*组织能否在义务到期时履行？* 它在任何选定的日期，揭示预期的资金余量或短缺。

**3. 流动性引导循环。** 该预测不是一份报告；它是平台跟踪决策的输入。预期的短缺会触发融资操作——在账户和实体间调拨现金、提取授信额度、公司间融资。该循环将预测转化为行动，使组织能够主动管理其流动性状况。
leaves.rules:
### The position is derived, not authoritative

The platform consolidates balances and transactions that originate in banks and business systems; it is not the ledger in which money itself is recorded. Corrections to actual balances happen at the source (or as documented adjustments), which distinguishes this Type from accounting systems of record. What the platform *is* authoritative for is the consolidated view and the forecast built on it.

### Actuals replace estimates

A projected flow is an estimate until its date arrives and the real transaction clears; forecasts roll forward as actuals land. The forecast-vs-actual comparison is a first-class behavior, not an afterthought — forecast quality is one of the product's headline virtues, and variance analysis by entity and category is the standard way users improve it.

### Headroom constrains funding

A planned funding action is only as good as the capacity behind it. Facility headroom, intercompany balances, and liquid holdings bound what can be drawn or moved, and maturity dates, covenants, and repayment schedules constrain *when*. Mature products therefore keep funding capacity as a tracked object feeding the projection, not a static list.

### Consolidation requires translation and grouping discipline

Multi-entity organizations need balances expressed in a common currency at group level and intercompany positions handled so they are visible rather than silently netted away. How entities, accounts, and pools map into the group structure is configuration the finance team owns, and wrong mappings corrupt every figure above them.

### Freshness varies

How current the position is depends on the connectivity behind it — real-time API feeds, periodic statement files, or manual imports differ materially. Products present the position as a live operational surface, but the operational claim is only as strong as the data pipeline; refresh cadence is a deployment property, not a definitional one.

### Actions carry control obligations

Where the platform executes money movement, actions pass through authorization — approval workflows, role-based permissions, fraud and sanctions checks are standard companions. Where it only recommends, the control burden sits with the banking channels the recommendation feeds.
leaves.rules_zh:
### 头寸是衍生的，而非权威的

平台整合来自银行和业务系统的余额与交易；它本身不是记录资金本身的账簿。对实际余额的纠正发生在源头（或作为有文档记录的调整），这将此类平台与权威记账系统区分开来。平台*具有*权威性的是其整合后的视图以及基于此构建的预测。

### 实际值替代估算值

一个预测的现金流在预计日期到来且真实交易完成结算之前，都只是估算值；随着实际值的落地，预测会向前滚动。预测与实际值的比较是一等公民行为，而非事后补充——预测质量是该产品的主要优点之一，按实体和类别进行差异分析是用户提升预测质量的标准方法。

### 富余空间约束融资

一个计划中的融资行动，其有效性完全取决于背后可用的能力。信贷额度富余空间、内部公司余额和流动性持有量，限制了能够提取或划转的金额，而到期日、契约条款和还款计划则约束了*何时*可以进行。因此，成熟的产品会将融资能力作为一个被追踪的对象来反馈至预测中，而非一个静态列表。

### 整合需要换算与分组纪律

多实体组织需要以集团层面的通用币种来表达余额，并且内部公司头寸需要得到处理，使其可见而非被静默地净额抵消。实体、账户和资金池如何映射到集团结构，是财务团队负责的配置任务，错误的映射会扭曲其上方的所有数据。

### 新鲜度各有不同

头寸的实时程度取决于其背后的连接方式——实时API数据流、定期报表文件或手动导入，差异显著。产品呈现

leaves.name: Liquidity Risk Platform
leaves.overview:
A **Liquidity Risk Platform** is the software a financial institution uses to hold and manage the risk that it cannot meet its obligations as they fall due — its liquidity risk. It maintains a consolidated view of the institution's funding position (the balance sheet as a structure of cash flows and liquid-asset buffers), translates that position into adequacy measures under both current and stressed conditions, and keeps the whole state monitored and controlled against the institution's liquidity risk appetite.

It answers, continuously and for the whole institution: *can we pay what is coming due — today, during the day, and under stress — and are we still inside the liquidity risk we said we would take?*

The defining core is three structures that only work together:

```text
Liquidity position of record
  (the balance sheet's funding structure: assets, liabilities,
   commitments as cash flows, with the liquid-asset buffer identified)
└── Liquidity adequacy measures
      (coverage of net outflows, structural funding, maturity mismatch —
       under the current view and under stressed assumptions)
    └── Ongoing monitoring & control vs liquidity risk appetite
          (limits, thresholds, buffer requirements, early warnings,
           breach handling, governance and regulatory reporting)
```

Everything else commonly associated with modern liquidity risk management — named regulatory ratios (LCR/NSFR-family), intraday payment-flow monitoring, HQLA buffer optimization, behavioral deposit models, contingency funding plan workflows — is widespread in current products but is not what makes the product a liquidity risk platform.

When the primary seat shifts from the financial institution's risk function to a corporate finance function steering its own cash, the product is a different Application Type (Liquidity Management Platform); when the same machinery is extended to aggregate across market, credit and liquidity risk on one institutional view, it becomes the layer of a Financial Risk Management Platform.
leaves.overview_zh:
一个**流动性风险平台**是金融机构用于持有和管理其无法按时履行义务风险——即流动性风险——的软件。它维护着该机构融资状况的统一视图（资产负债表作为现金流与流动性资产缓冲的结构），将该状况转化为当前和压力情况下的充足性度量指标，并根据该机构的流动性风险偏好对整个状态进行监控和管控。

它持续地、针对整个机构回答：*我们能否支付到期款项——今天、日内以及在压力情况下——并且我们是否仍在我们设定的流动性风险限额内？*

其定义核心是三个仅协同工作的结构：

```text
记录的流动性状况
  （资产负债表的融资结构：资产、负债、
   承诺作为现金流，并识别出流动性资产缓冲）
└── 流动性充足性度量
      （净流出覆盖、结构性融资、期限错配——
       基于当前视图和压力假设）
    └── 持续监控与控制 vs 流动性风险偏好
          （限额、阈值、缓冲要求、早期预警、
           违规处理、治理与监管报告）
```

其他通常与现代流动性风险管理相关的一切——命名的监管比率（LCR/NSFR系列）、日内支付流量监控、HQLA缓冲优化、行为存款模型、应急资金计划工作流——在当前产品中很普遍，但并非使该产品成为流动性风险平台的本质。

当主要使用者从金融机构的风险部门转向管理自身现金流的企业财务部门时，该产品属于不同的应用类型（流动性管理平台）；当同样的机制扩展到在单一机构视图下整合市场、信用和流动性风险时，它就成为风险管理平台的一层。
leaves.dc:
Three properties. If any one is removed, the product is no longer recognizable as a liquidity risk platform:

- **Liquidity position of record** — the system holds the institution's funding structure as an inspectable whole: assets, liabilities and off-balance-sheet commitments organized by maturity, product, currency and legal entity, with the stock of liquid assets identified as the buffer. In mature implementations this view is built from deal- or instrument-level data — banking-book positions, securities inventories including pledged and repo collateral — so every figure can be traced to its source. Without this, the product is a calculator or a cash view with nothing to measure.
- **Liquidity adequacy measures under current and stressed views** — the position is translated into governed quantities of the institution's ability to meet obligations as they fall due: how much of the coming net outflows is covered by liquid assets, how structurally stable the funding is, where the maturity mismatches sit. Every such measure is a function of assumptions — how fast deposits run off, how much funding rolls over, what the buffer consists of — and the same position is measured under the current view and under stressed assumptions. Without this, the product is cash-flow reporting; the "risk" half is gone.
- **Ongoing monitoring and control against liquidity risk appetite** — the liquidity state is kept under continuous supervision: compared against limits, thresholds and buffer requirements, surfaced through early-warning indicators, with breaches and exceptions worked to resolution and results reported to liquidity governance (ALCO, board) and into prudential compliance. Stress outcomes connect to funding contingency decisions where the institution maintains them. Without this, the product is a one-off calculation tool rather than an operating platform.
leaves.dc_zh:
三项核心属性。移除任何一项，该产品将不再被识别为流动性风险平台：

- **流动性头寸记录** — 系统将机构的融资结构作为一个可检视的整体持有：资产、负债及表外承诺按到期日、产品、货币和法律实体组织，流动资产存量被识别为缓冲。在成熟实施中，此视图构建自交易或工具级数据——银行账簿头寸、证券库存（包括质押和回购抵押品）——因此每个数字都可追溯至其源头。若缺失此属性，产品将退化为计算器或现金流视图，缺乏度量对象。

- **当前与压力情景下的流动性充足率度量** — 将头寸转化为对机构到期偿付能力的受控度量：未来净流出中有多少被流动资产覆盖、融资结构稳定性如何、期限错配分布在何处。每项度量均基于假设（存款流失速度、融资续作比例、缓冲构成等），同一头寸需在当前视图和压力假设下分别度量。若缺失此属性，产品将沦为现金流报告，'风险'维度不复存在。

- **针对流动性风险偏好的持续监控与控制** — 流动性缓冲是否足以覆盖压力情景下的净流出、风险限额是否被突破、预警指标是否触发。若缺失此属性，产品仅是度量工具而非风险管理平台。
leaves.rules:
### The stressed view is the point

A liquidity measure without defined outflow assumptions answers nothing: the same balance sheet is safe or failing depending on run-off and rollover assumptions. The assumption layer is therefore a first-class, governed object — versioned, validated, and changed through controlled processes, because changing an assumption changes every computed measure.

### The position must reconcile

Measures are computed from deal-level positions aggregated from source systems; discrepancies undermine every downstream number. Mature platforms invest in lineage and reconciliation — from top-of-house totals down to single deals and single cash flows.

### Prudential and internal views coexist

The same position carries regulatory-compliance measures and internal risk-management measures. Mature platforms keep both consistent on one data foundation rather than letting each become a separate unreconciled computation.

### Ratios have time

Liquidity measures are watched as history and forecast, not only as point-in-time values: how a ratio and its components moved, and where it is heading under current behavior and under scenarios.

### Two clocks, one risk

Daily ratio governance and intraday payment-flow monitoring measure the same risk on different clocks. Products differ in how deeply they integrate the intraday loop; some institutions run it as a separate system — a packaging question, not a different risk.

### Breaches are processes, not just flags

A limit or threshold breach typically enters an investigation-and-resolution workflow: cause analysis, ownership, escalation, a decision (adjust funding, rebalance the buffer, trigger contingency measures, accept), and a recorded outcome.
leaves.rules_zh:
### 压力视图是关键

一个没有明确流出假设的流动性度量无法回答任何问题：同一张资产负债表在不同的自然到期和展期假设下可能安全也可能失败。因此，假设层是一个一等公民、受治理的对象——受版本控制、验证，并通过受控流程变更，因为变更假设会改变每个计算出的度量指标。

### 头寸必须对账

度量指标是基于从源系统汇总的交易级别头寸计算得出的；差异会破坏所有下游数据。成熟的平台在数据沿袭和对账方面投入资源——从机构总部汇总数据一直到单笔交易和单笔现金流。

### 审慎视图与内部视图共存

同一份头寸承载着监管合规度量和内部风险管理度量。成熟的平台在一个数据基础上保持两者一致，而不是让每个都成为独立且未经对账的计算。

### 比率具有时间维度

流动性度量被作为历史和预测来观察，而不仅仅是时点值：比率及其组成部分如何变动，以及在当前行为和情景下它将走向何方。

### 两个时钟，同一风险

每日比率治理和日内支付流量监控在不同的时钟上度量同一风险。产品在集成日内循环的深度上有所不同；有些机构将其作为独立系统运行——这是一个产品包装问题，而非不同的风险。

### 违规是流程，而不仅是标记

限额或阈值违规通常会进入调查和解决工作流：原因分析、责任归属、升级、决策（调整融资、重新平衡缓冲、触发应急措施、接受）以及记录结果。

leaves.name: Listing Marketplace
leaves.overview:
A **Listing Marketplace** is a platform that aggregates structured listings — records describing specific things offered for sale, rent, or exchange — from many listers into one searchable inventory, helps seekers find and compare what is on offer, and connects each interested seeker with the lister behind the listing. The platform's defining loop ends at that connection: the sale, lease, or contract itself is concluded between the parties off-platform.

The defining core is small:

```text
Listing of record
└── Pooled searchable inventory
    └── Seeker → lister connection
        └── Off-platform deal completion
```

- **Listing of record** — a structured, standardized record describing one specific offered thing: its attributes, media, price or terms, and the identity of the lister who published it.
- **Pooled searchable inventory** — listings from many independent listers gathered into a single searchable, filterable pool organized by category, attributes, and location.
- **Seeker → lister connection** — an inquiry or contact path that hands the seeker to the lister to start the deal conversation.
- **Off-platform deal completion** — the platform connects the parties; it does not execute the underlying transaction as a merchant. Transaction-adjacent services (reservations, deposits, finance introductions) may exist as optional layers, but the commercial agreement is made between lister and seeker.

Remove the standardized listing structure and the pool becomes a free-form classifieds board. Remove the connection path and it becomes a published catalog with no commerce. Let the platform execute the transaction and it becomes a transactional marketplace or booking platform.
leaves.overview_zh:
一个**列表市场（Listing Marketplace）**是一个平台，它将来自众多发布者的结构化列表——描述特定待售、待租或待交换物品的记录——聚合为一个可搜索的库存，帮助寻找者发现并比较所提供的物品，并将每位感兴趣的寻找者与列表背后的发布者连接起来。该平台的定义性循环终止于这种连接：销售、租赁或合同本身是在平台之外由各方达成的。

其定义性核心很小：

```text
记录列表
└── 汇集的可搜索库存
     └── 寻找者 → 发布者连接
         └── 平台外交易完成
```

- **记录列表** — 一个结构化、标准化的记录，描述一个特定的待提供物品：其属性、媒体、价格或条款，以及发布该列表的发布者身份。
- **汇集的可搜索库存** — 来自许多独立发布者的列表被汇集到一个单一的、可搜索、可过滤的池中，按类别、属性和位置组织。
- **寻找者 → 发布者连接** — 一种查询或联系路径，将寻找者交给发布者以开始交易对话。
- **平台外交易完成** — 平台连接各方；它不作为商户执行底层交易。交易相邻服务（预订、押金、金融介绍）可能作为可选层存在，但商业协议是在发布者和寻找者之间达成的。

移除标准化的列表结构，池就变成了一个自由形式的分类广告板。移除连接路径，它就变成了一个没有商业活动的已发布目录。让平台执行交易，它就变成了一个交易型市场或预订平台。
leaves.dc:
Four structures, jointly held:

1. **The listing of record.** The central object. A listing is not a free-form advertisement: it is a record in a standardized schema — category, attributes (size, specification, condition, tenure, mileage, and so on, depending on the vertical), media gallery, price or terms, location, and the identity of the lister. The schema is what makes listings comparable and filterable at scale. The lister identity on the record is load-bearing: every listing is accountable to whoever published it.

2. **The pooled searchable inventory.** The marketplace's value comes from aggregation: many listers' listings form one pool that a seeker searches once, rather than visiting each seller separately. The pool is organized by category and attribute structure, and — in most mature products — by geography, because most listing verticals are location-bound.

3. **The seeker → lister connection.** Every listing carries a way to act on interest: an inquiry form, a masked message, a viewing or test-drive request, a phone reveal, or a structured lead delivered to the lister. The connection is the platform's conversion point and the object its lead-handling machinery is built around.

4. **Off-platform deal completion.** The platform does not stand between the parties at the point of sale. There is no cart, no checkout for the offered thing, no platform-executed payment for the item itself. The deal — the sale, the lease, the contract — is negotiated and concluded directly between seeker and lister. This is what keeps the Type distinct from transactional marketplaces and booking platforms.
leaves.dc_zh:
四个结构，共同构成：

1. **列表记录。** 核心对象。列表不是自由形式的广告：它是在标准化模式中的记录——类别、属性（尺寸、规格、状况、持有期、里程等，取决于垂直领域）、媒体库、价格或条款、位置以及发布者的身份。模式使得列表能够大规模地比较和过滤。列表上发布者的身份是关键：每个列表都对发布者负责。

2. **可搜索的汇总库存。** 市场的价值来自聚合：许多发布者的列表形成一个池，寻求者只需搜索一次，而不是分别访问每个卖家。库存按类别和属性结构组织，并且——在大多数成熟产品中——按地理位置组织，因为大多数列表垂直领域是受地点限制的。

3. **寻求者 → 发布者连接。** 每个列表都提供了处理兴趣的方式：查询表单、掩码消息、查看或试驾请求、电话揭示，或结构化的线索传递给发布者。这个连接是平台的转化点，也是其线索处理机制围绕的对象。

4. **平台外交易完成。** 平台在销售点不介入双方之间。没有购物车、没有结账流程、没有平台执行的支付。
leaves.rules:
### Admission policy gates publication

Who may publish is a policy decision, not a technical one. Products range from professional-only (listings accepted only from registered agents, dealers, or member firms) to private-only (listings accepted only from verified owners) to mixed with tiered billing. The policy shapes everything downstream: how listings enter the pool (feed vs self-serve form), the trust posture (professional accountability vs identity verification), and the monetization model.

### The lister owns the listing content

The platform receives listing data from the lister and treats the lister as its source of truth. Corrections to a live listing route through the lister; the platform's own staff do not normally edit inventory content. Third parties (including the subject of a listing) can flag problems through reporting paths, but the fix flows back through the lister.

### Status is visible and lifecycle-bearing

Listings carry user-visible status — live, under offer, price reduced, sold/let, removed — and seekers filter on it. Completion lags are expected: a sold or let listing may remain visible until the lister updates it, and platforms provide reporting mechanisms for stale listings. Removed listings commonly persist as historic records.

### Contact is mediated and protected

First contact runs through the platform: inquiry forms, masked email relays, or withheld phone numbers. This protects both sides (spam reduction, privacy) and gives the platform its lead-handling role. Some products attach seeker context to leads — with consent — to help listers prioritize.

### Monetization couples to the listing

Lister-side charges typically attach to the listing itself: per-advert packages (sometimes with pricing rules that tie the advert's asking price to a paid band), memberships or contracts that cover a lister's whole inventory, or paid services around the deal. The seeker side of the core discovery loop is free in the products studied.

### The platform stops at connection — with optional extensions

The defining loop ends when the parties connect. Products may layer transaction-adjacent services on top — online reservation of a vehicle, holding deposits, deal builders with finance, tenancy creation and deposit protection, instant sale-to-dealer flows — but these are optional layers around the connection, not a replacement for it: the underlying sale or lease is still concluded between the parties. Where a product introduces platform-executed checkout for the offered thing, it has crossed into the transactional-marketplace territory described under Related Application Types.

### Trust is an operating surface

Because the platform never handles the deal, trust machinery substitutes for transaction protection: listing reporting, fake-listing and scam guidance, lister reviews, verification badges, and complaint paths are standard parts of the product, not add-ons.
leaves.rules_zh:
### 准入政策决定发布

谁可以发布是一个政策决定，而非技术决定。产品范围从仅限专业（仅接受来自注册代理、经销商或会员公司的列表）到仅限私人（仅接受来自经过验证的所有者的列表），再到混合分层计费。该政策塑造了下游的一切：列表如何进入池（数据源 vs 自助表单）、信任姿态（专业问责 vs 身份验证）以及变现模式。

### 发布者拥有列表内容

平台从发布者处接收列表数据，并将发布者视为其真实来源。对在线列表的更正通过发布者进行路由；平台自己的员工通常不编辑库存内容。第三方（包括列表的主体）可以通过报告路径标记问题，但修复流程通过发布者返回。

### 状态可见且承载生命周期

列表携带用户可见的状态——在线、报价中、降价、已售/已租、移除——寻找者根据它进行过滤。完成滞后是预期的：已售或已租的列表可能在发布者更新之前保持可见，平台提供针对陈旧列表的报告机制。移除的列表通常作为历史记录持续存在。

### 联系是中介化且受保护的

首次联系通过平台进行：查询表单、屏蔽电子邮件中继或保留电话号码。这保护了双方（减少垃圾信息、隐私）并赋予平台其线索处理角色。某些产品在获得同意的情况下将寻找者上下文附加到线索上，以帮助发布者优先处理。

### 变现与列表耦合

发布者端的收费通常附加到列表本身：按广告套餐（有时带有将广告要价与广告价格挂钩的定价规则）

leaves.name: Listings Platform
leaves.overview:
A **Listings Platform** is a publication-and-discovery platform whose content is a pooled inventory of structured, time-bound offer listings from many independent listers. Its whole job is to take what many parties are currently offering — homes for sale or rent, vehicles, jobs, rooms, holiday lets, and similar — and make that pool of offers findable: searchable, filterable, comparable, and individually inspectable, until each offer is let, sold, expired, or withdrawn.

The defining core is deliberately small:

```text
Many listers / supply sources
└── Pooled inventory of current-offer listings (one venue, one operator)
    └── Listing of record — one specific thing offered
        (attributes, media, price/terms, location, identified lister or source)
    └── Seeker-facing discovery over the pool (search / browse / filter)
    └── Time-bound lifecycle — enters the pool, is updated, is retired when consummated or expired
```

Everything else commonly associated with these products — seeker accounts, saved searches and alerts, map views, lister profiles and reviews, verification and fraud controls, sold-price and valuation data layers, memberships and paid placement, even rental application or tenancy machinery — is mature added structure, not what makes the product a listings platform. Older and simpler realizations (a newspaper's listings section, a window card wall, a broker's listing book) satisfy the same core with none of the modern apparatus: the pooling of current offers from many listers, presented for discovery, is the Type.

When the platform's defining job shifts — to hosting free-form person-to-person ads (Classifieds), to managing the connection between seeker and lister as the product itself (Listing Marketplace), to standing records about entities rather than offers (Directory), or to selling the offerings on-platform (Online Marketplace) — it has become a different Application Type.
leaves.overview_zh:
一个**列表平台（Listings Platform）**是一个发布与发现平台，其内容是由众多独立发布者汇集而成的、结构化的、有时效限制的报价列表库存。其全部职责在于将多方当前提供的物品——待售或待租的房产、车辆、职位、房间、度假租赁等——转化为可发现的资源：使其可搜索、可筛选、可比较、可单独查看，直到每个报价被租出、售出、过期或撤回。

其定义性核心被刻意保持精简：

```text
众多发布者 / 供应来源
└── 当前报价列表的汇集库存（单一场所，单一运营方）
     └── 记录性列表 — 针对某一特定被提供物品
         （属性、媒体、价格/条款、位置、已识别的发布者或来源）
     └── 面向寻找者的池内发现（搜索 / 浏览 / 筛选）
     └── 有时效的生命周期 — 进入池内，被更新，在完成或过期时退役
```

通常与这些产品相关联的其他所有内容——寻找者账户、保存的搜索与警报、地图视图、发布者档案与评价、验证与欺诈控制、成交价与估值数据层、会员资格与付费展示，甚至租赁申请或租赁管理流程——都是成熟的附加结构，而非使该产品成为列表平台的原因。更古老、更简单的实现形式（如报纸的列表版块、橱窗卡片墙、经纪人的列表簿）在没有现代复杂机制的情况下也能满足同样的核心需求：将众多发布者的当前报价汇集起来以供发现，这就是该类型（Type）的本质。

当平台的定义性职责发生转变——例如转向托管自由形式的个人对个人的广告（分类广告 Classifieds），将寻找者与发布者之间的连接管理本身作为产品（列表市场 Listing Marketplace），记录关于实体而非报价的信息（目录 Directory），或在平台上直接销售这些提供物（在线市场 Online Marketplace）——它便已成为另一种应用类型（Application Type）。
leaves.dc_zh:
消费者端的存在是为了回答'当前有哪些符合我需求的供应？' 成熟的产品通常提供：
- 基于地点或类别的入口搜索，带有结构化属性过滤器和关键词搜索；
- 基于地图的搜索和区域定义，适用于位置相关的垂直领域；
- 保存的搜索并带有提醒，以便当新列表进入池中时通知搜索者；
- 列表详情页展示完整记录和联系交接。
leaves.rules:
### A listing exists because an offer exists

The record's legitimacy is tied to a live offer. Platforms treat expired, let, sold, or withdrawn inventory as a normal and managed state — staleness is governed, not tolerated — and several products carry explicit data-quality and fraud policies over the pool. This temporal discipline is what keeps the venue a market of current offers rather than an archive.

### Location correctness governs findability (for location-bound verticals)

For property and other place-bound offerings, search is organized around geographic areas; whether a listing appears for a seeker's search depends primarily on the offer's correct placement in that geography rather than on wording in its title. Non-local verticals (jobs for remote work, goods) shift the organizing axis to attributes and categories.

### The platform publishes, it does not sell

No checkout, cart, or transaction of record exists on the core surface: the offer is advertised, and the deal is made between seeker and lister outside the platform (or, where a product adds application or tenancy machinery, through clearly optional layers on top of the advertising core). When mediated transactions become the platform's defining product, it has drifted into marketplace territory.

### Contact is a handoff

The platform's obligation at the edge of the pool is to connect the interested seeker with the identified lister or source — by publishing contact details, relaying messages (often with masking for privacy and spam control), managing leads, or linking out. How much machinery surrounds that handoff varies from almost none to a managed pipeline; the handoff itself is standard.

### Alerts ride on pool entry

Newly published listings are the alerting fuel: seekers subscribe to criteria, and the platform commonly notifies them when matching offers enter the pool. This couples the alert system to the listing lifecycle rather than to edits of existing listings.

### Monetization sits on the supply side

In the researched sample, discovery is free for seekers and revenue comes from listers (memberships, listing products, paid placement, syndication, leads) and from advertising around the audience. Seeker-side charging for the core discovery product is not observed.
leaves.rules_zh:
### 列表的存在是因为报价的存在

记录的合法性与实时报价绑定。平台将过期、已租、已售或已撤回的库存视为一种正常且受管理的状态——陈旧性是受治理的，而非被容忍的——并且多个产品对池内数据执行明确的数据质量和欺诈政策。这种时间纪律使该场所保持为当前报价的市场，而非档案库。

### 位置正确性决定可发现性（针对位置绑定垂直领域）

对于房产和其他地点绑定的提供物，搜索围绕地理区域组织；列表是否出现在寻找者的搜索中，主要取决于报价在该地理区域中的正确放置，而非其标题中的措辞。非本地垂直领域（远程工作职位、商品）将组织轴心转移到属性和类别上。

### 平台负责发布，而非销售

核心界面上不存在结账、购物车或交易记录：报价是被广告宣传的，交易在寻找者与发布者之间在平台外部达成（或者，在产品添加申请或租赁机制的情况下，通过位于广告核心之上的明确可选层达成）。当中介交易成为平台的定义性产品时，它已偏离至市场领域。

### 联系是一种交接

平台在池边缘的义务是将感兴趣的寻找者与已识别的发布者或来源连接起来——通过发布联系信息、转发消息（通常带有掩码以控制隐私和垃圾信息）、管理潜在客户或链接出去。围绕该交接的机制多少不一，从几乎没有到受管理的管道不等；交接本身是标准的。

### 警报依赖于池内进入

新发布的列表是警报的燃料：寻找者订阅标准，

leaves.name: Litigation Management Platform
leaves.overview:
A **Litigation Management Platform** is a party-side system of record for litigated disputes: it holds each litigated case as a persistent record — the dispute's adverse parties, their representation, the court or forum, and the case's current posture — and works that case through the operating machinery of a proceeding: litigation stages, calendared litigation events with limitation-period risk, and the case's discovery and evidence layer.

The defining core is deliberately small:

```text
Litigated Case of Record
└── Parties & representation (claimant, defendant, counsel, co-counsel, experts)
    └── Forum/court context and current procedural posture
        └── The proceeding worked as litigation
            ├── Litigation stages / phase plans
            ├── Litigation events + deadline & limitation-period calendaring
            └── Discovery & evidence layer (requests, productions, experts, key documents)
```

Everything else commonly associated with these products — settlement and demand tracking, litigation budgets and billing-guideline compliance, medical-damages material, client portals, portfolio dashboards, AI summaries — is widespread but not what makes the software a litigation management system. The same is true on the buyer side: budgets, panel-counsel management and spend control are the oversight layer that dispute-owning organizations (corporations, insurers, governments) add on top.

The Type is realized in two market poles: **litigation firms** running plaintiff or defense caseloads (the standalone product family), and **dispute owners** — in-house legal, insurers, government agencies — whose litigated-case oversight is usually packaged inside matter management, enterprise legal management suites, or claims systems.
leaves.overview_zh:
一款**诉讼管理平台**是处理诉讼争议的当事方记录系统：它将每一起诉讼案件作为持久记录保存——记录争议的各方当事人、其代理律师、受理法院或仲裁庭，以及案件的当前诉讼态势——并通过诉讼程序的运作机制处理该案件：诉讼阶段、具有诉讼时效风险的法定日历事件，以及案件的证据开示与证据层。

其定义性核心被刻意设计得十分精简：

```text
记录在案的诉讼案件
└── 当事人与代理（索赔方、被告、律师、共同律师、专家）
    └── 法院/仲裁庭背景与当前程序态势
        └── 作为诉讼进行的程序
            ├── 诉讼阶段 / 阶段计划
            ├── 诉讼事件 + 截止日期与诉讼时效日历
            └── 证据开示与证据层（请求、出示文件、专家、关键文件）
```

这些产品通常关联的其他所有功能——和解与索赔追踪、诉讼预算与账单合规、医疗损害材料、客户门户、案件组合仪表板、AI摘要——虽然普遍，但并非该软件成为诉讼管理系统的决定性特征。买方视角同样如此：预算、律师团管理与支出控制是拥有争议的组织（企业、保险公司、政府机构）在其之上添加的监督层。

该类型在市场上通过两个极点实现：运营原告或被告案件量的**诉讼律所**（独立产品家族），以及**争议所有者**——公司内部法律部门、保险公司、政府机构——其对诉讼案件的监督通常被整合在事务管理、企业法律管理套件或理赔系统之中。
leaves.dc: The central object is the **case**: a persistent, individually identified record of one dispute prosecuted or defended in a forum (court, arbitration, tribunal, administrative body). A case carries:
leaves.dc_zh: 核心对象是 **案件**：在法庭、仲裁庭、裁判庭或行政机构等场所中，对一起诉讼、辩护或争议进行追诉或辩护而产生的、具有持久性且独立标识的记录。每个案件包含：
leaves.rules:
- **Deadlines are guarded as malpractice-level risk.** Limitation periods and court-rule deadlines attach to the case record with owners, reminders, and attribution; computation from jurisdictional rules is the mature implementation, manual entry the baseline.
- **Posture follows the forum.** The case's stage changes as the court or tribunal acts, not merely as internal work completes; the case record mirrors a proceeding conducted outside the system.
- **Adverse-party identity is structural.** Conflict screening against existing parties happens before acceptance; parties and representation are recorded on the case, not just in a contact list.
- **Economics couple to the case, not the timesheet alone.** Plaintiff-side value lives in the settlement/demand record; defense- and buyer-side control lives in budgets and guidelines applied per case; timekeeping and billing exist around these, not instead of them.
- **The case file is a durable record.** Documents, communications, events and history persist on the case across staff changes and handoffs — litigation is long-lived work that passes through many hands.
- **Roles and access matter most on the buyer side.** Assignment of cases to firms or staff counsel, visibility to outside collaborators, and audit trails for reporting to insurers or management are common governed behaviors.
leaves.rules_zh:
- **截止日期被视为重大执业风险。** 诉讼时效和法院规则规定的截止日期与案件记录绑定，包含负责人、提醒和归属；根据管辖规则进行自动计算是成熟的实现方式，手动输入是基础要求。
- **诉讼态势随法院而变。** 案件的阶段随着法院或仲裁庭的行动而改变，而不仅仅是内部工作完成；案件记录反映的是在系统之外进行的程序。
- **对方当事人身份具有结构性。** 接受委托前需对现有当事人进行利益冲突筛查；当事人和代理关系记录在案件上，而不仅仅是在联系人列表中。
- **经济性与案件相关，而不仅与计时表挂钩。** 原告端的价值体现在和解/索赔记录中；被告及买方端的控制体现在应用于每个案件的预算和指南中；计时和账单围绕这些内容展开，而非取而代之。
- **案件卷宗是持久记录。** 文件、沟通、事件和历史记录在案件上得以保留，跨越人员变动和交接——诉讼是历时很长、经手多人的工作。
- **角色和权限在买方端最为重要。** 将案件分配给律所或内部律师、对外部合作者的可见性、以及向保险公司或管理层汇报的审计跟踪，都是常见的受控行为。

leaves.name: Live Music Performance Software
leaves.overview:
A **Live Music Performance Software** is a performance application that a musician operates **during a live show** to execute music in real time from material the musician prepared in the software beforehand.

Its defining core is a trio of properties:

```text
Material the performer authors/curates in the software before the show
└── Real-time execution during the show
    │   (triggering, recalling, playing, mixing the material live)
    └── The show itself is the deliverable
        (no edited document is produced as the goal)
```

Each property is load-bearing. Remove the first and the software is mixing ready-made recordings — a DJ product. Remove the second and the material simply plays itself — a player, not a performance instrument. Remove the third and the work becomes production — a DAW whose goal is a recorded output. What remains when all three hold is the performer's seat: the software is the instrument, the rig, and the set-list holder at the same time.

The category has two recognizably different product shapes — **clip-launching environments** (the material is loops, patterns and sequences triggered from a grid) and **live-rig environments** (the material is sounds and song configurations recalled per song) — but both realize the same core.
leaves.overview_zh:
一款**现场音乐表演软件**是音乐家在**现场演出期间**操作的应用程序，用于实时执行音乐家事先在软件中准备好的素材。

其定义核心由三个属性组成：

```text
表演者在演出前在软件中创作/整理的素材
└── 演出期间的实时执行
     │    (现场触发、调用、播放、混音素材)
     └── 演出本身即为交付物
         (不产生经过编辑的文档作为目标)
```

每个属性都至关重要。移除第一个属性，软件就变成了对现成录音进行混音——一款DJ产品。移除第二个属性，素材就会自行播放——这是一个播放器，而非表演乐器。移除第三个属性，工作就变成了制作——一款目标是录制输出的DAW。当这三个属性同时成立时，剩下的就是表演者的位置：软件同时是乐器、设备架和曲目单持有者。

该类别有两种明显不同的产品形态——**片段启动环境**（素材是从网格触发的循环、模式和序列）和**现场设备架环境**（素材是按歌曲调用的声音和歌曲配置）——但两者都实现了相同的核心。
leaves.dc:
**Prepared performance material.** The software holds musical material the performer authors or curates in advance: sounds, instruments, effects chains, audio loops and samples, patterns and sequences, and configurations that bundle these into per-song or per-section settings. The material is the performer's own working material — even when it samples recordings, it has been prepared, edited and arranged for this show. This is the clearest line against DJ software, where the working material is finished recordings made by others.

**Real-time execution.** During the show the performer triggers, launches, recalls and plays the material in response to live decisions, and plays input into it (keys, pads, guitar, voice). The software combines the triggered material and the live input — mixing levels, applying effects, handling tempo — into one continuous program output. The performer is executing the show; nothing is being rendered or edited toward a file.

**The show as the deliverable.** The output of the software is the performance itself. Recording the show, where supported, is a byproduct for later reference — never the stated goal, and nothing in the workflow depends on producing a document. This is the line against production DAWs, whose endpoint is a rendered mix or stems.
leaves.dc_zh:
**准备好的表演素材。** 软件持有表演者提前创作或策划的音乐素材：声音、乐器、效果链、音频循环和采样、模式和序列，以及将这些打包成每首歌曲或每节设置的配置。这些素材是表演者自己的工作素材——即使它采样录音，它也已经为这场演出准备、编辑和安排过。这是与DJ软件最明显的区别，DJ软件的工作素材是由他人制作的成品录音。

**实时执行。** 在演出期间，表演者根据现场决策触发、启动、召回并播放素材，并将其输入（键盘、打击垫、吉他、人声）播放到其中。软件将触发的素材和实时输入结合——混合电平、应用效果、处理节奏——形成一个连续的程序输出。表演者正在执行演出；没有渲染或编辑成文件的内容。

**表演即交付。** 软件的输出是表演本身。录制演出，如果支持的话，是用于后续参考的副产品——从不是明确目标，工作流程中没有依赖于产生文档。这是与制作DAW的区别，制作DAW的终点是渲染的混音或分轨。
leaves.rules:
### The show must not stop

Performance software is built around the assumption that the output cannot interrupt itself. This shapes real behavior in the sampled rig products: features like defer-on-switch (finish the current sound before changing), instant silencing of the previous patch, pre-loading of songs so switching is instant, and suppression of save prompts mid-show — the exact combination varies by product. Stability and latency tuning is a documented concern in the category, not an implementation detail.

### Triggers align to the music

In grid-launching products, launches and recordings are commonly quantized to the musical grid so that a late button-press still lands in time. Tempo changes can be attached to scenes, songs or patches, so recalling a section moves the whole machine to that section's tempo.

### One material-holder at a time (per channel)

Grid-style products typically allow one clip per track at a time; launching a new clip replaces the playing one on that track while others continue. Rig-style products recall whole configurations, replacing the active sound set. Both embody the same rule: the performer's action takes over the channel it is aimed at, instantly.

### Material changes are performance choices

During the show, edits to material are live musical decisions (layering, muting, swapping), not document revisions; some products can log the improvisation back into an editable document afterwards, but that is capture, not the goal.

### The working material is the performer's own

The software performs material prepared in it — even audio sampled from recordings has been edited, looped and arranged by the performer for this show. This is the rule that keeps the Type distinct from mixing finished recordings.

### Recording is a byproduct

Capturing the show is supported (documented across the sampled products) but sits outside the performing loop: nothing about the live workflow depends on it.
leaves.rules_zh:
### 演出不能中断

表演软件建立在输出不能自我中断的假设之上。这塑造了采样设备架产品中的实际行为：诸如切换延迟（在更改前完成当前声音）、即时静音前一个补丁、预加载歌曲以便即时切换、以及演出中抑制保存提示等功能——具体组合因产品而异。稳定性和延迟调整是该类别中记录在案的关注点，而非实现细节。

### 触发器对齐音乐

在网格启动产品中，启动和录制通常量化到音乐网格，以便迟按的按钮仍能准时落地。速度变化可以附加到场景、歌曲或补丁，因此调用一个部分会将整个机器移动到该部分的速度。

### 每次一个素材持有者（每通道）

网格风格产品通常允许每条轨道同时只有一个片段；启动新片段会替换该轨道上正在播放的片段，而其他片段继续播放。设备架风格产品调用整个配置，替换活动的声音集。两者都体现了同一条规则：表演者的动作即时接管其指向的通道。

### 素材变更是表演选择

在演出期间，对素材的编辑是实时的音乐决策（分层、静音、交换），而非文档修订；某些产品可以将即兴演奏记录回可编辑文档，但那是捕获，而非目标。

### 工作素材是表演者自己的

软件执行在其中准备好的素材——即使是采自录音的音频，也已被表演者为本次演出编辑、循环和编排。这是使该类型与混音成品录音区分开来的规则。

### 录制是副产品

leaves.name: Live Video Chat Application
leaves.overview:
A **Live Video Chat Application** is a social application whose center is the live, real-time, two-way video conversation: equal participants meet on camera in one-to-one or small-group conversations, each conversation is with counterparts the user has chosen, and the product holds a persistent personal social context — a profile, relationships, messaging, and a record of past conversations — around those live conversations.

The defining structure is small:

```text
Live two-way video conversation (everyone on camera, live while it happens)
└── Equal peers in a small co-present group (no broadcaster, no audience)
    └── User-selected counterparts (relationships, suggestions, or a browsable pool — never random assignment)
        └── Persistent personal social context (profile · relationships · messaging · history)
```

Everything commonly associated with the category — browsing who is online, in-call games and effects, virtual currencies and subscriptions, kids and family editions, large group calls — is widespread in current products but is not what makes the product one of this kind. A bare application for live video conversations with chosen people, wrapped in nothing but a profile and a history, still fits the definition completely.

The removals that make the Type recognizable: remove the *personal social context* and the product becomes a pure video-calling utility; remove *user selection* — let the platform draw the counterpart at random — and it becomes random video chat; give one side the floor and the other side an audience, and it becomes live streaming; switch the medium to a governed audio floor, and it becomes social audio.
leaves.overview_zh:
一款**实时视频聊天应用**是一种以实时、双向视频对话为核心的社交应用：地位平等的参与者通过摄像头进行一对一或小型群体的对话，每次对话的对象都是用户自行选择的，并且产品在这些实时对话周围维持着一个持久的个人社交语境——包括个人资料、关系网络、消息记录以及过往对话的历史记录。

其定义性结构非常精简：

```text
实时双向视频对话（所有人开启摄像头，实时进行）
└── 小型共在群体中的平等对等者（无主播，无观众）
     └── 用户选择的对话对象（基于关系、推荐或可浏览的池子——绝非随机分配）
         └── 持久的个人社交语境（个人资料 · 关系 · 消息 · 历史）
```

通常与该类别相关联的一切——浏览谁在线、通话中的游戏和特效、虚拟货币和订阅服务、儿童及家庭版、大型群组通话——虽然在当前产品中普遍存在，但这并非使产品属于此类型的本质特征。一个仅用于与选定人员进行实时视频对话的极简应用，仅包裹着个人资料和历史记录，也完全符合该定义。

使该类型可识别的移除操作如下：移除*个人社交语境*，产品就变成了纯粹的视频通话工具；移除*用户选择*——让平台随机分配对话对象——它就变成了随机视频聊天；赋予一方发言权而另一方成为观众，它就变成了直播；将媒介切换为受管理的音频发言权，它就变成了社交音频。
leaves.dc: - **The persistent personal social context.** The product holds a profile, relationships, and messaging/history around the live conversations, so that a conversation is one surface of an ongoing personal social space: people you met stay reachable, past conversations leave a trace you can act on, and your identity accumulates. Remove this and the product is a pure video-calling utility — a different Type (Video Calling Application).
leaves.dc_zh: - **持久的个人社交上下文。** 产品围绕实时对话保存个人资料、关系和消息/历史记录，使得对话成为持续个人社交空间的一个表面：你认识的人保持可达，过去的对话留下可操作的痕迹，你的身份得以积累。移除这一点，产品就是一个纯粹的视频通话工具——一个不同的类型（视频通话应用）。
leaves.rules:
- **Both sides are on camera.** The conversation is two-way video by default; camera and microphone are personal toggles. This symmetric exposure is what distinguishes the Type from broadcast forms, where appearing is a granted role.
- **Selection belongs to the user.** Products may narrow the pool (preferences, filters) and may gate a connection on availability, but the counterpart is never randomly assigned. Where a product does assign counterparts randomly, it has become a different Type.
- **Encounters persist as relationships.** The follow/add-from-history mechanic converts live conversations into standing connections. What persists is the social trace — profile, relationship, messages, history — not the video itself; live conversations are live-first and leave no replay unless the product explicitly records them.
- **Conduct rules attach to the camera.** Where strangers meet, published rules (what may be shown and said), in-conversation reporting, and account enforcement are structural parts of the product, not optional extras.
- **Monetization wraps the conversation.** Where products charge, the core conversation remains the free center in the researched market, with payment attached around it — subscription tiers, virtual currencies, paid filters and messages. Postures vary; the free core is the norm but not an invariant.
- **Group scale is a product decision.** Group conversations are common; their size limits vary substantially by product and are not part of the Type's definition.
leaves.rules_zh:
- **双方都在摄像头前。** 对话默认是双向视频；摄像头和麦克风是个人开关。这种对称的暴露是该类型与广播形式的区别所在，在广播形式中，出镜是一种被授予的角色。
- **选择权属于用户。** 产品可以缩小池子（偏好、过滤器）并可以将连接建立在可用性之上，但对话对象绝非随机分配。如果产品随机分配对话对象，它就变成了另一种类型。
- **相遇持久化为关系。** 从历史中关注/添加的机制将实时对话转化为固定的连接。持久存在的是社交痕迹——个人资料、关系、消息、历史——而非视频本身；实时对话以实时为先，除非产品明确记录，否则不留回放。
- **行为准则附着于摄像头。** 在陌生人相遇的地方，已发布的规则（允许展示和说什么）、对话中的举报以及账户执行是产品的结构性部分，而非可选附加项。
- **变现包裹着对话。** 在产品收费的地方，核心对话在研究市场中仍保持免费中心地位，付费附着在其周围——订阅层级、虚拟货币、付费过滤器和消息。姿态各异；免费核心是常态但非不变量。
- **群组规模是产品决策。** 群组对话很常见；其大小限制因产品而异且差异巨大，不属于该类型的定义部分。

leaves.name: Livestock Management
leaves.overview:
A **Livestock Management** application is the livestock producer's system of record for the animals themselves: it holds the herd or flock as persistent records, captures every management event against those records as it happens, and turns the accumulated history into the decisions that keep a livestock operation running — which animals to breed, treat, move, cull, or sell.

Its defining structure is small:

```text
Livestock population (individual animals and/or groups with counts)
└── Dated event records bound to that population
    (breeding, births, weaning, health, weights, movements, purchases/sales/deaths)
    └── Records → decisions loop
        (performance measures, reports, worksheets → breed / treat / move / cull / sell)
```

Everything else commonly associated with modern products — electronic ear tags and RFID readers, breeding-cycle calendars, medicine inventories, pasture maps, compliance exports, cloud sync — is widespread in today's market but is not what makes the software livestock management. A paper herd book, a calving book, a treatment log, and an annual culling decision satisfy the same core.

The Type covers the generic livestock world — beef cattle, sheep, goats, and multi-species holdings. Its specialties have their own identities: dairy is defined by the lactation/milking cycle, poultry and swine by batch-flock production, aquaculture by water-environment rearing units. When a product's center of gravity is the milk cycle or the all-in/all-out flock, it belongs to those Types, not here.
leaves.overview_zh:
一个**牲畜管理**应用程序是牲畜生产者对牲畜本身的记录系统：它将畜群或畜组作为持久记录保存，实时捕获针对这些记录的每一个管理事件，并将积累的历史转化为维持牲畜运营的决策——决定哪些动物需要繁殖、治疗、转移、淘汰或出售。

其核心结构如下：

```text
牲畜种群（个体动物和/或带计数的群体）
```
